source: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.
reference: Bak uroe Senin, awak ilmuwan dari Fakultas Kedokteran Universitas Stanford geu peuumum akan jiteumèe alat diagnostik baro nyang jeuet geupileh atoe sel meunurot jeunèhjih: chip ubit nyang jeuet geucetak nyang jeuet geupeuget deungôn printer inkjèt standar deungôn yum mungken na sabôh sen AS lam tiep sabôh.
hypothesis: Bak uroe Senen, para ilmuwan dari Fakultas Kedokteran Universitas Stanford mengumumkan penemuan alat diagnostik baroe yeng jeut mengurutkan sel meunurot jenis: chip ubit yeng jeut di cetak yeng jeut di peuget deungen printer inkjet standar deungen mungken kira-kira saboh sen AS sigoe.

source: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.
reference: Peneliti utama kheun atra nyoe mungken meuhasé deteksi phôn keu kanker, TBC, HIV ngôn malaria keu pasien di nanggroe nyang gasien, nyang teuh tingkat keu udép keu peunyaket lagèe kanker bôh dada jeut siteungoh dari nanggroe nyang leubéh kaya.
hypothesis: Peneliti utama peugah nyo jeut jipeuhase deteksi awai kanker, tuberkulosis, HIV dan malaria keu pasien di nanggroe-nanggroe berpenghasilan rendah, di pat tingkat seulamat untuk peunyakét lage kanker payudara jeut dua boh dari nanggroe-nanggroe nyang leubeh kaya.

source: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.
reference: JAS 39C Gripen meupok landasan pacu lingka pôh 9:30 beungoh di sinan (0230 UTC) ngôn beureutoih, sampöe geutôp bandara keu teureubang komersial.
hypothesis: JAS 39C Gripen rhot bak saboh runway bak kira-kira 9:30 beungoh watee lokal (0230 UTC) dan meledak, teutôb bandara keu penerbangan komersial.

source: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
reference: Pilot geukalôn identitas sebagoe Keupala Skuadron Dilokrit Pattavee.
hypothesis: Pilot nyan diidentifikasi seubagoe Panglima Skuadron Dilokrit Pattavee.

source: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.
reference: Media di sinan geupeuthee sabôh keundaraan pemadam apui bandara meugule watèe meujaweub.
hypothesis: Media lokal melaporkan saboh kendaraan kebakaran bandara meugulung seulama bereaksi.

source: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.
reference: Vidal, 28 thôn, ka meugabong ngôn Barça lhèe musem nyang ka leupah, dari Sevilla.
hypothesis: Vidal yang meu umu 28 thon ka bergabung bak Barça lhee musim nyang ka lheueh, dari Sevilla.

source: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.
reference: Peuphôn pinah u ibukuta Catalan, Vidal ka meu’èn 49 pertandingan keu klub nyan.
hypothesis: Seujak geupinah u ibukota Catalan, Vidal ka geupeumeuen 49 pertandingan untuk klub nyan.

source: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.
reference: Protèh keupeuphôn lingka pôh 11:00 watèe di sinan (UTC+1) di Whitehall di sibrang pinto tamong nyang geukawai pulisi u Downing Street, lam meuligoe resmi Peurdana Meuntroe.
hypothesis: Protes dimulai sekitar jam 11:00 watee lokal (UTC+1) di Whitehall ban seukeulileng pintu masuk yang dipeulindong polisi u Downing Street, rumoh residensi resmi perdana menteri.

source: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.
reference: Teupat oh lheuh pôh 11:00, ureuëng nyang proteh geutôp lalu lintas di gerbong utara di Whitehall.
hypothesis: Hana padub na lheuh poh 11, ureuëng-ureuëng protes geutôb lalu lintas bak geuritan u utara di Whitehall.

source: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.
reference: Bak pôh 11:20, pulisi meulakee awak nyang proteh gisa u trotoar, nyang kheun bahwa awaknyan peureulee geupeuimbang hak keu proteh ngôn lalu lintas nyang meutumpok.
hypothesis: Bak 11:20, pulisi meulakée ureung protes untuk pindah lom bak trotoar, geu peugah bahwa awak nyan perlu untuk menyeimbangkan hak untuk protes ngen peningkatan lalu lintas.

source: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
reference: Lingka pôh 11:29, proteh meulangkah u Whitehall, meulintaih Trafalgar Square, meulingkeu Strand, meulintaih Aldwych ngôn ek Kingsway u Holborn nyang teuh Partai Konservatif geupeuget Forum Musim Semi awaknyan di hotel Grand Connaught Rooms.
hypothesis: Kira-kira jam 11:29, protes nyan geujak u Whitehall, lewat Trafalgar Square, langsong Strand, lewat Aldwych dan u Kingsway menuju Holborn di teumpat Partai Konservatif geupeuna Forum Musim Semi jih di Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

source: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.
reference: Rekor ulee keu ulee Nadal meulawan petenis Kanada nakeuh 7–2.
hypothesis: Rekor head to head Nadal terhadap Kanada nyan adalah 72.

source: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.
reference: Gobnyan barô-barô nyoe talô meulawan Raonic di Brisbane Open
hypothesis: Jih baro-baroe kalah bak Raonic di Brisbane Open.

source: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.
reference: Nadal meurumpo 88% poin gleh lam pertandingan nyang meunang 76 poin di servis phôn.
hypothesis: Nadal dipeuget 88% poin net lam pertandingan meuprang 76 poin dalam servis phon.

source: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."
reference: ‘Oh lheuh pertandingan, King of Clay kheun, "Lôn seunang that jeut gisa u babak final dari event paléng peunténg. Lôn di sinoe cuba lôn peumeunang pertandingan nyoe."
hypothesis: Óh ka lheueh pertandingan nyan, King of Clay geupeugah, "Ulôn meurasa seudeh that-that keu lôn jak lom bak babak final acara-acara nyang paleng peunteng.

source: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.
reference: "Panama Papers" nakeuh istil-ah umum keu lingka siploih juta dokumen dari firma hukôm Panama Mossack Fonseca, nyang boco u pers bak musem semi 2016.
hypothesis: "Panama Papers" adalah istilah umum untuk kira-kira siploh juta dokumen dari firma hukum Panamanian Mossack Fonseca, nyang bocor ke media bak musim semi 2016.

source: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.
reference: Dokumen nyan meupeutunyok peuet blaih bank nyang bantu klien nyang kaya geupeusom miliaran dolar kekayaan keu jise pajak ngôn kanun laenjih.
hypothesis: Dokumen-dokumen nyan geutunyok peuet blah bank membantu klien kaya menyembunyikan miliaran dolar AS dari kekayaan untuk menghindari pajak dan peraturan laen.

source: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.
reference: Surat haba Inggreh The Guardian meupeunapan Deutsche Bank mat keukang kira-kira seperlhèe dari 1200 perusahaan cangkang nyang geupakek keu geupeujud hai nyoe.
hypothesis: Koran Inggris The Guardian geu sugesti Deutsche Bank ji kontrol kira-kira lhee dari 1.200 perusahaan shell yang dipakek untuk ji capai nyo.

source: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.
reference: Na protes di bandum donya, ladom tuntutan pidana, ngôn keupala-keupala pöemeurentah Islandia ngôn Pakistan ban dua ureuëngnyan geupiyôh.
hypothesis: Na protes di bansigom donya, padum-padum peukara pidana, dan pimpinan peumeurintah Islandia ngon Pakistan mandua geu resignasi.

source: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".
reference: Lahé di Hong Kong, Ma geusikula di Universitas New York ngön Sikula Hukôm Harvard ngön tom mat "kartu ijô" peundudôk teutap Amerika.
hypothesis: Lahir di Hong Kong, Ma meupeuet di Universitas New York ngen Harvard Law School ngen pernah na " green card " keu penduduk permanen Amerika.

source: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.
reference: Hsieh geupeumeui peunileh bahwa Ma mungken plueng dari nanggroe nyan lam masa krisis.
hypothesis: Hsieh geu implikasikan seulama pemilu bahwa Ma mungken geutinggai nanggroe nyan seulama masa krisis.

source: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.
reference: Hsieh bantah cit bahwa Ma fotogenik leubéh gaya nibak substansi.
hypothesis: Hsieh cit meuargumen bahwa Ma fotogenik leubeh gaya daripada zat.

source: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.
reference: Leukang dari tudohan nyoe, Ma meunang ngôn mudah di platform nyang geupeuamanat hubungan leubéh rap ngôn daratan Cina.
hypothesis: Meskipun tuduhan-tuduhan nyo, Ma meuhase seucara mudah bak saboh platform yang meulakée hubungan yeng lubeh rapat deungen daratan Cina.

source: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.
reference: Awak nyang meu’èn uroe nyoe nakeuh Alex Ovechkin dari Washington Capitals.
hypothesis: Pemain uroe nyoe nakeuh Alex Ovechkin dari Washington Capitals.

source: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.
reference: Gobnyan cetak 2 gol ngôn 2 assist lam kemenangan 5-3 Washington ateuh Atlanta Thrashers.
hypothesis: Jih na 2 gol dan 2 assist dalam kemenangan 5-3 Washington ateueh Atlanta Thrashers.

source: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;
reference: Assist phôn Ovechkin malam nyan nakeuh gol nyang peuteuntèe kemenangan lé rookie Nicklas Backstrom;
hypothesis: Asisten awai Ovechkin malam nyan bak gol meunang game oleh rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

source: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.
reference: Gol keduajih malam nyan nakeuh nyang ke-60 musem nyoe, jeut keu awak phôn nyang meu’èn nyang cetak 60 gol atawa leubéh dalam saboih musem mulaphôn 1995-96, watèe Jaromir Jagr ngôn Mario Lemieux maséng-maséng teuka lam tonggak sejarahnyan.
hypothesis: gol keudua nibak malam nyan nakeuh gol keu 60 musim nyan, jeut keu pemain phon yang mencetak 60 gol atawa leubeh dalam saboh musim sejak 1995-96, wate Jaromir Jagr dan Mario Lemieux masing-masing mencapai tonggak nyan.

source: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.
reference: Batten duek bak peringkat 190 lam jadoi 400 Ureuëng Amerika paléng kaya 2008 ngôn kekayaan lingka $2,3 miliar.
hypothesis: Batten dipeuduek keu 190 bak daftar 400 ureung Amerika Meukaya bak thon 2008 deungon hareuta hareuta jih kira-kira $2,3 miliar.

source: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.
reference: Gobnyan lulôih dari College of Arts & Sciences dari University of Virginia bak thôn 1950 ngôn nakeuh donor peunténg bagi institusi nyan.
hypothesis: Jih lulus dari College of Arts & Sciences dari Universitas Virginia bak thon 1950 ngen merupakan donor yang signifikan keu institusi nyan.

source: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.
reference: Penjara Abu Ghraib Irak ka jitot watee teungoh kerusuhan.
hypothesis: Peunjara Abu Ghraib di Irak ka jitot bak masa huru hara.

source: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.
reference: Penjara jeut keu jithee ‘oh lheuh pelecehan tahanan geuteumèe di sinan ‘oh lheuh kapilah AS cok alih.
hypothesis: Peunjara nyan jeut keu terkenal lheuh penyalahgunaan tawanan diungkap di sinan lheuh angkatan prang AS meukuasa.

source: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.
reference: Piquet Jr. meupok di Grand Prix Singapura 2008 teupat oh lheuh Fernando Alônso geupeubuet pit stôp leubéh awai, peutubiet moto nyang aman.
hypothesis: Piquet Jr. keunong musibah bak Grand Prix Singapura 2008 seucara langsong lheuh teudong awai bak pit untuk Fernando Alonso, geuba keluar mobil keselamatan.

source: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.
reference: Watèe moto-moto di keue Alonso tamong keu geupasoe bahan bakar lam safety car, gobnyan pinah bungkoh keu geucok kemenangan.
hypothesis: Teungoh mobil-mobil nyang na dikeue Alonso jijak keu bahan bakar dimiyueb mobil keselamatan, gobnyan laju geuék u ateueh keu geujak meunang.

source: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
reference: Piquet Jr. geupeucat oh lheuh Grand Prix Hungaria 2009.
hypothesis: Piquet Jr. dipeugöt lheuh Grand Prix Hongaria 2009.

source: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.
reference: Pah bak pôh 8:46, sengue meulanda kuta, nyang tanda watèe nyang pah jèt keu phôn troek bak sasaranjih.
hypothesis: Teuman pukul 8:46 beungoh, seungab-seungab di banda nyan, meumakna saat jet phon keunong sasaran jih.

source: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.
reference: Duwa bôh beurkas cahya ka geupasang meuarah u angkasa lam simalam.
hypothesis: Dua sinar cahaya ka dipeuget untuk menunjuk u langet seulama malam.

source: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.
reference: Konstruksi teungöh meulangsong keu limong geudông peuncakar langét baro bak teumpat nyan, ngön pusat transportasi ngön taman peuringatan bak teungöhjih.
hypothesis: Peugot mantong keu limong bangunan beuton manyang baroe di situs nyan, ngen pusat transportasi ngen taman peringatan di teungoh jih.

source: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
reference: Piasan PBS na leubeh dari dua lusen penghargaan Emmy, ngon durasijih leubeh singkat hanya dari Sesame Street ngon Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
hypothesis: Acara PBS na leubeh dari dua duzen penghargaan Emmy, dan peudjalan jih leubeh kureueng dari Sesame Street ngon Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

source: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.
reference: Tiep episode acara akan pupusat bak tema lam buku teuteuntee ngon lheueh nyan geupeuget tema nyan meulalui hikayat-hikayat.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb episode acara akan fokus bak saboh tema lam saboh buku tertentu dan kemudian mengeksplorasi tema nyan melalui padum boh kisah.

source: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.
reference: Tiep piasan akan geubri cit rekomendasi buku-buku nyang haroh geumita le aneuk-aneuk miet watee awak nyan jak u pustaka awak nyan.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb acara pih akan na rekomendasi untuk buku-buku yang harus dipeu cari aneuk miet watee awak nyan jak bak perpustakaan awak nyan.

source: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."
reference: John Grant, dari WNED Buffalo (stasiun rumoh Reading Rainbow) geukheun, " Reading Rainbow geuperuno aneuk- aneuk pakon membaca,... galak membaca — [piasan] meugeudra aneuk - aneuk untuk geucok buku dan geubaca."
hypothesis: John Grant, dari WNED Buffalo (stasiun phon Reading Rainbow) geupeugah "Reading Rainbow peurunoe aneuk miet pakon meubaca,... cinta keu meubaca  [show] geu dorong aneuk miet keu jakcok saboh buku dan meubaca".

source: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.
reference: Diyakini le ladom ureueng, teumasok John Grant, bahwa krisis pendanaan ngon pergeseran filosofi program televisi pendidikan ikot geupeuakhee serial nyan.
hypothesis: Dipercaya le padum-padum droe, termasuk John Grant, bahwa krisis pendanaan ngen perubahan dalam filsafat pemrograman televisi pendidikan berkontribusi untuk mengakhiri seri.

source: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.
reference: Bade, nyang terletak seulingka 645 mil (1040 km) barat Pulo Tanjung Verde, mungken keu neuk gadoeh sigohlom geupeuhajeuek wilayah darat dumpat geukheun le ureuëng keumaloen cuwaca.
hypothesis: Angén bada, yang terletak sekitar 1040 km barat pulau Cape Verde, mungken akan meredakan sebelum mengancam wilayah darat, kata para ahli cuaca.

source: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.
reference: Fred jinoe na angen ngôn keucepatan 105 mil per jeum (165km/jeum) ngôn meugrak u arah barat laot.
hypothesis: Fred saat nyoë na angén 105 mil/jam (165 km/jam) dan meupeutamong u arah barat laut.

source: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.
reference: Fred nakeuh siklôn tropis paléng teuga nyang tom meutuleh nibak nyoe i seulatan ngôn timu Atlantik mulaphôn na citra sateulit, ngôn bade rayeuk kelhèe sagai nyang meutuleh i timur 35°BB.
hypothesis: Fred nakeuh siklon tropis yeng paleng teuga yeng kalheh ji catet di seulatan ngen timu di Laôt Atlantik semenjak teuka gamba satelit, ngen hanya siklon utama keu lhee di catet di timu 35°W.

source: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.
reference: Bak tanggai 24 September 1759, Arthur Guinness geuteken siwa 9.000 thôn keu St James' Gate Brewery i Dublin, Irlandia.
hypothesis: Bak 24 September 1759, Arthur Guinness menandatangani kontrak sewa 9.000 thon untuk St James' Gate Brewery di Dublin, Irlandia.

source: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.
reference: 250 thôn alheuh nyan, Guinness ka rayeuk jeut keu bisnis global nyang hasé leubéh nibak 10 miliyon euro (US$14,7miliyon) tiep thôn.
hypothesis: 250 thon lheuh nyan, Guinness ka bereh jeut keu bisnis global yang bereh lebih dari 10 miliar euro (US $ 14,7 miliar) tieb-tieb thon.

source: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.
reference: Jonny Reid, co-driver keu tim A1GP Selandia Baro, uroe nyoe peugöt seujarah deungôn geumé keundaraan paléng bagah i ateueh Auckland Harbour Bridge nyang umujih 48 thôn, Selandia Baro, seucara legal.
hypothesis: Jonny Reid, co-driver untuk tim A1GP Selandia Baru, uroe nyoe geupeuget riwayat ngon geu peumeuén yeng paleng rayek di atas Jembatan Pelabuhan Auckland, Selandia Baru, 48 thôn, secara sah.

source: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.
reference: Mr Reid hasé geumé keu kandran A1GP Selandia Baro, Black Beauty deungôn bagah leubéh nibak 160km/jeum tujoh geujeumeurang tutue.
hypothesis: Pak Reid meuhase memandu mobil A1GP Selandia Baru, Black Beauty bak kecepatan leubeh dari 160km/jam tujoh goe di ateuh jembatan.

source: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.
reference: Pulisi Selandia Baro payah keu geungui sinyata radar bagah awaknyan keu ingieng kiban bagah Mr Reid leupah sabab kiban trep Black Beauty, ngôn sabôh-sabôhjih watèe pulisi meuhasé geugunci Mr Reid nakeuh watèejih trep sampöe 160km/ jeum.
hypothesis: Kepolisian Selandia Baru na masalah dipakek senjata radar kecepatan jih untuk melihat seberapa cepat Pak Reid geujak kareuna betapa rendahnya Black Beauty, dan satu-satunya kalheuh polisi meuhase meutarek Pak Reid adalah wate awak nyan meutarek bak 160km/jam.

source: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.
reference: Lam 3 buleuen nyang ka leupah, leubéh nibak 80 ureuëng lam peunjara geulheueh nibak fasilitas Central Booking hana geutuntot seucara reusmi.
hypothesis: Lam lhee buleuen nyang ka lheueh, leubeh nibak 80 ureuëng nyang teudrob ka geupeubeubaih nibak fasilitas pusat pemesanan tanpa diteuntang secara resmi.

source: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.
reference: Bak buleuen April thôn nyoe, peurintah peunahanan sumeuntara geupeutubiet lé Hakim Glynn keu teumpat keu geupeudoeng peulheuh awaknyan nyang geutheun leubéh 24 jeum ‘oh lheuh iteurimoeng awaknyan nyang hana iteurimoeng sidang lé komisaris peungadilan.
hypothesis: Bak buleuen April thôn nyoë, hukom Glynn geupeutron titah peugadôh seucara seucara seujati terhadap fasilitas nyan untuk geupeuna pembebasan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang keunong teun leubeh dari 24 jam lheuh geuteurimong, nyang hana geuteurimong sidang lé komisaris mahkamah.

source: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.
reference: Kömisaris geupeuteutap jaminan, meunyöe geubri, ngôn geupeuresmi tudôhan nyang geupeutubiet lè peutugas nyang dröp. Tudôhan nyan alheuh nyan geupeutamöng lam sistim komputer nanggröe bahgian dipat peukara nyan geulacak.
hypothesis: Komisaris geupeutrang jaminan, meunyo geubri, dan geu formalize tuduhan nyang dipeutamong lé petugas nyang peudeng.

source: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.
reference: Sidang geupeutanda cit tanggai hak teusangka keu peungadilan bagah.
hypothesis: Sidang sidang nyoë na cit tanda tanggai keu hak tersangka keu peundidikan sigra.

source: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.
reference: Peter Costello, beundahara Australi ngôn ureuëng nyang palèng mungkèn meuhasè Peurdana Meuntröe John Howard seubagöe syheh peureutèi Liberal ka geubi keuseupakatani liköt industri teunaga nuklir i Australi.
hypothesis: Peter Costello, tanggungan Australia dan ureueng nyang paleng meubacut pih jeut keu pengganti perdana menteri John Howard seubagoe pimpinan partai Liberal ka geu peutamong dukungan jih bak industri tenaga nuklir di Australia.

source: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.
reference: Mr Costello kheun bahwa meunyöe peumbangkèt listrèk teunaga nuklir jeut tang‘ui seucara ekonomi, Australi suwah talèt geung‘uijih.
hypothesis: M. Costello geupeugah bahwa wate pembangkit listrik tenaga nuklir jeut keu ekonomi meuguna, Australia harus melanjutkan penggunaan jih.

source: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.
reference: "Meunyöe jeut keu komersial, tanyöe suwah na nyan. Heutjih, bak prinsipjih phui tuleuëng keu énergi nuklir" geukheun lè Costello.

hypothesis: Pemimpin suprem nanggroe nyan, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, ka geu peutrang ketergantungan bak minyak seubagoe "seret" yang meupeulheueh seugolom revolusi Islam Iran bak thon 1979 dan di nanggroe nyan harus geupeubeubaih droe jih.

source: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.
reference: Watée kapsul sampöe u Bumoe ngôn tamöng u atmosfer, lingka poh 5 beungöeh (watée timu), nyan geuharap jeut keu piyasan cahya keu ureuëng-ureuëng i California Utara, Oregon, Nevada, ngôn Utah.
hypothesis: Watee kapsul nyan trok u bumoe dan geutamong lam atmosfer, kira-kira 5am (waktu timu), nyan diharap jeut keu saboh pertunjukan cahaya untuk ureung di California Utara, Oregon, Nevada, dan Utah.

source: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.
reference: Kapsul teungieng lagée bintang rhôet nyang léwat langét.
hypothesis: Kapsul nyan akan deuh lagee bintang nyang teungoh meulayang di langet.

source: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.
reference: Kapsul keuneuk iplueng deungôn keuceupatan lingka 12,8 km atawa 8 mil per deutik, cukôp bagah keu leupah nibak San Francisco u Los Angeles lam siminet.
hypothesis: Kapsul nyan akan meulayeue kira-kira 12,8 km atau 8 mil per detik, luwah that untuk jak dari San Francisco keu Los Angeles lam sipeut menit.

source: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.
reference: Stardust neuk peugöt rekor barô sipanyang masa seubagöe kapai teureubang ruweuëng angkasa palèng bagah nyang gisa u Bumoe, geupeutalô rekor sigöhlöm nyan nyang geupeugöt bak Mei 1969 lam watée tuka modul peuréntah Apollo X.
hypothesis: Stardust akan dipeuget rekor baroe untuk jeut keu pesawat angkasa tercepat untuk geuwoe u bumoe, dipeujeut rekor awai nyang dipeuget bak Mei 1969 seulama geugisa modul perintah Apollo X.

source: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.
reference: “Nyôe akan meupinah di ateueh panté barat California utara ngôn akan geupeutrang langèt dari California ngôn Orègon teungôh ngôn lajungôn Nevada ngôn Idaho ngôn u Utah,” geukheun lé Tom Duxbury, manajér proyèk Stardust.
hypothesis: Inyan akan bergerak di seulatan pantai barat California utara dan akan meucahya langet dari California melalui pusat Oregon dan lheuh nyan melalui Nevada dan Idaho dan u Utah,  Tom Duxbury, manajer proyek Stardust geupeugah.

source: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.
reference: Keputusan Tuan Rudd keu geubôh tèkèn lam perjanjian iklim Kyoto rôeh seulaén Amerika Serikat, nyang jinôe akan jeut keu saböh-saböhjih nanggröe maju nyang hana geupeuratifikasi perjanjian nyan.
hypothesis: Keuputosan Pak Rudd untuk menandatangani Perjanjian Iklim Kyoto mengisolasi Amerika Serikat, yang jinoe jeut keu nanggroë nyang ka maju yeng hana meratifikasi perjanjian nyan.

source: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.
reference: Beukaih pöemeurentah konservatif Australia tulak keu geupeuratifikasi Kyoto, deungôn kheun hai nyan akan geupeureulöh ekonomi deungôn meugantôngjih nyang brat bak ekspor batèe bara, adakpih nanggröe-nanggröe lagèe India ngôn Cina hana meuikat deungôn target emisi.
hypothesis: Pemerintah konservatif awai Australia geutulak untuk meratifikasi Kyoto, geu kheun nyan akan merugikan perekonomian deungen ketergantungan rayek jih bak ekspor batubara, seudangkan nanggroe-nanggroe lage India ngon Cina hana terikat deungen target emisi.

source: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.
reference: Nyôe nakeuh akuisisi paléng rayéuk dalam seujarah eBay.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah akuisisi paleng rayek dalam seujarah eBay.

source: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.
reference: Perusahaan meuharap keu geupeulée sumber keuntunganjih ngôn beu meusyuhu di area dipat Skype mat posisi nyang kong, lagee Cina, Eropa Timur, ngôn Brasil.
hypothesis: Perusahaan nyan meuharap keu ji diversifikasi sumber keuntungan jih dan ji peumeunang popularitas di daerah-daerah di sinan Skype na posisi kuat, lage Cina, Eropa Timu, ngen Brasil.

source: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.
reference: Ureuëng meu‘ileumée ka geuduga Enceladus sebagöe geologis aktif ngôn asai nyang mungkén nibak eunciën èh E Saturnus.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan geusangka Enceladus aktif secara geologis dan sumber mungken dari cincin E beku Saturnus.

source: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.
reference: Enceladus nakeuh objek nyang paléng reflektif bak tata surya, nyang hu silingka 90 persen cahya matauröe nyang keunôngjih.
hypothesis: Enceladus adalah objek nyang paleng meutarek lam tata surya, meutarek kira-kira 90 persen cahya mata uroe nyang keunong keunan.

source: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.
reference: Penerbit permeu‘enan Konami kheun uröe nyôe i saböh surat haba Jeupang bahwa awak nyan han geupeuteubiet meuneu‘en Days in Fallujah.
hypothesis: Penerbit game Konami geupeugah uroe nyoe lam saboh surat kabar Jepang bahwa awak nyan hana akan jipeuleumah game Six Days in Fallujah.

source: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.
reference: Meuneu‘en nyoe meunurôt bak Prang Fallujah Keduwa, prang juah antara kapilah Amerika ngön Irak.
hypothesis: Game nyan didasarkan bak Pertempuran Fallujah keudua, saboh pertempuran keujam antara angkatan Amerika ngen Irak.

source: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.
reference: ACMA teumée cit bahwa bahpih video nyan geupeuleumah bak Internet, Big Brother hana meulanggéh qanun sensor konten online sabab media hana geukeubah i situs web Big Brother.
hypothesis: ACMA cit jiteupeu bahwa bahpi video nyan ji-stream bak internet, Big Brother hana ji-ceurlang undang-undang sensor konten online kareuna media nyan hana ji-stores bak situs web Big Brother.

source: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.
reference: Qanun Layanan Peunyiaran geuatôe regulasi konten Internet, teutapih mangat geusangka sebagöe konten Internet, konten nyan suwah seucara fisik na bak server.
hypothesis: Undang-undang Layanan Penyiaran dipeuteuntée keu peraturan konten Internet, namun untuk dianggap konten Internet, nyan harus secara fisik tinggai di saboh server.

source: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.
reference: Keudutaan Rayéuk Ameurika Seurikat nyang meuteumpat i Nairobi, Kenya ka geupeuteubit peuringatan bahwa "ekstremis nibak Somalia" geurancang keu gupeuleheuh geuseureubu bôm peumatée dröe i Kenya ngôn Ethiopia.
hypothesis: Kedutaan Amerika Serikat nyang na di Nairobi, Kenya ka jipeuteubiet peringatan bahwa "ekstremis dari Somalia" ka jikeuneuk peutaloe serangan bom bunuh diri di Kenya ngon Ethiopia.

source: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.
reference: AS kheun ka teurimông informasi nibak muasai nyang geusöm nyang seucara meuteuntèe geubrithèe ngôn pembôm pumatée dröe keu geupeubeureutôh "landmark jithèe" di Ethiopia ngôn Kenya.
hypothesis: AS kheun awak nyan ka geuteurimong informasi dari sumber nyang hana diungkapkan yang secara khusus menyebutkan penggunaan bom bunuh diri untuk akan meledak "tanda-tanda penting" di Ethiopia ngon Kenya.

source: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.
reference: Trép that sigohlöm The Daily Show ngôn The Colbert Report, Heck ngôn Johnson meubayang saböh publikasi nyang geupeuparodi haba—ngônpeulaporan haba—watèe awaknyan mantöng mahasiswa i UW bak thôn 1988.
hypothesis: Seulama sigohlom The Daily Show ngen The Colbert Report, Heck ngon Johnson geu bayangkan saboh publikasi yeng akan parodi berita ngen laporan berita wate awak nyan mahasiswa di UW bak thon 1988.

source: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.
reference: Mulaphôn, The Onion ka jeut keu keurajeun parodi haba nyang hakiki, deungôn edisi cetak, situs web nyang lagak 5.000.000 pengunjông ceudahbak buleuën Oktober, iklan dröe, jaringan haba 24 jeum, podcast, ngônbarô-barô nyôe geupeutubiet atlas dônya nyang geukheun Our Dumb World.
hypothesis: Sejak awai jih, The Onion ka jeut keu saboh kekaisaran berita parodi yang nyata, deungen edisi cetak, saboh situs web yang menarik 5.000.000 pengunjung unik bak buleun Oktober, iklan pribadi, jaringan berita 24 jam, podcast, ngen atlas donya nyang baro diluncurkan nyang geukheun Our Dumb World.

source: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).
reference: Al Gore ngôn Jenderal Tommy Franks deungôn geumayeum geuratôh haba phôn galak awaknyan (Gore's nakeuh watèe The Onion geupeulapor bahwa jih ngônTipper meujimak paléng get lam udép awak nyan ‘oh lheuh jih talôe i Electoral College thôn 2000).
hypothesis: Al Gore ngen Jenderal Tommy Franks secara acak-acak meucaruet bak judul-judul favorit jih (Gore na watee The Onion geu lapor bahwa jih ngon Tipper na hubungan seks nyang paleng get lam udeb jih lheuh taloe Electoral College thon 2000 jih).

source: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.
reference: Lée nibak penulèh awaknyan ka bri teurakah rayéuk bak piasan parodi haba Jon Stewart ngônStephen Colbert.
hypothesis: Le ureueng tuléh jih ka le that peungaroh bak acara berita parodi Jon Stewart ngon Stephen Colbert.

source: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.
reference: Acara artistik nyôe nakeuh cit bahgian nibak kampanye lé Balèe Kuta Bucharest nyang meuoseuha geupeutubiet löm citra ibukuta Rumania sebagöe kuta metropolitan nyang kreatif ngônpeunôh wareuna.
hypothesis: Acara seni nyan cit merupakan bagian dari kampanye oleh Balai Kota Bucharest yang meuhajat untuk meupeutrang lom citra ibu kota Rumania seubagoe metropolis kreatif dan berwarna.

source: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.
reference: Kuta nyôe keu neuk jeut keu nyang phôn i Iée rupa teunggara nyang jeut keu pöe rumôh CowParade, acara seuni publik palèng rayéuk i dônya, antara buleuèn Juni ngônAgustus thôn nyôe.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe akan jeut keu nyang phon di Eropa tenggara keu tuan rumah CowParade, acara seni publik nyang paleng rayek di donya, antara Juni ngen Agustus thon nyoe.

source: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.
reference: Maklumat uröe nyôe geupeupanyang komitmen Poemeurentah nyang geupeugöt bak buleuën Maret thôn nyôe geubi pèng keu tamah geureuböng.
hypothesis: Pengumuman uroë nyoë cit geupeutamah komitmen peumeurintah nyang geupeugot bak buleuen Maret thôn nyoë keu geubimbéng karung-karung tambahan.

source: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.
reference: Tamah 300 jeut keu mandum 1.300 geureuböng nyang ka geupereulèe keu peukureuëng arat.
hypothesis: 300 teuk jeut keu total 1.300 geuritan yeng akan didapat untuk meringankan keusisopan.

source: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.
reference: Christopher Garcia, juru bicara Deupartemen Kepulisian Los Angeles, kheun teusangka peulaku aneu' agam teungôh geuparéksa sabab tamông hana idin nibak vandalisme.
hypothesis: Christopher Garcia, sidroe juru bicara Dinas Polisi Los Angeles, geupeugah bahwa ureung agam nyang diduga meusalah nyan dipeureksa karena melanggar dan bukan vandalisme.

source: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".
reference: Tanda nyan hana geureulöh seucara fisik; modifikasi geupubuët deungôn geu ngui tika itam geupeungui tanda damée ngôn atée keu geupeuubah abeujad "O" jeut keu abeujad ubit "e".
hypothesis: Tanda nyan hana rusak secara fisik; modifikasi nyan dipeuget deungen pakei tarpaulin itam yang di hiasan deungen tanda damai ngen hati untuk meu ubah "O" untuk baca huruf kecil "e".

source: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
reference: Pasang mirah geuseubab lé konsentrasi Karenia Brevis nyang leubèh reuyéuk nibak biyasajih, organism la'ôt meusèl saböh tök nyang meudali seucara alami.
hypothesis: Gelombang mirah disebabkan le konsentrasi yeng lubeh dari normal dari Karenia brevis, organisme laot sel tunggal nyang terjadi secara alami.

source: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
reference: Faktor alam jeuet meuköh-köh keu geupeuhasée keuadaan nyang ideal, nyang geupeumungkén alga nyôe ji'ék jumlahjih seucara dramatis.
hypothesis: Faktor alam jeut meumilang untuk menghasilkan kondisi yang ideal, yang memungkinkan alga nyo untuk meningkat jumlah jih secara dramatis.

source: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
reference: Alga nyoe geupeuhasée racôn saraf nyang jeuet geupeulumpuh saraf bak manusiya seureuta eungkôt.
hypothesis: Alga nyan jipeuhase neurotoksin nyang jeut meuceulaka saraf bak manusia dan eungkot.

source: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
reference: Eungkôt kayém matée sabab konsentrasi racôn nyang lée bak ië dilèe.
hypothesis: Eungkot seureng mate kareuna konsentrasi toksin nyang rayek lam ie.

source: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
reference: Manusiya jeuet jipeungarôh deungôn peulheuh nafah nyang keunông ië nyang jiba u udara lé angén ngôn geulumbang.
hypothesis: Manusia jeut dipengaruhi leupie ji ambek ie nyang keunong u udara le angén ngen ombak.

source: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .
reference: Bak punca jih, Siklön Tropis Gonu, geubôh nan khut deungôn saböh keureutaih ôn palém lam basa Maladewa, trôek bagah angèn 240 kilometèe peur jeum (149 mil peur jeum).
hypothesis: Bak puncak jih, Siklon tropis Gonu, yang dinamakan untuk saboh kantong daun sawit lam basa Maladewa, meuhase angén nyang lestari 240 kilometer seureutoh (149 mil seureutoh).

source: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.
reference: Bak awai uröe nyôe, bagah angèn lingka 83 km/jeum, ngôngeukira teuma keu neuk sabé meuleumôh.
hypothesis: Phon awai uroe nyoe, angén na kira-kira 83 km/jam, dan diperkirakan akan seumaken meukureueng.

source: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.
reference: Bak uröe Rabu, Asosiasi Böhla Baskèt Nasional Amerika Seurikat (NBA) geupeutanggôh musém böhla baskèt professionaljih sabab takôt geuh keu COVID-19.
hypothesis: Bak uroe Rabu, Asosiasi Basketbol Nasional Amerika Serikat (NBA) geupeugadôh musém basket profesional jih kareuna seudeh deungen COVID-19.

source: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.
reference: Keuputusan NBA nyan geupeuseutöt awak nyang meu‘en Utah Jazz nyang positif meujangkét virus COVID-19.
hypothesis: Keuputosan NBA lheuh sidroe pemain Utah Jazz diuji positif untuk virus COVID-19.

source: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.
reference: Meunurôt fosil nyôe, nyang meumakna beureutôh trèp leubèh awai nibak nyang geukira lé dali molekuler.
hypothesis: "Berdasarkan fosil nyoe, nyan berarti pemisahan nyan leubeh awai daripada yang diantisipasi oleh bukti molekuler.

source: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.
reference: "Nyang meumakna bandum suwah geupulang," jikheun lé peuneliti i Rift Valley Research Service i Ethiopia ngônrakan ureuëng teumuléh studi, Berhane Asfaw.
hypothesis: Nyan ateuh mandum nyan harus dipeuriwang lom", kata peneliti di Rift Valley Research Service di Ethiopia dan co-author studi nyan, Berhane Asfaw.

source: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.
reference: Sampöe jinôe, AOL kameudaya geupeugrak ngôngeupeumaju pasai IM deungôn bagahjih keudröe, sabab geungui jih nyang luwah i Amerika Seurikat.
hypothesis: Sampoe jinoe, AOL ka meuhase ji peugot dan ji peugöt pasai IM bak laju jih keudroe, kareuna penggunaan jih luah di Amerika Serikat.

source: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.
reference: Deungôn peungaturan nyôe, keubebasan nyôe mungkén meuakhée.
hypothesis: Deungon peundirian nyan, keumeurdehkaan nyan jeuet keuneulheueh.

source: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.
reference: Jumlah ureuëng ngui Yahoo! ngôn meusapat layanan Microsoft keu neuk lawan jumlah peulanggan AOL.
hypothesis: Jeumeulah ureuëng ngui jasa Yahoo! ngen Microsoft digabungkan akan bersaing ngen jeumeulah pelanggan AOL.

source: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.
reference: Bank Northern Rock ka geunasionalisasi bak thôn 2008 geupeuseutot bahwa peurusahaan nyan ka teurimöng sapue kheun darurat nibak pöemeurintah Inggréh.
hypothesis: Bank Northern Rock ka di nasionalisasikan bak thon 2008 lheuh diungkap bahwa perusahaan nyan ka geuteurimong dukungan darurat dari Pemerintah Britania Raya.

source: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.
reference: Northern Rock peureulee sapue kheun sabab keunong jih lawet krisis subprime mortgage bak thôn 2007.
hypothesis: Northern Rock ka peureulée dukungan kareuna eksposur jih bak masa krisis hipotek subprime bak thon 2007.

source: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.
reference: Tawaran Virgin Group ata Sir Richard Branson keu bank geutulak sigohlom bank geunasionalisasi.
hypothesis: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group na tawaran untuk bank ditolak seugolom bank nyan dipeukan.

source: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).
reference: Bak thôn 2010, watèe geunasionalisasi, bank jalan raya jinoe Northern Rock plc geuaséng nibak 'bank brok', Northern Rock (Manajemen Aset).
hypothesis: Bak thon 2010, seudangkan ditasionalisasi, bank jalan raya saat nyoe Northern Rock plc teupisah dari bank bad, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

source: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.
reference: Virgin hanya geupeubloe ‘bank nyang get’ di Northern Rock, kon peurusahaan manajemen aset.
hypothesis: Virgin ka bloe bloe bloe bank good  di Northern Rock, hana bloe perusahaan manajemen aset.

source: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.
reference: Nyoe geuyakin seubagoe keulimöng goe jih lam seujarah ureuëng-ureuëng geutilék peu nyang teunyata nakeuh material Mars nyang geupeuteuntèeteuntèe seucara kimiawi nyang rhöt u Bumoe.
hypothesis: Nyo diyakini seubab kali keu limong lam seujarah bahwa ureung ka ji amati peue nyang ternyata jeut keu bahan Martian yang dikonfirmasi secara kimia rhot u bumoe.

source: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.
reference: Nibak lingka 24.000 metèorit nyang meutupeue rhôt u Bumoe, seulingka 34 sagai nyang ka geuverifikasi meuasai Mars.
hypothesis: Nibak kira-kira 24.000 meteorit yang diteupeu ka rhot u bumoe, hanya kira-kira 34 nyang ka diverifikasi bahwa jih berasal dari Mars.

source: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.
reference: Limöng blah bate nyoe teupaot paot ngôn ujeuen meteorit Juli nyang ka leupah.
hypothesis: Limong limong blah batée nyoe geupeutrok bak ujeuen meteorit buleun Juli.

source: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.
reference: Ladom batèe, nyang that langka di Bumoe, geupeubloe phôn nibak US$11.000 sampöe $22.500 per ôn, lingka siplôh goe lipat yum meuh.
hypothesis: Padum-padum aneuk batée, yang sangat langka di bumoe, dipeubloe dari US $ 11.000 sampoe US $ 22.500 per ons, yang kira-kira siploh kali leubeh le dari biaya méuh.

source: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.
reference: Oh lheuh meulet, Keselowski teutap jeut keu cheh Kejuaraan ureuëng balap deungôn 2.250 poin.
hypothesis: lheuh balapan, Keselowski tetap pemimpin Juara Pembalap deungon 2.250 poin.

source: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.
reference: Talô tujoh poin, Johnson na lam posisi keuduwa deungôn 2.243.
hypothesis: Tujoh poin di likot, Johnson keudua deungon 2.243.

source: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.
reference: Bak posisi kelhèe, Hamlin talô duwa plôh poin, teutapih meunang limöng poin nibak Bowyer. Kahne ngôn Truex, Jr. maséng-maséng na bak posisi keulimöng ngôn keunam deungôn 2.220 dan 2.207 poin.
hypothesis: Bak teumpat keu lhee, Hamlin na dua ploh poin di likot, teuma limong poin leubeh awai nibak Bowyer. Kahne dan Truex, Jr. na urutan keulimong dan nam deungon 2,220 dan 2,207 poin.

source: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.
reference: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, ngön Harvick geupeuleungkap posisi siplôh rayek keu Kejuaraan Pembalap ngön peuet meulét meusisa bak musémnyoe.
hypothesis: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, dan Harvick dipeupungkas posisi siploh teratas untuk Kejuaraan Pembalap deungen peut bala nyang mantong na di musim nyoe.

reference: Di London, leubeh kureueng 200 ureueng protes di luwa kanto mat hak cipta utama.
hypothesis: Di London, kira-kira 200 ureung protes di luwa beberapa kantor pemegang hak cipta utama.

source: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.
reference: Sibuleuen nyang ka leupah, na protes rayek di Polandia watee nanggroe nyan geutanda tangan ACTA, nyang peuseubab peumeurintah Polandia jipeuputoh han meuratifikasi perjanjian nyan, keu saat nyoe.
hypothesis: Buleuen nyang ka lheueh, na protes rayek di Polandia wate nanggroe nyan menandatangani ACTA, nyang ka meuakibat pemerintah Polandia hana geu ratifikasi perjanjian nyan, untuk saat nyoe.

source: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.
reference: Latvia ngon Slovakia ka geutunda proses meugabong deungon ACTA.
hypothesis: Latvia ngon Slowakia kalinyoe ka jipeuhase masa lam proses meupeutamong lam ACTA.

source: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.
reference: Peumbebasan hiweuen ngön Royal Society for the Prev Ention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) geusurak lom wajeb pasang kamera CCTV bak bandum rumoh sie hiweuen Australi.
hypothesis: Animal Liberation dan Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) lom geulakée keu pemasangan kamera CCTV wajib di mandum pembantai Australia.

source: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.
reference: Keupala Inspektur RSPCA New South Wales David O'Shannessy geukheun keu ABC bahwa peungawasan ngön inspeksi rumoh sie hiweuen suawahjeut keu peukara biyasa i Australi.
hypothesis: Inspektur kepala RSPCA New South Wales David O'Shannessy geupeugah bak ABC bahwa pengawasan ngen inspeksi bak teumpat pembantai harus biasa di Australia.

source: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."
reference: "CCTV bit-bit ineuk kirem sinyal nyang teuga keu ureueng-ureueng nyang keurija deungön meulatang bahwa keuseujahteuraan awak nyan nakeuh prioritas nyang paléng rayeuk."
hypothesis: "C CCTV pasti akan mengirimkan sinyal kuat keu ureung nyang bekerja deungen binatang bahwa kesejahteraan awak nyan adalah prioritas utô".

source: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.
reference: Peuta geumpa bansigom donya dari Survei Geologi Amerika Seurikat jipeutunyok hana geumpa nibak Islandia si aleuhat seugohlom jih.
hypothesis: United States Geological Survey peta geumpa bumoe internasional hana geutunyok geumpa bumoe di Islandia bak minggu sigohlom nyan.

source: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.
reference: Kanto meteorologi Islandia jipeuthee cit hana aktivitah gempa bumoe nibak daerah Hekla lam 48 jeum teuakhee.
hypothesis: Kantor Meteorologi Islandia cit melaporkan hana aktivitas geumpa bumoe di wilayah Hekla lam 48 jam nyang ka lheueh.

source: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.
reference: Aktivitah geumpa jai nyang meuubah fase nyan teujadi nibak tanggai 10 Maret nibak bineh timu laot pucok kawah gunong meuapui.
hypothesis: Aktifitas geumpa bumoe yang signifikan yeng mengakibatkan perubahan fase ka terjadi bak 10 Maret di sisi utara timu caldera puncak gunung berapi.

source: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.
reference: Awan seupot nyang hana meusangkot deungon aktivitah vulkanik ka jipeuthee di lapeh phon gunong.
hypothesis: Awan itam nyang hana meuhubongan deungen aktivitas vulkanik dipeugah bak gaki gunong nyan.

source: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
reference: Awan nyan jeut meupeugot mumang peukeuh beureutoh nyan ka teujadi.
hypothesis: Awan-awan nyan geupeutrang potensi kebingungan tentang peu kheueh erupsi seucara nyata ka teujadi.

source: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.
reference: Luno na meu 120–160 mete kubik bahan bakar watèe mogok ngön angèn teuga seureuta riyeuk itulak luno keu peubicah geulumbang.
hypothesis: Luno na 120 160 meter kubik bahan bakar di ateueh awak nyan wate nyan rusak dan angén rayek dan ombak mendorong jih u dalam krueng.

source: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.
reference: Helikopter geupeuseulamat duwa blah droe awak kapai ngön saboh-sabohjih ceudra nakeuh idoeng nyangpatah.
hypothesis: Helikopter dipeuseulamat dua blah anggota awak awak dan luka jih saboh hidung patah.

source: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.
reference: Kapai deungön panyang 100 meter nyan teungoh lam peurjalanan keu coek muwatan pupokjih nyang biyasa ngön awaijih awak peujabat ka watèe kapai nyan jeut geupeuro muwatan.
hypothesis: Kapal 100 meter nyan teungoh jakcok kargo pupuk biasa jih dan awai peugawée-peugawée teumakot kapal nyan jeut jipeutron kargo.

source: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.
reference: Amandemen nyang geuusong ka geuteurimoeng lé banduwa majeulis bak thôn 2011.
hypothesis: Proposal amandemen nyan kaleuh dipeuseuleusoe le dua dewan bak thon 2011.

source: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.
reference: Peurubahan geupubuet bak sidang legislatif nyoe watèe kalimat keuduwa awai geuhapoh lé DPR ngön dudoe geupeusah lam beuntuk saban lé Seunat Seunanyan.
hypothesis: Perubahan geupeuget di sesi legislatif nyoë wate kalimat keudua dihapus phon-phon that lé DPR dan lheuh nyan dihapus lam bentuk nyang saban le Senat Buleuen Duwa.

source: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.
reference: Hana wasé hukôman keduwa, nyang geu usong keu geutham seurikat ureueng biyasa seusama jeuneh, mungkén jeut peuhah pinto keu seurikat ureueng biyasa i masa ukeu.
hypothesis: Kegagalan kalimat nyang keudua, nyang meukeusut keu meuklarang pergaulan sipil sesama jenis, mungken jeut ji peuhah pintoe keu pergaulan sipil di masa ukeu.

source: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.
reference: Lheuh proses nyan, HJR-3 geu neuk tilek lom lé legislatif nyang teupileh lheuhjih gèt thôn 2015 atawa 2016 keu teutap lam proses.
hypothesis: Seulaén proses nyan, HJR-3 akan di peuget ulang le anggota legislatif nyang geupiléh lom bak thon 2015 atawa 2016 untuk teutab lam proses.

source: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.
reference: Prestasi Vautier luwa peunyutradaraan teumasok meutheun pajoh bu bak thôn 1973 geulawan peu nyang gobnyan pandang sebagoe sensor politek.
hypothesis: Prestasi Vautier diluwa sutradara termasuk mogok deuk bak thon 1973 melawan peue nyang geu pandang sebagai sensur politik.

source: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.
reference: Hukôm Peurancih geuubah. Aktivismejih iwo lom bak umu 15 thôn watèe gobnyan meusapat deungön Peurlawanan Peurancih nibak trep Prang Dônya II.
hypothesis: Undang-undang Perancis ka ji ubah. Aktivisme jih ka geuwoe bak umu 15 thon wate jih geu ikot Resistance Prancis seulama Perang Donya II.

source: He documented himself in a 1998 book.
reference: Gobnyan geukubah peuninggai droe geuh lam saboh buku thôn 1998.
hypothesis: Jih mendokumentasikan droe jih lam saboh kitab thon 1998.

source: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.
reference: Bak 1960-an gobnyan geuwo u Aljazair nyang barô meurdeka keu geupeurunoe peunyutradaraan pilem.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1960-an gobnyan geuwoe u Aljazair yang barojih merdeka keu geu peurunoe sutradara filem.

source: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.
reference: Judoka Jeupang Hitoshi Saito, nyang meunang duwa meundali meuh Olimpiade, matèe bak umu 54 thôn.
hypothesis: Judoka Jepang Hitoshi Saito, nyang meunang dua medali emas Olimpiade, ka meuninggai donya bak umu 54 thon.

source: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
reference: Musabab meuninggai geuumum nakeuh sabab kanker saluran eumpeudu intrahepatik.
hypothesis: Penyebab meuninggai nyan diumumkan seubab kanker saluran empedu intrahepatic.

source: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.
reference: Gobnyan meuninggai i Osaka bak uroe Seulasa.
hypothesis: Jih meuninggai di Osaka bak uroe Selasa.

source: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.
reference: Silaén jawara nyang ka leupah Olympic and World, Saito nakeuh peutua komite peulatihan All Japan Judo Federation bak watèe meuninggaijih.
hypothesis: Seulaen dumna juara Olimpiade ngen Donya, Saito nakeuh ketua komite pelatihan Federasi Judo Seluruh Jepang bak watèe gobnyan meuninggai donya.

source: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.
reference: Seutidakjih 100 droe ureueng ka teuka lam pesta nyan, keu piyasan milad phôn pasangan nyang peurnikahanjih geupubuet thôn nyang ka leupah.
hypothesis: Sekurang-kurangnya 100 droeneuh ka meusapat bak pesta nyan, untuk meriahkan ulang thon phon saboh pasangan nyang meukawen thon nyang ka lheueh.

source: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.
reference: Acara milad reusmi geupeujadôi watèe uroe ukeu, geukheun lé awak peujabat.
hypothesis: Acara ulang tahun formal dijadwalkan untuk saboh tanggai seulanjut jih, kheun peugawée.

source: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.
reference: Pasangan nyan kawén i Texas sithôn nyang ka leupah ngön teuka u Buffalo keu geupeuraya deungön rakan ngön keurabat.
hypothesis: Pasangan nyan ka meukawen di Texas sithon nyang ka lheueh dan teuka u Buffalo keu ji khanuri ngon rakan ngon waréh kawöm.

source: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.
reference: Lakoe meuumu 30 thôn, nyang lahé i Buffalo, nakeuh salah saboh nibak peuet ureueng nyang matèe lam peunembakannyan, tapi peurumoeh gobnyan hana lut.
hypothesis: lakoe 30 thon, nyang lahé di Buffalo, adalah salah saboh dari peuet droe nyang meuninggai bak penembakan, teutapi peurumoh jih hana luka.

source: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.
reference: Karno nakeuh gurèe basa Inggreh meusyeuhu bahpih kontroversial nyang geupeurunoe bak Modern Education ngön King's Glory nyang geupateh na 9.000 aneuk sikula bak punca karirjih.
hypothesis: Karno nakeuh sidroe guru bahasa Inggréh nyang meusyeuhu tapi kontroversial nyang geupeurunoe di bawah Modern Education dan King's Glory nyang geu klaim na 9.000 mahasiswa bak puncak karir jih.

source: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.
reference: Lam tulesanjih gobnyan geungui kalimah-kalimah nyang lé ladom ureueng tuha geusangka gasa, ngön gobnyan geubrithèe ngui kalimah-kalimah kutolam glah.
hypothesis: Dalam catatan jih jih jih geu pakek kata-kata nyang na ureung tuha geu anggap kasar, dan geu lapor geu pakek penghinaan di kelas.

source: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.
reference: Peundidekan Modern geutudoh gobnyan peugöt iklan rayeukbak bus hana idin ngön meusulet deungön kheun bahwa gobnyan nakeuh peutua tutor basa Inggreh.
hypothesis: Modern Education geu tudoh jih geu cetak iklan rayek bak bis tanpa izin dan geuboh ngen geu peugah bahwa jih adalah guru bahasa Inggris utama.

source: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.
reference: Gobnyan ka geutudoh sit sigohlomnyan geupubuet peulanggaran hak cipta, tapi hana geudakwa.
hypothesis: Jih cit kaleuh ditudoh keu pelanggaran hak cipta, teutapi hana ditudoh.

source: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'
reference: Sidroe siswa awai geukheuen bahwa gobnyan 'geungui basa gaul lam glah, geupeurunoe keuteurampilan meukeuncan lam catatan, ngön lagèe rakan aneuk sikula.'
hypothesis: Sidroe mahasiswa awai geupeugah bahwa jih nyan 'jipeuguna slang di kelas, jipeurunoe cara meupeurumpok lam catatan, dan jih nyan saban ngon rakan murid-murit jih.'

source: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.
reference: Lawét lhèe dekade tseuneulheuh, bahpih seucara reusmi teutap jeut keu nanggroe komunis, Cina ka geupeumaju ekonomi pasai.
hypothesis: Seulama lhee ploh thon nyang ka lheuh, meskipun secara resmi tetap jeut keu saboh negara komunis, Cina ka geupeugöt ekonomi pasai.

source: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.
reference: Reformasi ekonomi phôn geupubuet imiyub keupeumimpinan Deng Xiaoping.
hypothesis: Reformasi ekonomi phon geupeuget di bawah pimpinan Deng Xiaoping.

source: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.
reference: Mulaphôn nyan, ukoran ekonomi Cina ka timoh 90 goe lipat.
hypothesis: Sejak nyan, ukuran ekonomi China ka meutamah 90 kali lipat.

source: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.
reference: Nyang keu phôn, thôn nyang ka leupah Cina ekspor leubèh lë moto nibak Jeurman ngön leubèh nibak Amèrika Seurikat sebagoe pasai paléng rayeuk keu industri nyoe.
hypothesis: Keu phon that, thon nyang ka lheueh Cina geueksport leubeh le mobil nibak Jerman dan ji lham Amerika Serikat seubagai pasar paleng rayek keu industri nyoe.

source: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.
reference: PDB Cina jeut leubèh rayeuk nibak Amèrika Seurikat lam duwa dekade.
hypothesis: PDB China mungken leubeh rayek nibak Amerika Serikat lam dua dekade.

source: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Badé Tropis Danielle, badé meunan kepeuet musem badé Atlantik 2010, ka meupeugöt i Samudra Atlantik timu.
hypothesis: Badai tropis Danielle, ribut keu peuet di musim badai Atlantik 2010, ka terbentuk di Laôt Atlantik timu.

source: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).
reference: Badé, nyang teuka silingka 3.000 mil nibak Miami, Florida, na keuceupatan angèn maksimum 40 mph (64 kph).
hypothesis: Badai nyan, yang terletak kira-kira 3.000 mil dari Miami, Florida, na angén maksimum dipeuteun 40 mph (64 km/h).

source: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.
reference: Awak ilmuwan i Pusat Badé Nasional geupeukira bahwa Danielle keu neuk leubèh teuga jeut keu badé bak uroe Rabu.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan di Pusat Badai Nasional geu prediksi bahwa Danielle akan meutamah teuga jeut keu ribut bak uroe Rabu.

source: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.
reference: Sabab badé jeuoh nibak darat, manteng payah keu geupeunyum potensi meu akibat u Amèrika Seurikat atawa Karibia.
hypothesis: Kareuna ribut nyan jiôh dari darat, mantong sulet untuk teuntang dampak potensial keu Amerika Serikat atau Karibia.

source: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.
reference: Lahé di ibukuta Kroasia, Zagreb, Bobek meurumpok keutenaran watèe meu’èn keu Partizan Belgrade.
hypothesis: Bobek lahé di Zagreb, nanggroë Kroasia, Bobek geuteumeugah wate geumeulakee bak Partizan Belgrade.

source: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.
reference: Gobnyan meugabong deungön awaknyan bak thôn 1945 ngön tinggai sampoe thôn 1958.
hypothesis: Jih jeut keu anggota jih bak thon 1945 dan tinggai sampoe 1958.

source: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.
reference: Oh watèe gobnyan deungön tim, gobnyan geupeuhasé 403 gol lam 468 meuneu’èn.
hypothesis: Seulama masa jih ngon tim nyan, jih mencetak 403 gol dalam 468 penampilan.

source: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.
reference: Hana ureueng meu’èn laén nyang leumah leubèh lë atawa geupeuhasé leubèh lë gol keu klub selaén Bobek.
hypothesis: Hana meusidroe pih nyang ka geupeuleumah droe leubeh le atawa geu gol keu klub nyan nibak Bobek.

source: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.
reference: Bak thôn 1995 gobnyan teupileh sebagoe ureueng meu’èn paléng gèt lam seujarah Partizan.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1995 jih geu piléh sebagoe pemain paleng get lam seujarah Partizan.

source: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.
reference: Peurayaan geupeuphôn deungön piasan khusuih lé grup meuceuhu dônya Cirque du Soleil.
hypothesis: Peurayaan dimulai deungen acara khas deungen grup Cirque du Soleil nyang meusyeuhu bansigom donya.

source: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.
reference: Geuikot lé Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, band Janissary, ngön penyanyi Fatih Erkoç ngön Müslüm Gürses.
hypothesis: Geuturot lé Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, saboh band Janissary, ngen penyanyi Fatih Erkoç ngon Müslüm Gürses.

source: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.
reference: Dudoe Darwis Nyang geuputa-puta ék u ateuh panggong.
hypothesis: Óh lheueh nyan Whirling Dervishes geuék lam panggung.

source: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.
reference: Diva Turki Sezen Aksu meulagu deungön peunyanyi tenor Itali Alessandro Safina ngön peunyanyi Yunani Haris Alexiou.
hypothesis: Diva Turki Sezen Aksu tampil deungen tenor Italia Alessandro Safina ngen penyanyi Yunani Haris Alexiou.

source: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".
reference: Sebagoe ngön peuakhe, grup tari Turki Fire of Anatolia geupeulemah piasan "Troy".
hypothesis: Untuk meuhase, grup tari Turki Fire of Anatolia geupeuget pertunjukan "Troy".

source: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
reference: Peter Lenz, sidroe pembalap motor meuumu 13 thôn, maté lheuh meulibat lam kecelakaan di Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
hypothesis: Peter Lenz, sidroe pembalap motor nyang meu umu 13 thon, ka meuninggai donya lheuh keunong musibah di Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

source: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.
reference: Watèe geupubuet pemanasan, Lenz rhot dari gritan gobnyan, ngön dudoe geupo lé sabé-sabé peumbalap Xavier Zayat.
hypothesis: Wate di lap pemanasan jih, Lenz rhot dari sepeda jih, dan lheuh nyan keunong le rakan balap Xavier Zayat.

source: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.
reference: Gobnyan rijang geuraweut lé staf medis bak lintasan ngön geuba u rumoh sakét di sinan di pat gobnyan dudoe maté.
hypothesis: Jih langsong dijaga le awak medis di jalur dan di angkot u rumah sakit setempat di sinan awak nyan meuninggai donya.

source: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.
reference: Zayat hana meulut lam kecelakaan nyan.
hypothesis: Zayat hana keunong musibah bak musibah nyan.

source: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.
reference: Teukawet ngön situasi keuangan global, Zapatero lanjut deungön kheun bahwa "sistem keuangan nakeuh bagian dari ekonomi, bagian peunteng.
hypothesis: Mengenai situasi keuangan global, Zapatero melanjutkan bahwa "sistem keuangan adalah bagian dari ekonomi, bagian penting.

source: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."
reference: Kamoe keunong krisis keuangan lawét sithôn, nyang na momen paléng akut lam duwa buleuen teurakhe, ngön lôn piké jinoe pasai keuangan mulai puleh."
hypothesis: Geutanyoe na krisis keuangan nyang treb jih sithon, nyang ka na momen jih nyang paleng brat lam dua buleuen nyang ka lheueh, dan ulôn pike jinoe pasar-pasar keuangan ka mulai meubacut pih".

source: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.
reference: Peukan nyang ka leupah, Naked News geupeuumum bahwa awak nyan akan seucara dramatis geupeutingkat mandat basa internasionaljih keu pelaporan haba, deungön lhèe siaran barô.
hypothesis: Lam minggu nyang ka lheueh, Naked News geupeumaklum bahwa nyan akan meutamah brat mandat bahasa internasional jih keu laporan berita, deungen lhee siaran baroe.

source: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
reference: Ka geupeuthèe lam basa Inggreh ngön Jeupang, organisasi global geupeuteubiet program meubasa Spanyol, Itali, ngön Korea, keu televisi, web, ngön perangkat seluler.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng donya nyoë ka ji lapor lam basa Inggreh ngon Jepang, organisasi nyoë ka jipeutrang program-program lam basa Spanyol, Italia, dan Korea, keu televisi, web, dan perangkat seluler.

source: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
reference: Untongjih hana nyang teujadi bak lôn, tapi lôn ngieng peumandangan nyang ye teuh, watèe ureueng-ureueng cuba geupeubeukah tingkap untuk teubiet.
hypothesis: "Ngon mubahgia hana meusapeue pih nyang teujadi ateueh ulôn, teuma ulôn kalon saboh adegan nyang keujam, seudangkan ureuëng-ureuëng ji coba keu jipeurusak tingkap mangat hase jiteubiet.

source: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
reference: Ureueng-ureueng geupeupoh panel deungön keurusi, tapi tingkapjih hana jeut geubeukah.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng nyan jitimpa panel deungon kurusi, teuma tingkap nyan hana hase teupeukah.

source: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
reference: "Salah saboh panel akhejih beukah, ngön awak nyan phôn teubiet rhet tingkapnyan," geukheun lé penyintas Franciszek Kowal.
hypothesis: Salah saboh panel akhe jih patah, dan awak nyan mulai keluar dari tingkap", kata yang selamat Franciszek Kowal.

source: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.
reference: Bintang geupeupancar cahya ngön seuuem sabab energi nyang geuhasé watèe atom hidrogen meugabong (atawa meuhimpon) untuk geupeuhasé unsur nyang leubèh geuhen.
hypothesis: Bintang dipeuteubiet cahaya ngen panas kareuna energi nyang dipeuget wate atom hidrogen dipeusatu (atau dipeusatu) meusapat untuk membentuk elemen yeng leubeh brat.

source: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.
reference: Awak ilmuwan teungoh keurija keu peugöt reaktor nyang jeut geupeuhasé energi deungön cara nyang sama.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan teungoh meukeureuja keu jipeugöt reaktor nyang jeut jipeuget energi bak cara nyang saban.

source: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.
reference: Tapi, nyoe nakeuh masalah nyang that sulet keu geuseuleuso ngön akan pajoh watèe meuthôn-thôn sigohlom geutanyoe ngieng reaktor fusi nyang meuguna geubangön.
hypothesis: Namun, nyoe nakeuh saboh masalah nyang payah that untuk dipeulheuh dan akan treb that ta peugot reaktor fusi nyang meuguna.

source: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.
reference: Jarom baja meuapong di ateuh ie sabab tegangan permukaan.
hypothesis: jarum baja meulayang di ateueh ie kareuna tegangan permukaan.

source: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.
reference: Tegangan permukaan na sabab molekul ie di permukaan ie leubèh meutarek sabé kedroe-droejih nibak molekul udara di ateuhjih.
hypothesis: Ketegangan permukaan terjadi kareuna molekul ie di permukaan ie leubeh that tertarik sidroe ngon nyang laen daripada molekul udara di ateuh awak nyan.

source: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.
reference: Molekul ie peugöt kulet nyang hana teungieng di permukaan ie nyang geupeumungkén benda-benda lagèe jarom meuapong di ateuh air.
hypothesis: Molekul ie jipeuget saboh kulét nyang hana deuh bak permukaan ie nyang meupeugadeh hal-hal lagee jarum untuk meutabu di ateueh ie.

source: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.
reference: Bilah bak seluncur eh modern na bineh ganda deungön lueng cekung di antarajih. Banduwa bineh nyan geupeumungkén reugam eh deungön leubèh gèt, bahkan watèe singet.
hypothesis: Blade bak skate es modern na tepi dua kali ngen lueng kongkaf di antara jih.

source: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.
reference: Sabab bagian yub bilah ceukok bacut, watèe bilah singet u saboh sisi atawa sisi laénjih, tepi nyang teupeh deungön eh ceukok sit.
hypothesis: Kareuna bagian miyueb peunyaket nyan bacut melengkung, kareuna peunyaket nyan meulinteung bak saboh pihak atawa nyang laen, pinggiran nyang na lam kontak deungen es pih melengkung.

source: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
reference: Nyoe geupeusabab awak nyang meuen seluncur meuwet. Meunyô seluncur singet u uneun, awak nyang meuen seluncur meuwet u uneun, meunyô seluncur singet u wie, awak nyang meuen seluncur meuwet u wie.
hypothesis: Nyo meuakibat skater meuguncang. Meunyoe skater meuguncang u blah uneuen, skater meuguncang u blah uneuen, jika skater meuguncang u blah wie, skater meuguncang u blah wie.

source: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
reference: Keu balek u tingkat energi sigohlomnyan, awak nyan haroih geupeuboih energi ekstra nyang geuteumèe dari cahya.
hypothesis: Untuk geuwoe bak tingkat energi awai jih, awak nyan harus geupeugadoh energi tambahan nyang geuteurimong dari trang.

source: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
reference: Awak nyan geupubuet nyoe deungön geupeupancar partikel ubit cahya nyang geukheun "foton".
hypothesis: Nyo ji peubuet deungen jipeutron partikel cahaya ubit nyang jiboh nan "foton".

source: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
reference: Awak ilmuwan geukheuen proses nyoe "emisi radiasi meustimulasi" sabab atom geurangsang lé cahya trang, nyang geupeusabab emisi foton cahya, ngön cahya nakeuh jeuneh radiasi.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan geukheun proses nyoe "pemicu emisi radiasi" kareuna atom-atom dipeugöt le cahya trang, yang menyebabkan emisi foton cahaya, dan cahaya adalah saboh jenis radiasi.

source: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
reference: Gamba teuma meupeutunyok atom geupeupancar foton. Teuntèe, lam kenyataan foton jeuoh leubèh ubit nibak nyang na lam gamba.
hypothesis: Gambar ukeu na peuleumah atom nyang peulheueh foton. Teutapi, bak nyata foton leubeh ubit nibak nyang na di gamba nyan.

source: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
reference: Foton bahkan leubèh ubit nibak bahan penyusun atom!
hypothesis: Foton leubeh ubit nibak zat nyang peuget atom!

source: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.
reference: Lheuh meureutoih jeum meuoperasi, filamen lam bohlam akhejih meutot ngön bohlam hana meufungsi lom.
hypothesis: Lheuh ratusan jam operasi filament lam bohlam akhe jih terbakar dan bohlam hana berfungsi le.

source: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.
reference: Bola panyot peureulèe geugantoe. Peureulèe kehati-hatian lam geupeuganto bola panyot.
hypothesis: Lam lampunya nyan, lampunya nyan peureulée teugantoe. Keu teugantoe lampunya nyan, awak nyan meuseuti teurasa teuliti.

source: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.
reference: Nyang phôn, sakelar keu panyot haroih geupeumaté atawa kabel geusuet.
hypothesis: Phon-phon, saket untuk peungikat lampu harus dipeutamat atawa kabel dipeutron.

source: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.
reference: Hai nyoe sabab leseutirik nyang geupeuiile u soket teumpat bagian logam bohlam geuduek jeut bri gata meusetrom ngön leseutirik nyang brat meunyô gata mat bahagian dalam soket atawa dasar logam bohlam watèe manteng ladom na lam soket.
