hypothesis: Nyo seubab listrik yang mengalir u soket di teumpat bagian logam bohlam nyan duek jeut memberikan shock listrik yang parah jika awak menyentuh bagian dalam soket atau dasar logam bohlam nyan seudangkan jih mantong sebagian di soket.

source: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.
reference: Organ utama dari sistem peredaran darah nakeuh jantong, nyang geupeupumpa darah.
hypothesis: Organ utama sistem sirkulasi adalah jantung, yeng memompa darah.

source: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.
reference: Darah teubiet dari jantong lam pembuluh nyang geukheun arteri ngön balek u jantong lam pembuluh nyang geukheun vena. Pembuluh paléng ubit geukheun kapiler.
hypothesis: Darah geutinggai hati lam tabung nyang geuboh nan arteri dan geuwoe u hati lam tabung nyang geuboh nan urat. tabung nyang paleng ubit geuboh nan kapiler.

source: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
reference: Igoe triceratop kön ônmantöng jeut mamöh tapi nyang paling koeng lagѐe cabeung ngön ukheue jeuet sit.
hypothesis: Gigi triceratops akan mampu menghancurkan bukan hanya daun tapi bahkan cabang dan akar yang sangat keras.

source: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.
reference: Na padum droe ureueng meuéleumѐe geupiké triceratops nyan ipajôh bak sikas, nyang biasa na di jameun Cretaceous.
hypothesis: Padum-padum ilmuwan jipike Triceratops jipajoh cicad, yang merupakan jenis tanaman yang umum di Kretaceus.

source: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.
reference: Bak nyan deuh takalön lagѐe bak kurma ubeut ngön mahkutajih nyang tincu-tincu.
hypothesis: Tanoh-tanoh nyoe deuh lage bak sawit ubit nyang na mahkota ôn nyang tajam dan puntong.

source: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.
reference: Triceratop jeuet sit jingui abah nyang koeng keu jikoh ôn kayѐe nyan seugohlom jipajôh bakjih.
hypothesis: Triceratops jeut dipakek bilek jih yang kuat untuk melepas daun sigohlom geu pajoh bak.

source: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
reference: Ureueng-ureueng meuéleumѐe nyang laén geumuphôm bahwa bak-bak nyan meuracôn sampoe han mungkén dinasourus ipajôh jih, adakpih jinoe beuö ngön meulatang laén lagѐe tiyong (biek dinasourus) jeuet ipajôh ôn atawa boh meuracôn nyan.
hypothesis: Ilmuwan laen meuargumen bahwa tumbuhan nyo sangat beracun jadi hana mungken dinosaurus peue mantong jipajoh jih, meskipun jinoe si lintah dan binatang laen lage papaga (sebuah keturunan dinosaurus) jeut jipajoh daun atau buah beracun.

source: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.
reference: Pakriban keuh gravitasi bumoe lo itarek lôn? Meunyö droeneuh neudöng ateueh lo, geuhöndroeneuh jeuet keu phui nibak Bumoe.
hypothesis: Meunyo awak na di ateueh permukaan Io, awak nyan leubeh ubit nibak awak di ateueh bumoe.

source: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.
reference: Sidroe ureueng nyang geuhön geuh 200 pon (90kg) i Bumoe keuneuk na geuhön sangkira 36 pon (16kg) bak lo. Lheuhnyan gravitasi, teuntѐejih, kureueng itarek droeneuh.
hypothesis: Sidroe droeneuh nyang brat jih 90kg di bumoë na kira-kira 16kg di bumoë. Jadi gravitasi, teutap, leubeh bacut teugrah u ateueh droeneuh.

source: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.
reference: Mata uroe hana krak lagѐe Bumoe nyang jeuet ta döng. Mandum mata uroe geupeugoet nibak gah, apui, ngön plasma.
hypothesis: Mata uroe hana na kerak lagee bumoe nyang jeut awak berdiri bak nyan. Mata uroe nyan mandum terbuat dari gas, apui, dan plasma.

source: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.
reference: Gah jeuet leubeh lipéh watѐe droeneuh neupeujioh pusat mata uroe.
hypothesis: Gas nyan jeut leubeh tipis wate awak jak leubeh jiôh dari pusat Matahari.

source: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".
reference: Blah luwa nyang takalön watѐe ta pandang mata uroe jikheun fotosfer nyan meumakna "bola hu".
hypothesis: Bagian luwa nyang ta kalon watee ta pandang Matahari taboh nan fotosfer, nyang teungui "bola cahaya".

source: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
reference: Sangkira na lhee ribѐe thôn ukeu, bak thôn1610, astronomi Italia Galileo Galilei geungui teleskop keu geutilek bahwasajih Venus na fase, lagѐe buleuen.
hypothesis: Kira-kira lhee reutoh thon lheuh nyan, bak thon 1610, astronom Italia Galileo Galilei geupakek teleskop keu geu amati bahwa Venus na fase, lagee buleuen.

source: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
reference: Fase nyan jeuet sabab saboh sagai sagoe Venus (atawa buleun) nyang ipeukeu Mata Uroe nyang trang. Fase-fase Venus sapeu kheun keu tiori Copernicus bahwasajih planet-planet iputa Mata uroe.
hypothesis: Phases terjadi karena hanya sisi Venus (atau Bulan) yang menghadap Matahari yang tercahaya. Phases Venus mendukung teori Copernicus bahwa planet-planet mengelilingi Matahari.

source: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
reference: Teuma, meupadum thôn ukeu bak thôn 1639, sidroe astronomi Inggreh nanjih Jeremiah Horrocks geutilek transit Venus.
hypothesis: Lheuh nyan, padum thon lheuh nyan, bak thon 1639, sidroe ahli astronomi Inggréh nyang nan jih Jeremiah Horrocks ka geupeurati saboh transit Venus.

source: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.
reference: Inggréh ka geurasa masa damai nyang cukôp panyang lheuëh penaklukan Danelaw.
hypothesis: Inggreh ka jilami periode seujahtra nyang panyang lheuh peumeunang lom dari Danelaw.

source: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.
reference: Tapi, nibak thôn 991 Ethelred dipeuhadap deungön Armada Viking nyang leubéh rayek daripada armada laén sejak Guthrum mat kuasa siabad sigohlomjih.
hypothesis: Namun bak thon 991 Ethelred meuhadapan deungen angkatan prang Viking leubeh rayek dari yang laen seujak Guthrum seulama abad.

source: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.
reference: Armada nyoë ipimpin lé Olaf Tryggvason, ureuëng Norwegia nyang seumangat that geurebôt lom negarajih dari kekuasaan ureuëng Denmark.
hypothesis: Flot nyo dipimpin le Olaf Trygvasson, sidroe Norwegia nyang na ambisi untuk meubalek nanggroe jih dari dominasi Denmark.

source: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.
reference: Lheuëh kemunduran militer nyang awai, Ethelred sepakat ngön persyaratan nyang dipeugot Olaf, nyang balék u Norwegia icuba reubôt keulai kerajaanjih deungön hasé nyang biasa.
hypothesis: Lheuh kemunduran militer awai, Ethelred jeut setuju keu kesepakatan deungen Olaf, nyang geuwoe u Norwegia keu geucuba meukreuh keurajeuen jih deungen sukses campuran.

source: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
reference: Hangeul nyankeuh salah saboh alfabet nyang geusahja geupeugöt lam geumeubasa siuroe-uroe nyang meusyeuhu. Alfabet itumee bak thôn 1444 bak masa keurajeuen Raja Sejong (1418-1450).
hypothesis: Hangeul nakeuh saboh-saboh abjad nyang ka geupeugöt seucara sengaja lam peurènja tieb-tieb uroe. Abjad nyan geupeugöt bak thôn 1444 bak masa keurajeuen Raja Sejong (1418  1450).

source: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.
reference: Raja Sejong nyankeuh raja keupeut nibak Dinasti Joseon ngön nyankeuh salah saboh nyang paléngpaléng jitabék.
hypothesis: Raja Sejong nakeuh raja keu peuet dari Dinasti Joseon dan nakeuh salah saboh nyang paleng rayek.

source: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".
reference: Gobnyan phôn that nan geuh alfabet Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, nyang meumakna “su nyang beutôi keu peutunyok ureueng".
hypothesis: Jih awai jih geuboh nan abjad Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, nyang haroh jih "suara nyang teupat keu ajaran rakyat".

source: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
reference: Hinan na padum-padum boh tiori pakriban basa Sansekerta na. Salah sabohjih nyankeuh migrasi Arya nibak blah barat u India nyang imee basa awaknyan.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum teori tentang cara bahasa Sanskerta teuka. Salah saboh jih nakeuh tentang migrasi Arya dari barat u India nyang geuba bahsa awak nyan ngon awak nyan.

source: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
reference: Sansekerta nyankeuh basa jameun nyang seubandeng deungön basa Laten nyang jingui i Eropa.
hypothesis: Sanskrit nakeuh saboh basa jameun dan saban ngon basa Latin nyang ji peugah di Eropa.

source: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
reference: Buku keu phon that nyang ithei le donya ituleh lam basa Sansekerta. Oh lheueh komplikasi Uphanishad, basa Sansekerta ka li sabab hierarki.
hypothesis: Kitab awai nyang jituri di donya teunuléh lam basa Sanskerta. Óh ka lheueh geupeusapat Upanishads, basa Sanskerta hanco sabab hierarki.

source: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
reference: Sansekerta nyankeuh basa nyang paléng sampoerna ngön kaya, nyang jeut keu asai keu dum basa India nyang ka maju, sama lagѐe basa Laten nakeuh asai keu basa Eropa lagѐe Peurancih ngön Spanyol.
hypothesis: Sanskrit nakeuh basa nyang rayek that kompleks dan kaya, nyang ka jeut keu sumber keu padum boh basa India moderen, lagee bahasa Latin nakeuh sumber keu basa-basa Eropa lage Perancis ngon Spanyol.

source: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.
reference: DeuDeungön abéhjih prang keu Peurancih, Jeurman ipuphon keu jak reubôt pulo Britania.
hypothesis: Meusajan prang keu Prancis ka seuleusoe, Jerman mulai bersiap untuk ji-invasi pulo Britania.

source: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.
reference: Nan sani prang Jeurman “Opeurasi Singa Laot”. Dum beudé geuhön ngön peunajôh Teuntra Inggreh ka gadöh watѐe ipinah nibak Dunkirk, teuma teuntra nyan sep leumöh.
hypothesis: Jerman geuboh nama kode serangan nyan Operation Sealion. Sebagian rayek senjata beuban dan pasokan Angkatan Darat Inggréh ka gadôh wate ji evakuasi dari Dunkirk, jadi angkatan prang nyan leumoh that.

source: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.
reference: Teutapi Teuntra Laôt Keurajeuen Inggreh mantông leubѐh teuga ibandeng Teuntra Laôt Jeurman (‘Kriegsmarine”) ngön jeuet ipeuancô dum armada prang nyang ikirem jeumeurang Lueng Laôt Inggreh.
hypothesis: Tapi Angkatan Laut Diraja mantong leubeh teuga daripada Angkatan Laut Jerman (Kriegsmarine) dan jeut ji peubinasa peue mantong angkatan prang invasi nyang ji peulheueh di Teungoh Saluran.

source: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
reference: Beuranggadum, bacut that kapai-kapai Teuntra Laôt Keurajeuen Inggreh nyang na rap deungön rot-rot nyang mungken ikeupong kareuna lakseumanajih yoe awak nyan ipeukaram le aneuk beude kapai phoe teuntra Jeurman.
hypothesis: Namun, sangat padum-padum aneuk kapai Angkatan Darat Raja geupeudong di deungen rute-rute invasi yeng mungken kareuna para amiral takot awak nyan akan tenggelam deungen serangan udara Jerman.

source: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.
reference: Jak ta puphon deungön saboh haba peukara hajat Itali. Itali nyan jameun nyankeuh "adoe" Jeurman ngön Jeupang.
hypothesis: Jak tapeuphon deungon penjelasan tentang rencana Italia. Italia terutama "abang ubit" Jerman ngon Jepang.

source: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.
reference: Jih na teuntra darat nyang leubeh leumoh ngön teuntra laôt nyang leubeh leumoh, adakpih awak nyan ban lheueh ipeugoet peuet boh kapai barô sigohlom prangipuphon.
hypothesis: Jih na angkatan prang nyang leubeh leumoh dan angkatan prang nyang leubeh leumoh, meskipun awak nyan baro jipeuget peuet kapai baroe seugolom jih musém prang.

source: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.
reference: Hajat Itali nyang phon nyankeuh nanggroe-nanggroe Afrika. Keu ireubot nanggroe-nanggroe nyan, awak nyan suwah na saboh teumpat keu ipeutren teuntra, ngön teuntra awak nyan beu jeuet imeulayeue jeumeurang Laôt Meiterania ngön reubot Afrika.
hypothesis: Tujuan utô Italia nakeuh nanggroë-nanggroë Afrika. Keu jiteun nanggroë-nanggroë nyan, awak nyan peureulèë na peuneugöt peuneugöt pasukan, mangat pasukan jeut meulayeue meulayeue laot Mediterania dan jitamong u Afrika.

source: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.
reference: Keu ipubuet nyan, awak nyan suwah ipeuanco eumpung-eumpung teuntra Inggreh ngön kapai-kapai nyang na bak Meuse. laénSeulaén nibak buet nyan, kapai-kapai prang Itali han suwah ipubuet dumpeue.
hypothesis: Keu nyan, awak nyan harôh jipeuhanco pangkalan ngon kapai-kapai prang Inggréh di Meusé.

source: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.
reference: Jinoe keu Jeupang. Jeupang jameun nyankeuh saboh nanggroe pulo, saban sit lagѐe Inggreh.
hypothesis: Jinoe keu Jepang. Jepang nakeuh saboh nanggroe pulo, lage Britania Raya.

source: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.
reference: Kapai nom nyankeuh kapai nyang ipeugoet keu ijak i yup ie, ngön teutap hinan sampoe watѐe nyang ka ipeuteuntee.
hypothesis: Kapal selam adalah kapal nyang dirancang untuk berelajah di bawah ie, ngen tinggai di sinan untuk jangka masa nyang luwah.

source: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
reference: Kapai nom nyan ingui bak Prang Donya I ngön Prang Donya II. Watѐe nyan awak nyan leupah meulet ngön timbakjih iphee leupah rap.
hypothesis: Submarines dipakek bak Perang Dunia I ngen Perang Dunia II. Bak masa nyan awak nyan sangat lambat ngen na jarak tembak yang sangat terbatas.

source: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
reference: Watѐe phon prang awak nyan paléng kayem ijak i ateueh laôt, teutapi watѐe radar ka ipeugoet leubeh got ngön ka lebeh pah kapai-kapai nom nyan iyue jak u yup ie bah han jeuet ikalon.
hypothesis: Bak awai prang nyan le jih ji meulayeue di ateueh laot, teutapi seucara radar mulai ji peugöt dan jeut keu leubeh akurat kapal selam dipakek untuk jak dimiyueb ie untuk hana ji kalon.

source: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
reference: Kapai nom ureueng Jeurman nanjih U-Boats. Ureueng Jeurman jroh that bak ime rakan bak ingui kapai nom awak nyan.
hypothesis: Kapal selam Jerman geukheun U-Boat. Ureuëng-ureuëng Jerman sangat get di navigasi ngen mengoperasikan kapal selam awak nyan.

source: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
reference: Seubab awaknyan jrôh deungön kapai nom, oh lheueh prang nyan Ureueng Jeurman han ipateh keu imat jai kapai nom.
hypothesis: Kareuna awaknyan meuhase ngon kapai selam, lheuh prang Jerman hana dipercayai keu na le jih.

source: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.
reference: Beutôi! Raja Tutankhamun, meujan-jan ikheun seubagoe "Raja Tut" atawa "Raja Aneuk Agam", nyankeuh sidroe Raja Ureueng Meuse nyang paléng meusyeuhu nibak watѐe jinoe.
hypothesis: Ya! Raja Tutankhamun, nyang kadang-kadang geuboh nan "Raja Tut" atawa "Raja Aneuk", na kheueh sidroe raja Meusé jameun nyang paleng meusyeuhu bak jamén nyoe.

source: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.
reference: Nyang gurajih, gobnyan han ikheun peunténg that bak watѐe jameun dilee ngön han meutuleh bak riwayat-riwayat raja jameun ilee nyang kayem na.
hypothesis: Meukheun jih, gobnyan hana jianggab that peunteng bak jamén ilée dan hana teucetet lam daftar raja-raja jameun.

source: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.
reference: lagѐe Beuranggadum, jeurat gobnyan nyang iteumee bak thon 1922 peujeuet gobnyan sebagoe ureueng nyan meusyeuhu. Adakpih jai jeurat-jeurat jameun dilee nyang irupah, jeurat nyoe teudong lagѐe soet han ipeukacho.
hypothesis: Teuma, óh ka lheueh jiduek bak jrat gobnyan bak thon 1922, gobnyan ka jeuet keu ureuëng nyang paleng meusyeuhu.

source: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.
reference: Dum dabeuh-dabeuh nyang meutanom sajan Tutankhamun ka ikawai deungön got, roh sit meuribee artefak-artefak nyang ipeugoet deungön beusoe ngön batee-batee nyang jareung na.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek barang-barang nyang teukubu deungen Tutankhamun ka dipeulara seucara get, termasuk meuribée-ribée artefak yeng dipeuget deungen logam mulia ngen batée langka.

source: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.
reference: Peuneujeuet ruda meujaroe peugoet sado Ureueng Asyur leubeh phui, leubeh bagah, ngön leubeh seuiya keu ime teuntra ngön sado laén.
hypothesis: Peuneugöt ruda nyang meubahya jipeujeuet geuritan Asyur leubeh leumoh, leubeh bagaih, dan leubeh got keu jipeuplueng droe nibak sipa-i dan geuritan-geuritan nyang laén.

source: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.
reference: Aneuk panah nibak panah awak nyan nyang paloe nyan jeuet peureuloh bajee beuso teuntra musoh. Kureueng leubeh bak thon 1000 S.M., Ureueng Asyur geupeugoet kavaleri nyang phon.
hypothesis: Panah-panah nibak panah-panah peumaté awaknyan hase jitamong lam kapai-kapai prang musoh. Kira-kira thon 1000 SM, Asyur jipeuna pasokan meuguda nyang phon-phon that.

source: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
reference: Kavaleri nyankeuh teuntra nyang meuprang nibak rueng guda. Peulana gohlom itumee, teuma awak kavaleri Asyur nyan meuprang i ateueh rueng soh nibak guda-guda awak nyan.
hypothesis: pasokan meuguda na kheueh saboh angkatan prang nyang jimeujuang ateueh guda.

source: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
reference: Geutanyoe jai taturi Ureueng Yunani nyang ahli peulitek, ahli sains, ngön ahli seuni. Mungken ureueng nyang paléng meusyeuhu nibak piyasan nyoe nyankeuh Homer, ureueng buta nyang kheun panton nyang meusyeuhu that, nyang geukarang duwa peuneugot nibak literatur Ureueng Yunani: panton Iliad ngön Odyssey.
hypothesis: Geutanyoe tateupeu le ureueng-ureueng politik, ilmuwan, dan seniman Yunani, dan mungken ureueng nyang paleng meusyeuhu lam budaya nyoe nakeuh Homer, penyair buta legendaris, nyang geukirém dua karya utama dalam sastra Yunani: puisi Iliad dan Odyssey.

source: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.
reference: Sophocles ngön Aristophanes nyan ureueng nyang meu’en dalupa nyang mantong meusyeuhu ngön dalupa awak nyan ithee seubagoe salah saboh nyang paléng got nibak literatur donya.
hypothesis: Sophocles ngen Aristophanes masih adalah penulis drama populer ngen drama awak nyan dianggap antara karya-karya sastra donya yang paleng rayek.

source: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
reference: Ureueng Yunani nyang meusyeuhu nyang laén nyankeuh ahli matematik Pythagoras, kayem ituri nibak teori gobnyan nyang meusyeuhu teuntang hubongan bineh-bineh lhee sagoe singkee.
hypothesis: Yunani terkenal laen adalah matematikawan Pythagoras, paleng that meusyeuhu untuk teorema jih yang terkenal tentang hubungan sisi segitiga persegi.

source: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
reference: Na muebagoe sangkira keu padum jai ureueng nyang peugah haba basa Hindi. Nyoe geukira sajan nibak basa keuduwa ngön keupeut nyang paléng umum jingui i donya.
hypothesis: Na estimasi yeng meubeda keu padum droe ureuëng njang meututoe bahasa Hindi.

source: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
reference: Jumlah peunutoe aseuli meumacam bagoe meunurot nibak pue dialek nyang teukaet brat atawa hana.
hypothesis: Jeumeulah pembicara asli meubeda-beda tergantung peu kheueh dialek yang terkait sangat atau hana diitung.

source: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
reference: Keunira sangkira nibak 340 juta sampoe 500 juta peunutoe, ngön na 800 juta ureueng jeuet meuphom basa nyan.
hypothesis: Perkiraan bervariasi dari 340 juta hingga 500 juta penutur, dan seugolom jih 800 juta ureung jeut meuphom bahsa nyan.

source: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
reference: Hindi ngön Urdu nyan hie lam kusakata tapih meubeda lam skrip; lam peunutoe siuroe-uroe, peunutoe keuduwa basa nyan biyasa jih jeuet sapue pham.
hypothesis: Bahsa Hindi ngon Urdu serupa dalam kosabulary tapi beda dalam skrip; lam percakapan tieb-tieb uroe, pembicara dua bahasa biasa jih jeut meuphom sidroe ngon nyang laen.

source: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
reference: Sangkira abda keu-15, Estonia Utara na keuh imiyup peungaroeh budaya Jeurman nyang rayeuk.
hypothesis: Kira-kira abad keu-15, Estonia utara na di bawah pengaruh budaya rayek dari Jerman.

source: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
reference: Padum droe biarawan Jeurman meuheut geume Tuhan leubeh toe deungön ureueng gampong aseuli, nyangkeuh awak nyan jipeugöt basa harfiah Etonia.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum teungku biarawan Jerman nyang meuheut keuneuk geupeusapat Allah bak ureuëng-ureuëng asli, ngon sabab nyan awaknyan jipeugöt basa Estonia secara harfiah.

source: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
reference: Nyan meuasai nibak alfabet Jeurman ngön saboh sipheut "Õ/õ" jipeutamah.
hypothesis: Nyan didasarkan bak abjad Jerman ngen saboh karakter "Õ/õ" ditambahkan.

source: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
reference: Seuireng watѐe ijak, jai kalimah nyang jipinjam nibak basa Jeurman jeuet keu saban. Nyoe keuh awai nibak penceurahan.
hypothesis: Seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara.

source: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.
reference: Meunurot tradisional, peuwareh tahta laju itamoeng militer oh lheuh peuseuleusoe sikula.
hypothesis: Seucara tradisional, ahli waréh keu takhta akan langsung masuk militer lheuh tamat sikula.

source: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).
reference: Beuranggadum, Charles ijak u kampus i Trinity College, Cambridge dipat jih meurunoe Antropologi ngön Arkeologi, ngön oh lheuh nyan Seujarah, meutume 2:2 (laqab glah duwa nyang leubeh miyup).
hypothesis: Namun, Charles geujak u universitas di Trinity College, Cambridge di sinan gobnyan geumeurunoe Antropologi dan Arkeologi, ngen lheuh nyan seujarah, geu peroleh ijazah 2: 2 (grade kelas dua yang leubeh rendah).

source: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.
reference: Charles nakeuh anggota phon nibak Keuluwarga Keurajeuen Inggreh nyang geubi geular.
hypothesis: Charles adalah anggota phon dari keluarga karajaan Inggris yang geubri gelar.

source: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
reference: Turki Eropa (Thrace timu atawa Rumelia i seumeunanjong Balkan) meulingkeu 3 % nanggroe.
hypothesis: Turki Eropa (Thrace timu atawa Rumelia di Semenanjung Balkan) mencakup 3% dari nanggroe nyan.

source: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
reference: Wilayah Turki na keuh panyang leubeh nibak 1.600 kilomete (1.000 mil) ngön bideung 800 km (500 mil) luwah, beuntoek sangkira peutsagoe panyang.
hypothesis: Wilayah Turki leubeh dari 1.600 kilometer (1,000 mi) panyang ngen 800 km (500 mi) luwah, deungen bentuk persegi.

source: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
reference: Wilayah Turki, itamoeng dano, iduek 783.562 kilometer peutsagoe (300.948 sq mi), na keuh 755.688 kilometer peutsagoe (291.773 sq mi) sapat i Asia barat daya ngön 23.764 kilometer peutsagoe (9.174 sq mi) i Eropa.
hypothesis: Wilayah Turki, termasuk danau, jimat 783.562 kilometer persegi (300.948 mil persegi), dari nyan 755.688 kilometer persegi (291.773 mil persegi) na di Asia barat daya ngen 23.764 kilometer persegi (9.174 mil persegi) di Eropa.

source: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
reference: Wilayah Turki jeuet keu nanggroe rayeuk keu-37 Idonya, ngön sangkira dumrayeuk Metropolitan Peurancih ngön Inggreh meuseu tapeusapat.
hypothesis: Wilayah Turki jeut keu nanggroë terbesar keu 37 di donya, dan kira-kira ukuran metropolitan Perancis ngen Britania Raya digabungkan.

source: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
reference: Turki ikeulileng le laôt bak lhee sagoe: Laôt Aegea i barat, ngön Laôt Itam i Utara, ngön Laôt Mediterania i selatan.
hypothesis: Turki dikeulileng le laot di lhee pihak: Laot Egeus di barat, Laot Hitam di utara ngen Laot Mediterania di seulatan.

source: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.
reference: Luksemburg na saboh hikayah panyang teutapi meurdehka jih bak thon 1839.
hypothesis: Luksemburg na seujarah nyang panyang teutapi kemerdekaan jih mulai thon 1839.

source: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.
reference: Ladom Belgia watѐe nyoe nakeuh ladom Luksemburg masa u likot teutapi jeuet keu Belgia oh lheueh Revolusi Belgia thon 1830an.
hypothesis: Bagian-bagian Belgia jinoe kaleuh jeut keu bagian dari Luksemburg di masa jameun tetapi jeut keu Belgia lheuh Revolusi Belgia 1830an.

source: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.
reference: Luksemburg sabe useuha keu teutap jeuet nanggroe netral teutapi di giduek mandua Prang Donya I ngön Prang Donya II le Jeurman.
hypothesis: Luksemburg kalheh ji coba untuk tetap jeut keu nanggroë netral, teutapi dijih jiokupi deungen prang donya I ngen prang donya II deungen Jerman.

source: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.
reference: Bak thon 1957 Luksemburg jeuet anggota peudong organisasi nyang jino meugah seubagoe Uni Eropa.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1957 Luksemburg jeut keu anggota pendiri organisasi nyang jinoe dikenal seubagoe Uni Eropa.

source: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
reference: Drukgyal Dzong nakeuh saboh beunteung nyang anco ngön biara Buddha bak ateueh Distrik Paro (bak gampong Phondey).
hypothesis: Drukgyal Dzong nakeuh saboh kuta nyang ka hanco dan monastik Budha di bagian ateueh Kabupatèn Paro (di gampông Phondey).

source: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
reference: Dipeugah bak thon 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel peugoet beunteung keu peuingat juwara lawan sidadu Tibet-Mongol.
hypothesis: Di peugah bak thon 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel geupeuget benteng keu geuingat keumeunangan jih terhadap pasukan Tibet-Mongol.

source: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
reference: Bak thon 1951, apui teutet seubap ladom geutinggai Drukgyal Dzong nyang euntee, lagѐe patong Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1951, kebakaran menyebabkan hanya padum-padum relikwi dari Drukgyal Dzong tinggai, lagee gambar Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

source: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
reference: Oh lheueh apui teutet, beunteung geulestarikan ngön geupelindong, teutap jeuet salah saboh atraksi paléng sensasional bak Bhutan.
hypothesis: Lheuh apui nyan, benteng nyan dipeuteun dan dipeulindong, tetap jeut keu salah saboh atraksi paling sensasional di Bhutan.

source: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
reference: Watѐe abad ke-18 Kamboja meuteume droe meuseupet bak antara, teutangga nyang kreuh, Thailand ngön Vietnam.
hypothesis: Seulama abad keu-18, Kamboja meurumpok droe jih dipakek antara dua tetangga nyang teuga, Thailand ngen Vietnam.

source: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
reference: Ureueng Thailand invasi Kamboja beberapa kali abda ke-18 ngön bak thon 1772 awak nyan geupeuanco Phnom Phen.
hypothesis: Ureuëng Thailand ji invadasi Kamboja le that kali bak abad keu-18 ngen bak thon 1772 awak nyan geupeuhanco Phnom Phen.

source: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
reference: Bak thon-thon akhe abad keu-18, Vietnam pih menginvasi Kamboja.
hypothesis: Bak thon akhe abad keu-18 ureung Vietnam juga ji serang Kamboja.

source: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
reference: Lapan blah peureusen ureueng Venezuela hana keureuja, ngön ladom rayeuk nibak awak nyan keureja bak ekonomi hana formal.
hypothesis: 18 persen rakyat Venezuela hana keureuja, dan le ureung nyang na keureuja bekerja lam ekonomi informal.

source: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
reference: Duwa peurlhee nibak ureueng Venezuela nyang keureuja pubuet bak sektor guna, karap sepeurpeut keureuja bak industri ngön sepeurlimong keureuja bak meugoe.
hypothesis: Dua pertiga rakyat Venezuela nyang keureuja bak sektor jasa, kira-kira siperempat keureuja bak industri ngen siperlima keureuja bak pertanian.

source: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
reference: Saboh industri peunténg bak Venezuela nakeu minyeuk, dipat nanggroe nyan nakeuh ekspor gleh, beu that saboh peureusen keureuja bak industri minyek.
hypothesis: Industri nyang peunteng keu rakyat Venezuela nakeuh minyak, nanggroë nyan nakeuh eksportir net, meskipun hanya sa persen yang bekerja lam industri minyak.

source: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
reference: Bak phon nanggroe meurdehka, ahli Lampoh Raya Singapura geutulông ubah pulo nyan jeuet saboh Kuta Taman tropis.
hypothesis: Awal-awal kemerdekaan negara, keahlian Taman Botani Singapura membantu meu ubah pulau nyan jeut keu Kota Taman tropis.

source: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
reference: Bak thon 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, hibrida anggrek, geupileh sebagoe bungong nanggroe.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, hibrida orchidee, geupiléh seubagai bungong nasional negara.

source: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
reference: Tiep thon seulingka buleun Oktober karap 1,5 juta herbivora geujak u darat seulatan, jeumeurang Krueng Mara, nibak gle utara keu ujeuen.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb thon kira-kira Oktober kira-kira 1,5 juta herbivores meulayeue u dataran selatan, menyeberkan Sungai Mara, dari bukit-bukit utara keu ujeuen.

source: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
reference: Oh lheuh nyan gisa teuma u utara leupah barat, sigoe teuk jeumeurang Krueng Mara, oh lheueh ujeun bak buleun April.
hypothesis: Óh lheueh nyan u utara meulalu barat, lom tajeumeurang krueng Mara, lheuh ujeuen di sekitar buleuen April.

source: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
reference: Teumpat Sarengeti meuasoe Taman Nasional Serengeti, Mukim Konservasi Ngorongoro ngön Keuneubah Meuneu'en Maswa i Tanzania ngön Cagar Nasional Maasai Mara i Kenya.
hypothesis: Wilayah Serengeti na Taman Nasional Serengeti, Wilayah Konservasi Ngorongoro ngen Taman Game Maswa di Tanzania ngen Taman Nasional Maasai Mara di Kenya.

source: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
reference: Meureunoe keu ta peuna media nyang interaktif peureulee keu cara biyasa ngön cara nyang ka meubudaya, nyan peureulee cit keu peukakah hayeu keu glah nyang interaktif (papeun ceurita, audio ngön video edit, peugah ceurita, dsj.)
hypothesis: Meurunoe untuk neupeugöt media interaktif geukeuheundak keuahlian konvensional ngon tradisional, meunan cit alat nyang ji peuturi lam kelas interaktif (storyboarding, pengeditan audio ngon video, cerita, dll)

source: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
reference: Beuntuk nyang interaktif nyan peureule keu gata taboeh yum lom sigoe teuk prasangka droeneuh keu peuna media ngön neumeurunoe keu neu pikee lam saboh cara nyang hana saban.
hypothesis: Desain interaktif merlukeun bahwa droeneuh neu-evaluasi ulang asumsi droeneuh tentang produksi media dan neumeurunoe pike ngon cara nyang hana linear.

source: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
reference: Beuntuk interaktif nyan peureule keu meubagoe beukai nibak saboh proyek keu tasambong saboh keu nyang laén, tapi jitamoeng cit lam akai keuneuk saboh hai nyang meucebre.
hypothesis: Desain interaktif merlukeun bahwa komponen proyek meuhubong ngen sidroe ngon nyang laen, teutapi cit na makna seubagai entitas yang terpisah.

source: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
reference: Nyang kureueng get nibak gaca lensa zoom nyan nakeuh bahwasajih fokus nyang payah ngön numboi nibak beukai gaca lensa nyan peureule keu beutrôh u saboh titek jioh fokus nyang leubeuh rayeuk nibak gaca lensa nyang phon.
hypothesis: Kelemahan lensa zoom adalah bahwa kompleksitas fokus dan jumlah elemen lensa yang diperlukan untuk meuhase rentang jarak fokus leubeh rayek daripada lensa utama.

source: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
reference: Nyoe keuneuk meupeukara nyang leubeh ubeut meunyö ureueng nyang peugoet gaca lensa nyan jeuet geutumee saboh standar nyang leubeh hayeu lam geupeugoet gaca lensa.
hypothesis: Nyoe ka jeut keu masalah yeng kureueng seucara produsen lensa meuhase standar yeng lubeh rayek dalam produksi lensa.

source: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
reference: Nyoe nyang peumungken gaca lensa zoom keu jipeuhase gamba nyang getjih nyan seubandeng deungön gaca lensa deungön focus jioh nyang teutap.
hypothesis: Nyo ka geupeu idhin lensa zoom untuk menghasilkan gambar deungen kualitas yeng jeut dibandingkan deungen lensa deungen jarak fokus yeng tetap.

source: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
reference: Nyang kureueng get laén nibak gaca lensa zoom nyoe nakeuh maksimum buka khopjih (bagah) nibak gaca lensa nyang ladôm leumoh.
hypothesis: Kelemahan laen dari lensa zoom adalah bahwa aperture maksimum (kecepatan) lensa biasa jih leubeh bacut.

source: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
reference: Nyoe musabab keu gaca lensa zoom nyang murah payah that dingui lam keuadaan kureueng hu meunyö hana cahya meu ble-ble.
hypothesis: Nyo meujeuet lensa zoom yang murah payah dipakek lam kondisi cahaya bacut tanpa flash.

source: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
reference: Salah saboh masalah nyang paléng umum 'oh watèë cuba ubah film u format DVD nakeuh pemindaian berlebih atawa overscan.
hypothesis: Salah saboh masalah nyang paleng umum watee geucuba geu ubah saboh pilem jeut keu format DVD nakeuh over scan.

source: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
reference: Biasajih tv dipeugot deungön cara keu peusenang masyarakat umum.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek televisi dipeuget deungen cara untuk meumangat masyarakat umum.

source: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
reference: Sabab alasan nyan, bandum nyang droëneuh kalön di TV na batah terteuntèë nyang dikoh, ateuh, miyup, ngön sampéng.
hypothesis: Nyang kheueh sabab jih, mandum nyang gata kalon bak TV na bataih-bataih jih, di ateueh, di miyueb dan di seukeulileng jih.

source: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
reference: Hai nyoë dipeugot keu peupasti bahwa gamba geutôp ban mandum layar. Nyan geusebôt overscan.
hypothesis: Nyo dipeuget untuk memastikan bahwa gamba nyan mencakup mandum layar. Nyan geukheun overscan.

source: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
reference: Sayangjih, 'oh droëneuh peugöt DVD, batahjih kemungkinan rayek akan dikoh cit, dan menyoe videojih na subtitel nyang leupah toë u bagian miyup, awak nyan han jipeudeuh ban mandum.
hypothesis: Malangnya, watee awak peuget DVD, batah jih akan dipotong cit, dan meunyoe video nyan na subtitle that rab ngon dasi, awak nyan hana akan ditampilkan sepenuhnya.

source: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
reference: Meuligoe tradisional abad teuneungoh ka trep meuilhami imajinasi, meusulap gamba jousts, hidang keu jamee ngon ksatria Arthurian.
hypothesis: Kastil abad pertengahan tradisional ka treb that geu ilham imajinasi, geu kirém gambar-gambar jousts, pesta dan ksatria Arthurian.

source: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
reference: Bahkan tadong di tengoh reruntuhan na umu meuribee thon, mudah untuk taingat su ngon bee prang yang ka trep teujadi, untuk rap meudeungo su aki di jalan meubatee ngon untuk meucom rasa teumakot nyang teubiet dari lubang penjara baroh tanoh.
hypothesis: Bahkan berdiri di teungoh-teungoh ruwah nyang meujuta-juta thon treb jih nyan mudah untuk jipeutrang suara dan bau prang nyang ka treb-treb meuninggai donya, untuk hampir mendengar kerumunan kapak di batu bata dan untuk mencium rasa takot nyang teuka dari lubang-lubang penjara.

source: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
reference: Teutapi peu imajinasi tanyoe jidasarkan bak keunyataan? Pakon meuligoe-meuligoe awai jipeugot? Kiban mandum nyan jirancang ngon jipeugot?
hypothesis: Teuma peu kheueh imajinasi geutanyoe meudasai bak realitas? Pakon istana teupeudong phon-phon that?

source: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
reference: Leubeh beutôi keu masa nyan, aseutana Kirby Muxloe nakeuh leubeh ke rumoh nibak keu saboh aseutana.
hypothesis: khas untuk periode nyan, Kirby Muxloe Castle leubeh dari rumoh nyang dipeukong daripada kastil seujati.

source: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
reference: Tingkeup raya meugacajih ngön binteh nyang lipeh hana jeuet keu peutheun keu seureubu nyang dipeutentee keu watѐe nyang trep.
hypothesis: Pintoe-pintoe tingkap jih nyang rayek dan bintéh-bintéh jih nyang tipis hana hase meuteun bak serangan nyang teupat treb jih.

source: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
reference: Lam thon 1480an, watѐe masa jipeudongjih ka jipuphon le Tuan Hastings, nanggroe nyan leubeh dame ngön peuthen nyan peureulee sagai keu keulompok ubeut ureueng rampok nyang meukeulileng.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1480-an, wate konstruksi jih dimulai le Lord Hastings, nanggroe nyan relatif aman dan pertahanan hanya diperlukan terhadap kelompok-kelompok kecil perampok.

source: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
reference: Kuwasa nyang timang nakeuh saboh sistem nyang bansa Eropa geuuseuha keu geujaga wilayah bansa nyang bibeuh ban mandum nanggroe di Eropa.
hypothesis: Keseimbangan kekuasaan adalah sistem yeng dilee bangsa Eropa geu mita untuk geujaga suverenitas nasional mandum negara Eropa.

source: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
reference: Cara nibaknyan nakeuh ban mandum nanggroe Eropa payah mita cara keu geupeutheun saboh bansa nyang jibeudoh jeuet keu teuga, ngön sabab nyan poemeurentah bansa nyang kayem digantoe syarikat keu jijaga keu timang.
hypothesis: Konsep jih adalah bahwa mandum bansa Eropa harus berusaha untuk mencegah saboh bansa jeut keu kuat, dan oleh karena nyan pemerintah nasional seureng meu ubah aliansi jih untuk dipeulara keseimbangan.

source: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
reference: Prang Wareh Bansa Spanyol jitanda nibak prang nyang keuphon deungön peukara nyang utama nyankeuh keu peutimang kuwasa.
hypothesis: Perang Suksesi Spanyol dipeukalon prang phon yeng isu pusat jih adalah keseimbangan kuasa.

source: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
reference: Nyoe jitanda meuubah nyang peunténg, sabab kuwasa Eropa nyan hana dipeunan le sebagoe prang ateueh nan agama. Nyan, Prang Lhee Ploh Thon nyang jeuet keu prang paléng akhe nyang jeuet jipeunan seubagoe prang ateueh nan agama.
hypothesis: Nyoe ka jeuet keubukeuti nyang paleng peunteng, kareuna bansa-bansa nyang na di Eropa hana le jimeudakwa sibagoe ureuëng meujuang keu agama.

source: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
reference: Teumpat keuramat Artemis bak Efesus nyan ka ancoe bak tanggai 21 Juli, thon 356 SM lam saboh buet teumeutet nyang dipeugöt le Herostratus.
hypothesis: Kuil Artemis di Efesus dihanco bak uroe 21 Juli 356 SM lam aksi pembakaran nyang dipeuget le Herostratus.

source: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
reference: Lagѐe nyang meutuleh lam calitra, meukeusut gobnyan nyankeuh bah meuceuhu adak pakribanpih carajih. Ureueng-ureueng Efesus, beungeh that, dibrithee bahwasajih nan Herostratus han tom dituleh.
hypothesis: Seucara meubacut pih, ureuëng-ureuëng Efesus nyan beungéh, dan jipeumaklum bahwa nan Herostratus hana teuma teucetet.

source: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
reference: Ahli seujarah asai Yunani Strabo dudoe geutuleh nanjih, teuma nyankeuh nyang peugöt tanyoe tupeue uroe nyoe. Teumpat keuramat nyan ancoe bak saban malam watѐe Aleksander Agung lahe.
hypothesis: Sidroe seujarah Yunani nyang nan jih Strabo geucalitra teuma nan nyan, lagée nyang tanyoe turi nibak uroenyoe.

source: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
reference: Aleksander, seubagoe raja, geupeutaba bayeue keu peudong lom teumpat keuramat nyan, tapi hajatjih nyan ditulak. Dudoe, oh lheueh Aleksander mate, teumpat keuramat nyan dipeudong lom bak thon 323 SM.
hypothesis: Aleksander, seubagoe raja, meujanji keu geubayeue keu geupeudong lom kuil nyan, teuma tawaran jih ditolak.

source: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
reference: Neupeuteuntee jaroe gata seuguruek mungken watѐe teungoh neutuleh mandum kheuet nyoe deungon beutôi – pih bek neutree peugöt jai buet leubeh laén deungon aneuk jaroe gata.
hypothesis: Pastikan jaroe droeneuh seureuh mungkin seudangkan droeneuh masih memukul semua catatan dengan benar - juga cuba untuk tidak membuat banyak gerakan yang luar biasa dengan jari-jari droeneuh.

source: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
reference: Deungon cara nyoe, gata jeuet neupeukureueng hek droe. Neuingat bahwasajih han peureulee neuteugon gunci deungon kreueh keu su yang leubeh rayek lagѐe bak piano.
hypothesis: Deungon cara nyoe, awak nyan akan leumoh droe awak nyan seugantoe mungken. Ingat hana perlu untuk menekan tombol deungon le kekuatan untuk volume tambahan lage bak piano.

source: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
reference: Bak akordeon, bah meuteumee su nyang leubeh rayek, gata neumboh deungon leubeh meuteugon atawa leubeh bagah.
hypothesis: Bak akordeon, untuk mendapatkan volume tambahan, awak dipakek bellow dengan tekanan atau kecepatan yang leubeh.

source: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
reference: Mistisisme nyankeuh buet peulet meusapat deungon, meusipheuet deungon, atawa dithee meutupeue nibak sipheuet nyata nyang paléng manyang, sipheuet tuhan, sipheuet aruwah nyang beutôi, atawa Tuhan.
hypothesis: Mistikisme adalah teuntang komunitas deungen, identitas deungen, atau kesadaran sadar deungen realitas tertinggi, keurajaan, kebenaran rohani, atau Allah.

source: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
reference: Ureueng-ureueng nyang pateh geumita nyumjih deungon lansong, grak ate, atawa eleumee lam sipheuet nyata tuhan/dewa atawa dewa-dewa.
hypothesis: Peucaya ji mita pengalaman langsung, intuisi, atawa wawasan lam realitas ilahi/deity atawa diet.

source: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
reference: Ureueng-ureueng nyang ikot nyan geumita cara-cara udep nyang meuteuntee, atawa buet-buet nyang dimeukeusud keu peulara nyum-nyum nyan.
hypothesis: Pengikut jih ji peujak cara udeb tertentu, atau praktek-praktek yang dimaksudkan untuk menumbuhkan pengalaman-pengalaman nyan.

source: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
reference: Mistisisme jeuet dipeusiblah nibak buet-buet agama ngön Meuseeumah nyang laén deungon puncajih nyum sidroe ureueng deungon cara lansong nibak sipheuet nyang meubeda nibak dithee, khususjih ureueng nyang dame, carong, bahgiya, atawa leubeh lom tabi’at nyang seunang.
hypothesis: Mistikisme jeut dibedakan dari bentuk-bentuk kepercayaan dan ibadah agama laen deungen penekanan jih pada pengalaman pribadi langsung dari keadaan kesadaran yang unik, terutama yang bersifat damai, teliti, bahagia, atau bahkan ekstasi.

source: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
reference: Sikhisme nyankeuh saboh agama nibak daerah benua India. Nyan asaijih bak daerah Punjab watѐe abad keu-15 nibak meupisah sekte lam peurangui Hindu.
hypothesis: Sikhisme nakeuh saboh agama nibak sub-kontinent India.jih asai jih di wilayah Punjab bak abad keu-15 dari peucre sekte lam tradisi Hindu.

source: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
reference: Sikh pikee agama awak nyan jeuet keu saboh agama nyang meupisah nibak agama Hindu adakpih awak nyan ditupue nyan ukheue-ukheue nibak Hindu ngön peurangui.
hypothesis: Sikh menganggap iman jih jeut keu agama yang terpisah dari Hinduisme meskipun awak nyan mengakui akar dan tradisi Hindu jih.

source: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
reference: Sikh dikheun agama awaknyan Gurmat, nyankeuh Punjabi keu "jalan nibak guree)". Guree nyankeuh saboh hai peunténg nibak mandum agama-agama India tapi Sikhisme ka dicok keu saboh hai nyang peunténg nyang peugöt uram nibak agama Sikh.
hypothesis: Agama jih jiboh nama Gurmat, nyang nakeuh bahasa Punjabi untuk "jalan guru". Guru nakeuh saboh aspek mendasar dari mandum agama India teutapi lam agama Sikhisme ka geucok peunteng nyang jeut keu inti kepercayaan Sikh.

source: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
reference: Agama nyan ka ipeudoeng bak abad keu 15 le Gure Nanak (1469-1539). Na sikureueng droe gure meuikot-ikot keuneulheuh nyan.
hypothesis: Agama nyoe geupeudong bak abad keu-15 lé Guru Nanak (1469~1539).

source: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
reference: Beuranggandum, bak buleun Juni 1956, janji Krushchev jiujoe watѐe karu i Polandia, dipat ureueng-ureueng keureuja ka geumeudawa han sep peunajoh ngön ikoeh gaji, meu ubahjeuetkeu dawa ureueng ramee bak Komunisme.
hypothesis: Namun, bak buleuen Juni 1956, janji-janji Krushchev geu uji watee karu di Polandia, di pat pekerja-pekerjaan meuprotes deungen kekurangan makanan dan pengurangan upah, meu ubah jeut keu protes umum deungen Komunisme.

source: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
reference: Adakpih keuneulheuh, Krushchev geukirem lam tengki keu jipeugadoeh baresan, gobnyan geubi meupadum boh tuntotan ekonomi ngön sapue kheun keu geutunyok Wladyslaw Gomulka seubagoe peurdana meuntroe baro.
hypothesis: Meskipun di akhe jih, Krushchev geu kirém bak tank untuk meupeuglehkan ketertiban, gobnyan ka geu peugot jalan keu padum boh tuntutan ekonomi dan setuju untuk geuangkat Wladyslaw Gomulka yang populer seubagoe perdana menteri baroe.

source: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
reference: Peuradaban Leumbah Indus nyankeuh peuradaban Jameun Peurunggu bak beunua india blah barat laôt nyang itamoeng ladom Pakistan nyang ka maju ngön padum boh dairah i India blah barat laôtngön blah timulaôt Afghanistan.
hypothesis: Peradaban Lembah Indus adalah peradaban Zaman Perunggu di benua barat laut India nyang mencakup sebagian rayek Pakistan jinoe ngen padum boh wilayah di barat laut India ngen barat laut Afghanistan.

source: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
reference: Peuradaban maju bak ceukungan Indus krueng sabab nyankeuh na nanjih.
hypothesis: Peradaban nyan bereh di bak-bak Krueng Indus, nyan keuh sabab jih nan jih.

source: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
reference: Adakpih padum-padum droe sarjana berspekulasi bahwasajih sabab peuradaban nyan sit na i ceukungan Krueng Sarasvati nyang jinoe thoe, nyang pah takheun Peuradaban Krueng Sarasvati, seumentara na padum-padum droe geukheunjih Peuradaban Harappan lheuh nyan Harappa, nyang phon bak situsjih ikueh bak thon 1920-an.
hypothesis: Meskipun na padum-padum-padum sarjana geu spekulasi bahwa kareuna peradaban nyan cit na di bak-bak bak Krueng Sarasvati nyang jinoe ka tho, nyan harus tepat jih jiboh nan peradaban Indus-Sarasvati, sementara padum-padum droe jiboh nan peradaban Harappa lheuh Harappa, situs phon jih nyang jiekol bak thon 1920-an.

source: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
reference: Sifeut militer Keurajeuen Romawi meutulông peurkeumbangan keumajuan medis.
hypothesis: Sifeut militarisme kekaisaran Romawi membantu perkembangan medis.

source: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
reference: Dokter kamulai geutarek le Raja Agustus ngön geupeugoet Korporasi Medis Romawi nyang keu phon keu jingui oh lheuh prang.
hypothesis: Dokter mulai direkrut le Kaisar Augustus dan bahkan dipeuget Kor medis Romawi phon untuk dipakek lheuh prang.

source: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
reference: Ahli beudah na euleumee keu meubagoe ubat peuneunang itamoeng keunan morfin nibak pati boh poppi ngön skopolamin nibak boh-boh kayee herba.
hypothesis: Ahli bedah na pengetahuan tentang macam-macam obat penenang termasuk morfin dari ekstrak benih poppy dan scopolamine dari benih herbane.

source: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
reference: Awaknyan jeuet keu hayeu bak amputasi keu peuseulamat ureueng saket nibak gangren sereuta torniket ngön klem arteri keu meutop roet ilee darah.
hypothesis: Awaknyan jeut keu ahli di amputasi untuk dipeuseulamat pasien dari gangrene meunan cit turniquets dan clamps arteri untuk menahan aliran darah.

source: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
reference: Sangkira meupadum abad, keurajaan Romawi meusababjih labajih bak bideueng keudokteran ngön jeuet jai euleumee nyang tanyoe turie jinoe.
hypothesis: Seulama padum-padum abad, Keurajeuën Roma jipeuhase kemajuan rayek lam bidang kedokteran dan jipeuhase ladum pengetahuan nyang tanyoe teupeue nibak uroenyoe.

source: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.
reference: Origami Pureland nyankeuh origami ngön parak saboh sagai lipatjih nyangjeuet ipeugoet bak masa nyan, lipat nyang sampoerna lagѐe hana ibri lipat meubalek, ngön lipat mandum lipat na teumpat droe ih laju.
hypothesis: Pureland origami adalah origami deungen batasan bahwa hanya saboh lipat jeut dipeuget sigoe, lipat yeng lubeh kompleks lage lipat reverse hana geupeu idhin, ngen mandum lipat na lokasi yeng langsong.

source: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.
reference: Nyoe ipeumaju le John Smith bak thon 1970-an keu meutulông pat keubah dabeuh nyang hana peungalaman atawa awaknyan nyang na keuahlian motorik.
hypothesis: Nyan dipeugöt le John Smith bak thon 1970an keu geutulông folder yang hana pengalaman atawa ureung nyang na kemampuan motor yang terbatas.

source: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.
reference: Aneuk miet ipeurayeuk nak ithei keu ras ngön stereotip ras sep muda ngön stereotip ras nyoe meupeuwap peukateun.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk mengembangkan kesadaran tentang ras dan stereotip ras yang sangat muda ngen stereotip ras nyoe mempengaruhi perilaku.

source: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.
reference: Keu tamse, aneuk miet nyang ithei droe ngön ras nyang ubeut nyang geustereotip han jeuet jawara bak sikula meuikot hana jawaraa sit bak sikula oh awaknyan meurunoe stereotip nyang meusangkôt deungön ras awaknyan.
hypothesis: Miseue jih, aneuk miet nyang ji identifikasi deungen etnis minoritas nyang ji stereotip seubagoe hana meuhase di sikula cenderung hana meuhase di sikula wate awak nyan jituri tentang stereotip nyang meuhubongan deungen ras awak nyan.

source: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
reference: Myspace nakeuh situs web terpopuler keulhèë nyang dipakék di Amerika Serikat ngön 'oh nyoë po 54 juta profil.
hypothesis: MySpace nakeuh situs web nyang paleng rayek keu lhee di Amerika Serikat dan na 54 juta profil saat nyoë.

source: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
reference: Website-website nyoë ka geuteurimong le perhatian, teuutama bak bidang pendidikan.
hypothesis: Laman-laman nyoe ka meuteumé le perhatian, terutama di lingkungan pendidikan.

source: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
reference: Na aspek positif dari situs web nyoë, nyang meliputi, jeut deungön mudah geuatô laman glah nyang jeut mencakup blog, video, foto, ngön fitur laénjih.
hypothesis: Na aspek positif bak situs-situs nyan, nyang meupeunteng, jeut dengan mudah peugöt laman kelas yang jeut meupeunteng blog, video, foto, ngen fitur-fitur laen.

source: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
reference: Halaman nyoë jeuet diakses deungön mudah hanya deungön geubri saboh alamat web, nyang jeuet diingat ngön mudah diketik lé siswa nyang mungkén sôsah geungui keyboard atawa ejaan.
hypothesis: Laman nyoe jeut ji akses mudah deungen ji bri saboh alamat web mantong, nyang jeut ji ingat ngon mudah ji ketik keu aneuk mit nyang mungken na masalah deungen menggunakan keyboard atawa deungen ejaan.

source: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
reference: Nyan jeuet disesuaikan mangat mudah dibaca ngön jeuet cit geuatô le atawa bacut wareuna kiban nyang hawa.
hypothesis: Nyo jeut disesuaikan untuk jeut mudah dibaca dan juga deungen seb le atau bacut warna lagee yang dikira.

source: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
reference: Attention Deficit Disorder “na keuh saboh penyaket sindrom neurologis nyang jameun nyang deuh lhee boh geujala lagѐe impulsif, distraksi, ngön hiperaktif atawa leubeh teunaga”.
hypothesis: Attention Deficit Disorder "na keuh sindrom neurologis yeng klasifikasi triad gejala termasuk impulsiveness, distractibility, dan hyperactivity atau kelebihan energi".

source: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
reference: Nyoe kon hana ek meurunoe, nyanjih gangguan meurunoe; "ipeuwap 3 sampoe 5 persen nibak mandum aneuk miet, mungken na 2 juta aneuk miet Amerika".
hypothesis: Nyan kon cacat peurunoe, nyan na keuh gangguan peurunoe; "nyan keunong bak 3 sampoe 5 persen dari mandum aneuk miet, mungken sampoe 2 juta aneuk miet Amerika".

source: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.
reference: Anuek miet nyang keunong ADD payah keu fokus bak hai-hai lagѐe buet sikula, teutapi awak nyanjeuet konsentrasi bak hai-hai nyang awak nyan galak lagѐe maeen game atawa kaloen karton nyang galak awak nyan atawa jitumuleh kalimah hana meutanda baca.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk nyang meu-ADD payah that meu-fokus bak hal-hal lagee keureuja di sikula, teuma awak nyan jeut meu-fokus bak hal-hal nyang awaknyan galak peubuet lage meu-game atawa meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu-meu

source: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
reference: Aneuk-aneuk miet nyoe jai meupeukara, sabab awak nyan “teupaot lam bahaya peukateun, jimeulhoe, ngön jilawan awak rayeuk” keu peuransang utakjih, sabab utakjih han meuransang deungön metode biyasa.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk nyoe cenderung jeut keu masalah nyang le, kareuna awak nyan "meuhubong lam perilaku berisiko, meuprang, dan meudebatkan otoritas" untuk merangsang otak awak nyan, kareuna otak awak nyan hana jeut dipeugöt deungen metode biasa.

source: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
reference: ADD jeuet hana get silaturahmi deungön rakan siumuejih sabab aneuk-aneuk laén hana jeuet jipeumeuphom pakoen awak nyan meutingkah lagѐe nyan rupa atawa pue awak nyan peukoe meunan peukateun atawa tingkat rayeukjih meubeda.
hypothesis: ADD mempengaruhi hubungan deungen rakan-rakan laen kareuna aneuk laen hana muphom pakon jih meubuet lagee nyan atawa pakon jih mengeja lagee nyan atawa tingkat kematangan jih beda.

source: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.
reference: Sabab daya keu tatumee ileumee ngön keu tameurunoe lagѐe nyan lagѐe nyang jiseubot i ateueh tingkat phon dipat ileume jiteume meu ubah- ubah.
hypothesis: Seubab kemampuan untuk meumeunang pengetahuan dan untuk meumeunang meu ubah lagee yang disebutkan di ateuh tingkat dasar yeng meumeunang pengetahuan meu ubah.

source: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.
reference: Peundeukatan keu peu na informasi meubeda. Hana geutham le bak meuingat sidroe ureueng, teutapih meudaya meuphom geuingat tulesan jeuet leubeh fokus.
hypothesis: Pendekatan untuk mendapatkan informasi nyan beda. Hana le tekanan tinggai dalam memori individu, tapi kemampuan untuk mengingat teks menjadi lebih fokus.

source: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.
reference: Intijih, Renaisans jipeugöt peurubahan nyang rayeuk lam peundekatan meurunoe ngön peuluwah ileume.
hypothesis: Pada dasarnya, Renaisans membuat perubahan yang signifikan dalam pendekatan untuk belajar ngen penyebaran pengetahuan.

source: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
reference: Kon lagѐe Primata laén, hominid hana le jingui jaroe awak nyan keu meugrak atawa meupeutheun geuhon atawa meuayon nibak bak kayee.
hypothesis: Beda ngen primata laen, hominid hana le dipakek jaroe jih bak lokomotif atau geuba beurat atau meuguncang bak kayee.

source: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
reference: Jaroe ngön gaki simpanse saban ukuran ngön panyang, leumah geungui jaroe keu theun beuban watѐe jak ngön gaki.
hypothesis: Tangan ngon gaki chimpanzee nyan saban deungen ukuran dan panyang, yang meucetakan penggunaan jaroe untuk meuseuôn beurat bak geuminah knuckle.

source: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
reference: Jaroe manusiya leubeh paneuk nibak gaki, deudeungön tulueng falang nyang leubeh teupat.
hypothesis: Tangan manusia leubeh kureueng daripada gaki, ngon phalanges nyang leubeh teupat.

source: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
reference: Fosil tuleueng jaroe duwa juta sampoe lhee juta thon u likot kheun na meugisa spesialisasi jaroe nyoe nibak meugrak u manipulasi.
hypothesis: Tulang jaroe fosil dua juta sampoe lhee juta thon jameun geuungkap perubahan nyoe dalam spesialisasi jaroe dari lokomosi keu manipulasi.

source: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
reference: Padum droe ureueng geupateh bahwa ka geualami le lumpoe jeungeh nyang diinduksi ngön cara artifisial kayem cukop jeuet hek that.
hypothesis: Padum-padum droe ureueng percaya bahwa meu-udep meu-udep lumpo lucid nyang geu-induksi secara jieunan jeut sangat meukarat.

source: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.
reference: Alasan keu phon fenomena nyoe nakeuh hase nibak lumpoe jeungeh nyang peuluah jangka watѐe antara sipheuet REM.
hypothesis: Alesan utama untuk fenomena nyo adalah hasil dari mimpi lucid yang memperluas jangka waktu antara keadaan REM.

source: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.
reference: Deungön leubeh bacut REM tiep malam, keuadaan dipat gata neualami eh nyang sebetoijih ngön tuboh gata puleh jeuet cukop jareung jeuet masalah.
hypothesis: Deungon bacut REM tieb-tieb malam, keadaan nyoe di teumpat awak ta alami tidur nyata dan awak awak awak ta pulih jeut keu langka sampoe jeut keu masalah.

source: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.
reference: Nyoe saban hekjih deungön miseu gata beudoh tiep duwa ploh atawa lhee ploh meunet ngön neukalon TV.
hypothesis: Nyoe seubalek jih leumoh seukira jih awak nyan jibeudôh tieb-tieb dua ploh atawa lhée ploh menit dan nonton TV.

source: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
reference: Akibatjih meuteuntee bak padum kayem utak gata geucuba keu meulumpoe jeungeh tiep malam.
hypothesis: Efek nyan meugantung bak seberapa seureng otak awak meucuba meulumpo lucid per malam.

source: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.
reference: Ban mandumnyan han berjalan deungön göt bagi ureuëng Italia di Afrika Utara karap sejak awai. Lam watèë seminggu lheuëh deklarasi prang Italia nibak 10 Juni 1940, Hussars (pasukan berkuda) Inggréh ke-11 ka geurebôt benteng Capuzzo di Libya.
hypothesis: Lagee Italia di Afrika Utara hana meuhase nibak awai. Lam sibuleuen lheuh Italia geupeumaklum prang bak 10 Juni 1940, pasukan 11 Hussars Inggréh ka jireubot Fort Capuzzo di Libya.

source: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.
reference: Lam penyerangan di timu Bardia, ureueng Inggréh geudrop pangulèë insinyur angkatan darat kesiploh Italia, Jenderal Lastucci.
hypothesis: Dalam penyergapan di timu Bardia, Inggreh jiteun Injiner-in-Chief Angkatan Tenth Italia, Jenderal Lastucci.

source: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.
reference: Nibak tanggai 28 Juni, Marshal Italo Balbo, Gubernur jenderal Libiya ngön peuwaréh Mussolini, maté keunong timbak lé rakan droe 'oh mendarat di Tobruk.
hypothesis: Bak 28 Juni, Marshal Italo Balbo, Gubernator Jenderal Libya ngen ahli waréh Mussolini, teupoh maté deungen tembakan rakan seulama geutron di Tobruk.

source: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.
reference: Meuneu’en (sport) anggar moderen nyan jipeumeu’en bak meubagoe tingkat, nibak aneuk sikula nyang teungöh meurunoe bak kampus sampoe nyang profesional ngön Olimpiade.
hypothesis: Olahraga modern fencing dipeuget bak padum boh tingkatan, dari mahasiswa yang belajar di perguruan tinggi hingga kompetisi profesional ngen Olimpiade.

source: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.
reference: Meuneu’en (sport) nyoe keuphôn jipeumeu’en nyang format duel, sidroe awak meu’en anggar jilawan ngön awak laen.
hypothesis: Seureuta jih, olahraga nyoe dipeuget dalam format duel, sidroe peumaju dueling yang laen.

source: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.
reference: Golf nyan kueh meuneu’en dipat peumaenjih geungui tungkat keu peh bola u lam ruhueng.
hypothesis: Golf nakeuh saboh game di teumpat para peumeuén meupakek kreueh untuk meukrok bola lam lueng.

source: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.
reference: Lapan Blah boh ruhueng jipeumeu’en nibak jatah meuatoeran, deungön ureueng meu’en biyasajih jimulai nibak ruhueng phôn i lapangan ngön meuakhé bak ruhueng keulapan blah.
hypothesis: 18 lueng dipeulakee seulama putaran biasa, deungen pemain biasa jih mulai di lueng awai di lapangan ngen tamat bak keu lapan blaih.

source: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.
reference: Ureueng meuen nyang cok poh nyang paling bacut, atawa geuayon tungkat, keu peuseulesoe gareh meunang.
hypothesis: Sidroe pemain nyang geucok bacut pukulan, atawa swing dari klub, keu geupeuseuleusoe kursus nyan meunang.

source: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
reference: Meueneu’en nyoe jipeumeu’en bak naleung, ngön naleung bak sangkira ruhueng jikoh leubѐh tuet ngön jikheun ijo.
hypothesis: Geulakee bak naleueng, dan naleueng di seukeulileng ruhueng dipeukoh leubeh kureung dan geuboh nan ijo.

source: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.
reference: Mungkén jinѐh jak tamasya nyang paleng ramee ureueng na keuh pue nyang ramee ureueng sangkot paot deungön jak meujak: jak tamasya jak meuramien.
hypothesis: Mungken jenis wisata yang paleng umum adalah nyang le ureung meuhubungkan deungen perjalanan: Pariwisata rekreasi.

source: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.
reference: Nyoe keuh wate ureueng jak bak teumpat nyang sep brat meubeda nibak teumpat biyasa jih siuroe-uroe udep keu meupeurasat ngön meuseunang-seunang.
hypothesis: Nyan keuh watee ureung jak bak saboh teumpat yang beda that dari kehidupan sehari-hari biasa untuk bereh dan bereh.

source: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.
reference: Pante, taman ngön meudom kayém thatjeuet keu teumpat paleng umum nyang kayém jisaweu le awak tamasya jak meuramien.
hypothesis: Pantai, taman hiburan ngen lapangan kamp seureng adalah tempat yang paling umum dikunjungi le wisatawan rekreasi.

source: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.
reference: Meuseu heut sidroe ureueng neuk meusaweu bak saboh teumpat keu neuk meuturi seujarah ngön budayajih nyoe jinѐh wisatajih jituri seubagoe budaya jak tamasya.
hypothesis: Meunyo tujuan kunjungan sidroe ureung bak saboh teumpat tertentu adalah untuk mengetahui seujarah dan budaya jih maka jenis pariwisata nyoe dikenal sebagai pariwisata budaya.

source: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
reference: Awak nyan jeuet meusaweu meupadum teumpat nyang meubeda nibak saboh nanggroe atawa awak nyan jeuet pileh keu teupat nibak saboh wilayah sagai.
hypothesis: Para wisatawan mungken geujak kalon peuneugöt nyang meubeda di saboh nanggroe tertentu atawa mungken awak nyan cuma geupiléh untuk fokus bak saboh daerah.

source: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.
reference: Kolonis, meukalon buet nyoe, ka geulakee tulong bak teuntra.
hypothesis: Kolonis, melihat aktifitas ini, juga telah menyerukan penguatan.

source: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).
reference: Pasukan teuntra geu kumiet bak ceue dikeu nyan keuh na nibak keu-1 ngön keu-3 nibak pasukan New Hampshire nyang na 200 droe ureueng, dimiyup Colonel John Stark ngön James Reed (ban duwa geuh jeuet keu jendral watee dudoe).
hypothesis: Pasukan nyang meupeukong posisi maju termasuk 1st ngen 3rd New Hampshire regiment 200 droe, dimiyueb pimpinan Kolonel John Stark ngen James Reed (kedua-dua lheuh nyan jeut keu jenderal).

source: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.
reference: Pasukan Stark geucok posisi meulinteung pageu u arah baroh ujong nibak posisi duek Kolonis.
hypothesis: Ureueng Stark jicok posisi langsong pagar bak ujong utara posisi Kolonis.

source: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.
reference: watѐe ie paseung ubuet ibuka ruwueng meulinteung i krueng Mystic arah timu laot nibakujong, ureueng nyan sigra dipeuluah ceue pageu dengön binteh bate paneuk u arah ujong baroh bak bineh ie lam saboh pante nyang ubeut.
hypothesis: Watee geulumbang rendah dipeubeukah jurang seulama Sungai Mystic seulama utara timu benua, awak nyan langsong lonek pagar seucara ubit seucara bintéh batee u utara akhé jih di pinggir ie di pantôn ubit.

source: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.
