reference: Gridley atawa Stark geupeudeng saboh tameh seulingka 100 gaki (30 m) dikeu pageu ngeon geubrie peurentah bahwasjih bek na meusidroe nyang teumimbak beudee sigolom masyarakat ka leupah atranyan.
hypothesis: Gridley atawa Stark dipeuduek tungkat kira-kira 30 meter di deungen pagar dan dipeurintah bahwa hana meusidroe pih menembak sampoe peugawée biasa melewati jih.

source: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.
reference: Rancang le Amerika nyan meuhubong ngeon titek seureubu nibak lhee boh arah nyang meubeda.
hypothesis: Rencana Amerika meugantung bak loncarkan serangan terkoordinasi dari lhee arah yang berbeda.

source: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.
reference: Jendral John Cadwalder neuk geupeulheueh seurangan keu peukachoe u sidadu Iggreh i Bordentown, ngön tujuan keupeutheun bala bantuan.
hypothesis: Jenderal John Cadwalder akan melancarkan serangan diversi terhadap garnison Inggris di Bordentown, untuk memblokir penambahan.

source: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.
reference: Jendral James Ewing geucok 700 droe teuntra meulinteung krueng I Trenton Ferry, geucok tutue di daerah Assunpink Creek ngön geutheun teuntra musoh nyang plueng peuseulamat droe.
hypothesis: Jenderal James Ewing akan geuba 700 milisi di seulatan krueng di Trenton Ferry, jicok jembatan di ateuh Assunpink Creek dan geucegah pasukan musoh dari meucre.

source: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.
reference: Bala teuntra nyan utama na keuh 2.400 droe ureueng nyang neuk geu sibrang krueng sikureueng mil nibak utara Trenton, aleuhnyan geubagi keu duwa boh pasukan, saboh dimiyup Greene ngön saboh dimiyup Sullivan, keu tujuan geu seurang sigolom suboh.
hypothesis: Pasukan serangan utama 2.400 droe akan menyeberangi krueng sikureueng mil utara Trenton, dan lheuh nyan dibagi jeut keu dua kelompok, saboh dimiyueb Greene dan saboh dimiyueb Sullivan, untuk melancarkan serangan sebelum fajar.

source: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.
reference: Dengön meuubah nibak siperpeut u siteungoh mil jiplueng, ukoe keu bagah plueng jeuet keu leubѐh hana peunteng ngön teunaga jeuet keu hai nyang keu kebutuhan.
hypothesis: Dengan perubahan dari seperempat keu sikureueng mil, kecepatan jeut jauh kureueng peunteng ngen daya tahan jeut keu kebutuhan mutlak.

source: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.
reference: Teunteejih sidroe atlet plueng glah sikhan mil keuphôn , sidroe ureueng nyang jeuet geuplueng lam duwa minet, mesti na bak gobnyan kemampuan plueng nyang bagah, tapi teunaga nyan payah na lam tip watѐe nyang sosah.
hypothesis: Teutapi sidroe half-miler kelas phon, sidroe ureueng nyang jeut ji peutaloe dua menit, meuseuti na kecepatan yang wajar, teuma daya tahan meuseuti ji peuhase bak mandum bahaya.

source: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.
reference: Ladom plueng meulingkeu nanggroe watѐe musem sijuek, meugabong ngön buet peugot bahagian ateuh badan lam teumpat gimnasium, nyan keuh buet peusiap nyang paleng get keu musem plueng.
hypothesis: Saboh balapan lintas darat watee musim dingin, dikombinasikan deungen kerja gymnasium untuk bagian atas awak, adalah persiapan yeng paleng get untuk musim balapan.

source: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.
reference: Pajôh peunajoh nyang sihat sagai nyan hana sep keu peuna teunaga nyang hayeu, tapih atranyan jeuet keu brat meuakibat nibak ureueng atlet muda keu ban mandum keuadaan nyang get.
hypothesis: Praktek gizi yang teupat hana jeut jipeuhase prestasi elite, teutapi jeut meupeungaroh that keu kesejahteraan umum atlet muda.

source: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
reference: Tapeuna keu daya kesihatan nyang timang, tapubuet cara jep ie nyang get keu lazem, ngön beu tameuphom keupadup boh hai neuk buet pajôh suplemen nyang neuk j jeuet di peu ek teunaga sidroe atlit ngön jipeu ek rasa seunang lam meuneu’en (sport).
hypothesis: Menjaga keseimbangan energi yang sehat, praktek kebiasaan hidrasi yang efektif, dan meuphom macam-macam aspek praktik suplemen jeut membantu atlet meningkatkan kinerja jih dan meningkatkan kegembiraan jih dari olahraga.

source: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.
reference: Jak plueng lam jarak nyang seudang nyan biasajih meuneu’en (sport) nyang hana meuhai;beuranggakri, ladom na salah meuphom keu padup boh alat nyang dipeureule keu jeuet ta ikot.
hypothesis: Peuplueng jarak teungoh adalah olahraga yang relatif murah; Namun, na le konsep salah tentang padum boh peralatan yang diperlukan untuk berpartisipasi.

source: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.
reference: Dabeuh jeuet keu tabloe ban lagѐe hajat, tapi dum na meuakibat bacut atawa hana sapue akibat nyang nyata nibak tampilan.
hypothesis: Produk jeut dibeli seucara diperlukan, teutapi seubagian rayek akan na bacut atawa hana dampak nyata bak kinerja.

source: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.
reference: Ureueng atlet mungkén geu rasa peureule keu dabeuh adakpi meungnyo dabeuh nyan hana meusapu na manfaah nyang nyata.
hypothesis: Atlet mungken meurasa bahwa awak nyan leubeh galak keu saboh produk meskipun hana meuguna nyata.

source: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
reference: Atom jeuet takheun seubagoe saboh hai nyang keuh asai nibak mandum beunda nyang na.
hypothesis: Atom jeut dianggap seubagai salah saboh blok bangunan mendasar dari mandum materi.

source: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
reference: Nyoe na keuh saboh hai nyang sep meucawoe nyang dipeuna, nyang dikheun le model Bohr nyang seudang, nibak saboh inti atom nyang jiteungoh dikeulileng le elektron, lagѐe hi planet jikeulileng mata uroe – neukalon Gamba 1.1.
hypothesis: Nyo adalah entitas yeng sangat kompleks yeng terdiri, meunurot model Bohr yeng disederhanakan, dari inti pusat yeng jikeulileng le elektron, yeng agak mirip deungen planet yeng jikeulileng Matahari - kalon Gambar 1.1.

source: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
reference: Inti atom nyan na keuh nibak duwa boh partikel – neutron ngön proton.
hypothesis: Inti terdiri dari dua partikel - neutron ngen proton.

source: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
reference: Proton nyan na saboh muatan listrek nyang positif ngön neutron hana muatan meusaboh pih. Elektron na muatan listrek negatif.
hypothesis: Proton na muatan listrik positif sementara neutron hana muatan elektron na muatan listrik negatif.

source: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.
reference: Keu takalon ureueng ceulaka, gata suwah keuphôn that neukalon keuadaan keu peu aman droe dile.
hypothesis: Untuk teupareksa korban, awak harus phon-phon teureksa tempat kejadian untuk memastikan keselamatan awak.

source: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.
reference: Gata suwah neuteupue dipat teuh ureueng nyang ceulaka nyan watѐe neu peutoe gobnyan ngön bagoe keuadaan ceulaka nyang laen.
hypothesis: Neupeurati posisi korban bak watée awak jak bak jih dan tanda-tanda beureuguih secara otomatis.

source: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
reference: Miseue gata saket watee neutulong, gata mungkén peuget hai nyang meutamah leubѐh brok.
hypothesis: Meunyoe gata luka meunyoe gata cuba bantu, nyan teuma jeuet keusabab peukara leubeh brat lom.

source: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
reference: Peuneulitian meureumpok depresi nyan, yoe ngön bala sinambong nibak rasa saket ngön ceudra bak ureueng saket rueng imiyub.
hypothesis: Penelitian nyan meurumpok bahwa depresi, takot ngen bencana mediasi hubungan antara nyeri ngen cacat bak penderita nyeri punggung.

source: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
reference: Peungaroh nibak bala sagai, koen depresi ngön yoe nyang keuh syarat nibak sesi PA meususon tiep aleuhad meuatoe.
hypothesis: Hanya efek dari bencana, bukan depresi ngen takot terkondisikan deungen sesi PA terstruktur mingguan biasa.

source: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.
reference: Awak nyan geuikot lam buet uroe meuatoe peurle leubѐh jai dukong bak persepsi negatif saket keu peubeda rasa saket parah ngön rasa hana mangat nibak meugrak tuboh lagѐe biyasa.
hypothesis: Ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meusapat dalam aktivitas reguler peureulèë dukungan leubeh rayek lam hal persepsi negatif seudeh yang membedakan perbedaan rasa nyeri kronis dan ketidaknyamanan dari gerakan fisik biasa.

source: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.
reference: Meukaloen, atawa keu geukalon meunurot bak sistim visual sensori anggota tuboh atawa mata.
hypothesis: Visi, atawa keupayaan untuk kalon meugantung bak sistem visual organ sensor atau mata.

source: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.
reference: Na padum-padum boh nyang meulaen meunyum saket nibak mata, mulai bak payah maunuroet bak syarat peuneujeuet poe.
hypothesis: Na le konstruksi mata nyang meubeda, yeng meubeda dalam kompleksitas tergantung pada persyaratan organisme.

source: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.
reference: Na padum-padum rasa saket nyang meulaen meunyum saket meulaen, hanjeuet teupeh angen keu panyang-geulumbang meubeda ngön na tingkat meubeda bagahjih, cit awak nyan peureulee peugoet meubeda keu peugot itamoeng ngön numboi meubeda keu keurija nyang pah.
hypothesis: Konstruksi yeng meubeda na keupayaan yeng meubeda, sensitif keu panyang gelombang yeng meubeda ngen na tingkat keukuatan yeng meubeda, cit awak nyan merlukeun proses yeng meubeda untuk meuphom input ngen bilangan yeng meubeda untuk bekerja seucara optimal.

source: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.
reference: Populasi nakeuh meusapat makhlouk nibak jinѐh meuteunte lam wilayah geografi nyang pah.
hypothesis: populasi adalah kumpulan organisme spesies tertentu dalam wilayah geografis tertentu.

source: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.
reference: Watѐe mandum ureueng lam saboh populasi jipeusama deungön sifeut fenotipik awak nyan dipeugah seubagoe monomorfik.
hypothesis: Watee mandum individu dalam saboh populasi adalah sama sehubungan ngen sifat fenotip tertentu awak nyan dikenal seubagai monomorf.

source: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.
reference: watѐe individu geupetunyok padum boh jinѐh nibak sifeut meuteunte awak nyan polimorfik.
hypothesis: Watee individu menunjukkan padum-padum varian dari ciri khas nyan polymorphic.

source: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.
reference: Koloni sidom teuntra meubareh ngon meuumpung lam masa meubeda cit.
hypothesis: Koloni semut angkatan prang meulayeue dan meutabu dalam fase yeng meubeda cit.

source: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
reference: Lam masa meupinah-pinah, sidom teuntra meubareh bak malam uroe ngön jipiyoh jidom bak cot uroe.
hypothesis: Lam fase nomad, semut angkatan prang jijak bak malam dan berhenti bak kem bak uroe.

source: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.
reference: Koloni geupuphôn masa meupinah-pinah watѐe kubah eumpeuen ka meukureung. Nibak masa nyoe, koloni geupeugot umpung siat nyang meugantoe tiep uroe.
hypothesis: Koloni dimulai fase nomad wate peunajoh nyang na meurang. Lam fase nyoe, koloni nyan jipeuget sarang sementara nyang jiubah tieb-tieb uroe.

source: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.
reference: Tiep meupinah-pinah karu atawa pawei na meu 17 uroe.
hypothesis: Masing-masing rampage atau marches nomad nyoe berlangsung selama kira-kira 17 uroe.

source: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.
reference: Peu nyan sel? Kata sel meuasai nibak kata Laten "cella", makeusudjih "ruheung ubeut", ngön nyan keuphôn dipeugot le sidroe ahli mikroskop nyang geuamati struktur nibak gaboh.
hypothesis: Peu kheueh nyan saboh sel? Kata sel teuka nibak basa Latin "cella", nyang makna jih "ruweueng ubit", dan phon-phon that geupeugöt lé sidroe ahli mikroskop nyang teungoh geupeurati struktur bakong.

source: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
reference: Sel nakeuh sipu-pue muasai nibak mandum makhlouk hudep, ngön mandum makhlouk hudep meususon nibak saboh atawa leubѐh sel.
hypothesis: Sel adalah unit dasar mandum makhluk hidup, dan mandum organisme terdiri dari saboh atawa le sel.

source: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
reference: Sel meuasai that ngön peunteng keu meureuno nibak hudep, sebeutoijih, awak nyan kayém dipeugah seubagoe “dabeuh peunyuson hudep”.
hypothesis: Sel-sel nyan sangat mendasar dan kritis untuk studi kehidupan, bahkan, bahwa awak nyan seureng ditudohkan sebagai "blok bangunan kehidupan".

source: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.
reference: Sistem saraf geupeulhara homeostasis deungön geukirѐm impuls saraf bak saboh tuboh keu geujaga ilee darah teutap dijak ngön hana karu.
hypothesis: Sistem saraf geujaga homeostasis deungen geu kirém impuls saraf melalui awak keu geujaga aliran darah berjalan meunan cit hana geuganggu.

source: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
reference: Impuls saraf nyoe jeuet jikirѐm deungön bagah bak saboh tuboh nyang geujaga tuboh teutap aman nibak mandum potensi ancaman.
hypothesis: Impulse saraf nyoe jeut geu kirém seucara sigra bansaboh tuboh nyang membantu menjaga tuboh aman dari ancaman potensial.

source: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
reference: Angen puteng beuliyoung geuseurang wilayah ubeut jibandeng deungön badei rayeuk laen, tapih nyanjeuet geupeuanco mandum bak rauh droejih.
hypothesis: Tornado meucarueh saboh wilayah ubit dibandingkan badai nyang teuga laen, teuma awak nyan jeut jipeuhanco mandum nyang na bak rot jih.

source: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
reference: Angen puteng beuliyoung peureubah bak-bak kayee, peuleuekang papeun –papeun geudoeng, ngön ipapoe moto-moto u langet. Duwa peureusen dari angen nyang paleng brat nyan leubѐh nibak lhee jeum.
hypothesis: Tornado meucrebre bak-bak kayée, meucrebre papan-papan bangunan, dan meucrebre geuritan-geuritan u langet.

source: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
reference: Bade rayeuek nyoe sep teuga angen sampoe 480 km/jam (133 m/s; 300 mph).
hypothesis: Badai monster nyo na angén sampoe 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

source: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.
reference: Ureueng-ureueng ka geupeugoet ngön geupeuguna lensa keu tapeurayeuk nibak trep meuribei – ribei thon.
hypothesis: Manusia ka jipeuget dan meupakek lensa untuk memperbesar selama meuribée dan meuribée thon.

source: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.
reference: Beuranggandum, seubeutoijih phôn that na teleskop geupeugoet le ureueng Eropa bak akhé abad keu-16.
hypothesis: Namun, teleskop asli phon dipeuget di Eropa bak akhe abad keu-16.

source: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.
reference: Teleskop nyoe geupakek seunapat duwa boh lensa keu geupeugoet objek nyang jioh beudeuh leubѐh toe ngön rayeuk
hypothesis: Teleskop-teleskop nyoe dipakek kombinasi dua lensa untuk meuget objek-objek yang jiôh deuh leubeh rab ngen leubeh rayek.

source: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly
reference: Jumoh ngön kreuh utak ka sabѐe sajan tanyoe ngön nyankeuh sifeut keureujasama alami bak wate laba umumjih jai lam siklep geupikee keudroe geuh sagai.
hypothesis: Cilaka dan egoisme akan sabe na bak geutanyoe dan adalah sifat kerjasama bahwa watee mayoritas meuguna akan sabe na leubeh untuk keuntungan dalam jangka pendek dengan bertindak egois

source: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
reference: Beurijang, jai ureueng geutupue bahwa pilehan nyang get nyang trep nyankeuh geukeureuja saban ngön ureueng laen.
hypothesis: Mudah-mudahan, le ureung akan sadar bahwa pilihan terbaik lam jangka panjang jih adalah bekerja sama ngon ureung laen.

source: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.
reference: Na padum droe ureueng geumeulumpoe bak siuroe manusiya troek geujak u bintang-bintang nyang laen ngön geujeulajah donya, na padum droe ureueng geutanyoeng-tanyoeng pue nyang na iluwa hideh na ta pateh alien atawa mungkén na laen nyang udep.
hypothesis: Le that ureung meulumpo uroe watee manusia jeut geujak u bintang laen dan menjelajahi donya laen, padum-padum ureung hireuen peue nyang na di luwa nyan padum-padum nyang percaya bahwa makhluk asing atau kehidupan laen mungken udep di tanaman laen.

source: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".
reference: Tapi, meunyoe nyoe tom meudali mungkén ka meudali keu wate nyang trep. Bintang-bintang meunan meusipreuk sampoe na meulion-lion mil nibak bintang-bintang "ureueng lingka".
hypothesis: Teuma, meunyoe nyoe ka teujadi mungken hana teuma teujadi lam watee nyang panyang. Bintang-bintang nyan meutabu sampoe na triliun-triliun mil antara bintang-bintang nyang "tetangga".

source: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
reference: Mungkén bak saboh jan, cucoe droe neuh jidoeng bak puncak donya luwa nyan ka jitanyoen-tanyoeng keu arwah endatu?
hypothesis: Mungken saboh uroe, cucoe-cucoe gata teuma jidong di ateueh donya nyang laén dan teumanyong keuhai indatu awaknyan nyang awai?

source: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
reference: Binatang dipeugot dari jai sel-sel. Awak nyan dipajôh sipeue-peue lheueh nyan dicerna nyan i dalam. Dum meulatang jeuet meugrak.
hypothesis: Hewan dipeuget dari le sel. awak nyan pajoh peue-peue nyang na dan jicerna lam tuboh awak nyan. La'én-la'én beulatang nyan jeut meu-ubah.

source: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).
reference: Tok meulatang nyang na utak (adakpih hana mandum meulatang na; abo-abo, cuntohjih, hana utak).
hypothesis: Hanya binatang yeng na otak (meskipun bahkan hana mandum binatang yeng na; jellyfish, miseu jih, hana otak).

source: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.
reference: Meulatang jeuet diteumee bak dumpat teumpat di bumoe. Awak nyan dimeukueh lam tanoh, dimeulangu lam laot, ngön dipho bak langet.
hypothesis: Beulatang-beulatang na di bansigom bumoe.

source: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
reference: Sel nyankeuh hai nyang meususon ngön nyang meufungsi bak saboh makhéuluk (beunda-beunda) udep.
hypothesis: Sel adalah unit struktural ngen fungsi yeng paleng ubit dari organisme udep (hal-hal).

source: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
reference: Sel asaijih dari kata Laten cella nyang artijih kama ubeut.
hypothesis: Cell teuka nibak kata Latin cella nyang makna jih ruweueng ubit.

source: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
reference: Meunyo neukalon bak makhéuluk udep deungon mikroskop, gata jeuet neukalon awak nyan dipeugot dari kotak-kotak ubeut atawa bola.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak kalon makhluk udeb di bawah mikroskop, awak nyan akan takalon bahwa awak nyan teupeuget nibak kuadrat ubit atawa bola.

source: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
reference: Robert Hooke, sidroe ahli biologi asai Inggreh, geukalon tong-tong peuet sagoe ubeut i dalam gaboh deungon saboh mikroskop.
hypothesis: Robert Hooke, sidroe ahli biologi dari Inggréh, deuh jikalon kuadrat ubit lam cork ngon mikroskop.

source: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
reference: Kutak-kutak nyan deuh lagѐe kama-kama. Gobnyan keuh ureueng nyang phôn geupareksa sel mate
hypothesis: Awaknyan deuh jih lagée kamar. Gobnyan kheueh nyang phon-phon that geupeurati sel-sel nyang ka maté

source: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
reference: Zat-zat ngön senyawa-senyawa jeuet diminah dari saboh sipheuet u sipheuet laen ngön hana meugantoe.
hypothesis: Unsur dan senyawa jeut ji pindahkan dari saboh keadaan keu yang laen dan hana ji ubah.

source: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
reference: Nitrogen seubagoe saboh gah mantông na hai-hai nyang saban deungon nitrogen caye. Sipheuet caye nyan leubѐh kreueh teutapi molekul-molekuljih teutap saban.
hypothesis: Nitrogèn seubagai gas mantong na sifeut yang sama seubagai nitrogèn cair. Nanggroe cair leubeh padet teuma molekul-molekul nyan mantong saban.

source: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
reference: Ie nyankeuh saboh cuntoh nyang laen. Senyawa ie nyan dipeugot dari duwa boh atom-atom hydrogen ngön saboh atom oksigen.
hypothesis: Banyu adalah contoh laen. Banyu gabungan terdiri dari dua atom hidrogen ngen saboh atom oksigen.

source: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
reference: Nyan na susonan molekul nyang saban peuekeuh nyan saboh gah, caye, atawa kreueh.
hypothesis: Jih na struktur molekuler yang sama peu kheueh nyan gas, cair, atawa padet.

source: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
reference: Adakpih sipheuet beuntukjih jeuet meugantoe, sipheuet kimiajih teutap saban.
hypothesis: Meskipun keadaan fisik jih jeut meubah, keadaan kimia jih tetap sama.

source: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
reference: Saboh jan nyankeuh sipue nyan kana silingka tanyoe, deungön jipeungaroh mandum nyang tanyoe pubuet, bahpih payah ta meuphom.
hypothesis: Watee adalah sesuatu nyang na di sekitar geutanyoe, dan mempengaruhi mandum nyang tanyoe peubuet, tapi payah that meuphom.

source: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.
reference: Saboh jan ka jimeurunoe le awak sarjana agama, filosofi, ngön euleumee alam keu meuribe thon.
hypothesis: Seulama meuribée-ribée thon, masa ka ji peuruno lé ureuëng-ureuëng meurunoe agama, filsafat, ngon ilme-ilme ilmiah.

source: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
reference: Tanyoe tapeurasa watѐe sebagoe saboh keujadian nyang ka ulikot nibak masa ukeu roet masa jinoe ngön masa ka ulikot.
hypothesis: Geutanyoe ta alami wate seubagai serangkaian peristiwa nyang geujak dari masa ukeu meulalu masa kini keu masa lampau.

source: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
reference: Saboh jan sit kiban tapeubandeng watѐe (panyang) keujadian.
hypothesis: Wate cit adalah cara geutanyoe peubandeng durasi (panjang) peristiwa.

source: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
reference: Droeneuh jeuet neutanda abeh watѐe keudroe ngön neukaloen lom siklus keujadian. Siklus keujadian nyankeuh sipue nyang keujadian meuulang lom seucara meususon.
hypothesis: Gata keudroe pih jeuet taingat bahwa masa teungoh jak deungon cara gata kalon peunyaket-peunyaket seucara meugantoe-gantoe. Peunyaket meugantoe-gantoe na kheueh peunyaket nyang teujadi sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sigoe sig

source: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.
reference: Komputer jinoe ka jingui keu tapeuna-peuna gamba ngön video.
hypothesis: Komputer jinoe dipakek untuk meu manipulasi gamba ngen video.

source: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.
reference: Animasi hayeu jeuet tapeugoet bak komputer, ngön jeunѐh animasi nyan kop jai jingui bak tivi ngön bak pileuem.
hypothesis: Animasi canggih jeut dipeuget bak komputer, dan jenis animasi nyoe semakin dipakek di televisi ngen pilem.

source: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.
reference: Lagu kayém jireukam ngön komputer nyang hayeu keu jipeugot ngön jipeusapat su.
hypothesis: Musik seureng direkam ngen dipakek komputer canggih untuk meuproses dan meucampur su bersama.

source: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
reference: Keu watѐe nyang trep seulama abad keusikuereueng blah ngön keu duwa ploh, jiyakin bahwasajih masyarakat phôn Selandia Baro na keuh ureueng Maori, nyang meuburu cicem raksasa nyang geukheun moas.
hypothesis: Seulama seulama seulama abad keu sikureueng blah dan dua ploh, jih diyakini penduduk phon Selandia Baru adalah ureung Maori, yang geujeut cicém rayek yang dikhen moas.

source: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
reference: Tiori nyan keuh nyang peuteutap pikѐran bahwa ureueng-ureueng Maori geupinah nibak Polinesia lam Armada Rayeuk ngön geujok Selandia Baro nibak Moriori, meubentok masyarakat meugle.
hypothesis: Teori nyan lheuh nyan geupeudong ide bahwa ureung Maori berei dari Polinesia dalam armada rayek dan geucok Selandia Baru dari Moriori, geupeudong masyarakat pertanian.

source: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
reference: Beuranggandum, bukti baro geupeutunyok bahwa Moriori na keuh saboh keulompok Maori darat nyang meumigrasi nibak Selandia Baro u Pulo Clatham, jipeukeumbang keuh budaya dame ngön khas awak nyan keudroe ih.
hypothesis: Namun, bukti baroe teuntang bahwa Moriori adalah saboh kelompok Maori daratan yeng bermigrasi dari Selandia Baru keu Kepulauan Chatham, mengembangkan budaya khas, damai jih keudroe.

source: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
reference: Disinan na cit suku nyang laen lam pulo Chatham nyan na keuh Maori nyang jioh diminah dari Selandia Baru.
hypothesis: Na cit saboh sukée la'én di pulo Chatham nyan ureueng Maori nyang meuimigrasi dari Selandia Baru.

source: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
reference: Awaknyan dihei droeih ureueng Moriori disinan na padup droe teuntra ubit ngön di akhé buet, ureueng Moriori nyan kahabeh meusampoh
hypothesis: Awaknyan jiboh nan droe jih Moriori na padum boh skirmish dan bak akhé jih, Moriori ka teupeubinasa

source: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
reference: Ureueng sidroe-droe nyang na tom meupadup-padup thon geutulong kamoe geuhargai teunaga kamoe ngön seumangat watѐe deuh trang geunilai meubagoe ujoe atawapih hana wase.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng nyang ka meu-udeung lam padum-padum ploh thon ka jitulông kamoe meuteumei kekuatan dan hasrat kamoe seudangkan secara tulus meupeureksa masalah dan bahkan gagal.

source: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
reference: Watѐe meudeungoe sidroe-droe ureueng geupeugah calitra pribadi, keuluwarga, ngön organisasi, kamoe meuteume eleuemee nyang lhok bhah masa awai ngön ladom sidroe-droe nyang geubi peungaroh nyang get atawa brok lam budaya organisasi.
hypothesis: Teungoh kamoe deungoe individu-individu meucalitra kisah droe jih, keluarga, dan organisasi, kamoe meuteumé peungeurtian nyang meupeunteng keuhai masa dilée dan padum-padum-padum droe ureueng-ureueng nyang meupeungaroh keu nyang jroh atawa keu nyang brok bak budaya organisasi.

source: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
reference: Adakpi tameuphom keu riwayat sidroe ureueng hana meutentee keu tameuphom saboh budaya, nyoe na keuh geutulong ureueng bak geuteume bacut hai nibak pat rhot ureuengnyan lam saboh seujarah organisasi.
hypothesis: Seudangkan meuphom seujarah sidroe han geu anggap meuphom budaya, nyan seucara minimal geutulông ureung meuphom teumpat awak nyan na lam seujarah organisasi.

source: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
reference: Adakpi tanilai wase ngön ta teupue hai nyang hanjeuet keu wase, sidroe-sidroe ureueng ngön mandum nyang geuperoh droe jeuet geuteume nilai nyang leubѐh lhok, tujuan, ngön daya teunaga lam organisasi.
hypothesis: Seulama meunilai keberhasilan ngen jeut keu sadar akan kegagalan, individu ngen mandum ureung nyang berpartisipasi deuh deuh leubeh dalam nilai-nilai, misi, dan kekuatan pendorong organisasi.

source: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
reference: Lam tamsee nyoe, takaloen lom tamsee-tamsee nyang ka ulikot dari peukateun cara meukat ngön meuhase wase nyang jeuet geutulong urueng keu leubѐh geuteurimong hai nyang ka meuganto baro ngön arah u geureja lingka disinan.
hypothesis: Lam peukara nyoe, mengingat contoh-contoh awai dari perilaku wirausaha dan keberhasilan yang dihasilkan membantu ureung untuk terbuka untuk perubahan baro dan arah baro untuk gereja lokal.

source: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
reference: Kisah meuwase nyang jeuet geupeukureueng rasa yo keu perobahan, watѐe jipeuna hai nyang get nyang jundrong u perobahan u keu.
hypothesis: Kisah-kisah sukses lagee nyan jipeuteun peurasaan takot keu perubahan, seudangkan ji peuget kecenderungan positif keu perubahan di masa ukeu.

source: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
reference: Pola pike konvergen nakeuh teknik pemecahan masalah nyang geupeusahoe ide-ide atawa bidang-bidang nyang meubeda keujeut meurumpok solusi.
hypothesis: Pola pemikiran konvergen adalah teknik pemecahan masalah yeng menyatukan ide atau bidang yeng meubeda untuk meurumpok solusi.

source: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
reference: Fokus pola piké nyoë nakeuh kecepatan, logika ngön akurasi, na cit identifikasi fakta, menerapkan keulai teknik nyang na, geupeusahoë informasi.
hypothesis: Fokus pola pikir nyoe adalah kecepatan, logika ngen akurasi, cit identifikasi fakta, menerapkan ulang teknik yang na, pengumpulan informasi.

source: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
reference: Faktor teupenténg dari pola piké nyoë nakeuh: hanya na saboh jawaban nyang beutôi. Droëneuh hanya neupiké dua jawaban, yaitu beutôi atawa salah.
hypothesis: Faktor nyang paleng peunteng lam pola pikir nyoe nakeuh: na saboh jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët jeuët

source: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
reference: Jeunéh seumikèë nyoë jipeuhubông deungön éuleumèë atawa prosedur standar teuteuntèë.
hypothesis: Jenis pemikiran nyo ka dikaitkan deungen ilme-ilmu tertentu atau prosedur standar.

source: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
reference: Ureuëng deungön tipe pemikiran nyoë po pemikiran nyang logis, sanggôp geuingat pola, peuseuleusoe masalah ngön pubuët tes ilmiah.
hypothesis: Ureueng nyang na tipe pemikiran nyo na pemikiran logis, jeut ji ingat pola, dipecahkan masalah dan meubuet bak tes ilmiah.

source: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
reference: Manusiya sampoe uroenyo nakeuh nyang paleng hayeu dalam geubaca asoe pikiran ureueng laen.
hypothesis: Manusia adalah spesies nyang paleng berbakat dalam meurunoe pikeran ureung laen.

source: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.
reference: Nyan meumakna bahwasajih geutanyoe ngön mudah jeuet ta kira pu nyang ureueng laen teurimong, neuheut, pateh, teupu atawa hawa.
hypothesis: Meukeusut jih tanyoe jeut meuhase ta prediksi peue nyang manusia laen persepsi, berniat, percaya, tahu atau meuheuet.

source: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.
reference: Nibak keuleubѐhan nyoe, meuphom le geutanyo akan ureueng laen nyan peunteng. Nyoe akan jeuet keugeutanyo keu ta seuleuso pue nyang hana jeulah dari buet nyata.
hypothesis: Di antara keupayaan nyo, meuphom niat ureung laen sangat peunteng.

source: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.
reference: Keu tamsee, meungnyo neukalon sidroe ureueng geukho’ gaca jeundela moto, gata mungkén akan neupikee bahwasjih ureuengnyan teungoh geu cuba geucu moto ureueng laen.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, meunyo awak kalon na ureuëng nyang peureuloh tingkap mobil, awak nyan mungken meurasa awak nyan teungoh jicok mobil ureuëng nyang hana awak awak nyan.

source: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
reference: Ureueng nyan akan laen lom dipike le ureueng meungnyo gobnyan ka gadeh gunci moto geuh ngön nyan keuh moto atra gobnyan kedroe nyang teungoh geucuba tameng u dalam.
hypothesis: Jihnyan harôh teupeusidang ngon cara nyang laén meunyoe jihnyan ka gadôh kunci mobil jih dan nyan na kheueh mobil jih keudroe nyang jikeuneuk tamong lam nyan.

source: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
reference: MRI nyan ateuh dasar saboh fenomena nyata nyang dikheun sabagoe resonansi magnet inti (NMR), nyang geuteume wate thon 1930an le Felix Bloch (nyang geukeureuja bak Universitas Stanford) ngön Edward Purcell (nibak Universitas Harvard).
hypothesis: MRI didasarkan bak fenomena fisika yeng geukheun resonansi magnetik nuklir (NMR), yeng diteumeung bak thon 1930-an le Felix Bloch (garap di Universitas Stanford) ngen Edward Purcell (dari Universitas Harvard).

source: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
reference: Lam resonansi nyoe, bideung magnet ngön geulumbang radio geupeujeuet atom keu i peuteubit sinyal radio nyang haloh.
hypothesis: Lam resonansi nyoe, medan magnet dan gelombang radio menyebabkan atom untuk peulheueh sinyal radio ubit.

source: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
reference: Lam watee thon 1970, Raymond Damadian, sidroe dokter medis ngön sidroe eleumewan riset, geuteume asai dari geungui resonansi magnet keu gamba sabagoe saboh dabeuh keu diagnosa medis.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1970, Raymond Damadian, dokter medis ngen ilmuwan penelitian, geumita dasar untuk meupakek magnetic resonance imaging seubagai alat untuk diagnosis medis.

source: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
reference: Peuet thon dudoe saboh paten ka geubrie, nyang keu paten nyang keuphôn that na lam bideung MRI.
hypothesis: Peuet thon lheuh nyan paten dipeuteubiet, yang merupakan paten phon di donya nyang dipeuteubiet lam bidang MRI.

source: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
reference: Lam 1977, Dr. Damadian geupeuleuh peunyang geupeuget akan keuphôn that dari “saboh-badan” dabeu MRI keu scan, nyang jiboh nan le gobnyan sebagoe “Indomitable”.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1977, Dr. Damadian geupeuseuleusoe peugot scanner MRI keu phon, nyang geuboh nan Indomitable.

source: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.
reference: Komunikasi nyang hana meusambong peureulee keu watѐe keu takalon droe ngön jawaban dari ureueng.
hypothesis: Komunikasi asinkron mendorong watee untuk merenung dan bereaksi bak ureung laen.

source: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
reference: Nyoe akan dipeujeuet murid keu dikeureuja lam langkah droejih ngön jeuet ta jaga Langkah dari peurintah informasi.
hypothesis: Meujok keupayaan keu mahasiswa untuk bekerja bak laju droe jih dan kontrol laju informasi instruksi.

source: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
reference: Keutamah, na bacut wate nyang ditheun dengön watѐe keureuja nyang mungkén jeuet ta ubah. (Bremer, 1998)
hypothesis: Seulaén nibak nyan, na kureuëng kureuëng peunténg masa deungon kemungkinan jamén kerja nyang fleksibel (Bremer, 1998)

source: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
reference: Ngui keu internet ngön Jareng Luah Donya nyan jeuet keu sidreo ureueng nyan keugeucok dum informasi lam saban watee.
hypothesis: Penggunaan internet ngen World Wide Web memungkinkan para pelajar untuk na akses keu informasi bak mandum wate.

source: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
reference: Murid nyan jeuet cit geujok pertanyaan lam meubagoe watee lam si uroe ngön gueharap jaweub nyan bagah, nibak suwah preh oh watee meureumpok seucara lansong.
hypothesis: Murit-murit jeut cit geukirém pertanyaan keu instruktur bak jeueb-jeueb watee uroe dan berharap jawaban yeng lubeh cepat, daripada geupreh sampoe pertemuan meuhadab keue yeng seulanjut jih.

source: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
reference: Geupeutoe meurenoe cara nyang leubѐh maju geupeutaba keubebasan nibak absolut. Hana saboh cara nyang get keu meureunoe.
hypothesis: Pendekatan posmodern untuk meurunoe na meubri kebebasan dari mutlak. Hana saboh cara yang jroh untuk meurunoe.

source: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
reference: Deuh takaloen, hana saboh hai nyang get keu meurenoe. Meurenoe jeuet nibak peungalaman ureueng meurenoe ngön ileume nyang na.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, hana saboh hal nyang jroh keu teumeurunoe.Pelajaran terjadi lam pengalaman antara peulajar dan pengetahuan nyang geupeutrang.

source: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
reference: Peungalaman kamoe saat nyoe deungön pubuet-keudroe ngön informasi nyang na, meurenoe-meudasar acara tivi meugamba hai nyoe.
hypothesis: Keujadian geutanyoe bak saat nyoe deungen mandum acara televisi berbasis pembelajaran, do-it-yourself dan presentasi informasi, geu ilustrasikan hal nyoe.

source: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
reference: Jai that nibak geutanyoe meureumpok droe geukalon acara tivi nyang ipeuleumah geutanyoe saboh buet atawa peungalaman bak geutanyoe hantom sapeu kheun atawa ngui ileume nyan.
hypothesis: Le that nibak geutanyoe nyang kalon saboh acara televisi nyang geupeutrang keu geutanyoe saboh proses atawa pengalaman nyang tanyoe hanjeut ta tamong lam atawa ta peujak peungeurtian nyan.

source: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
reference: Geutanyoe hantom peugot saboh moto, geupeudong ie mancue bak likot rumoh geutanyoe, saweu u Peru keu pareksa runtohan jameun, atawa peugot teuma rumoh ureueng silingka geutanyoe.
hypothesis: Hana mungken geutanyoe ta peugot lom saboh ôt, ta peugot mata ié bak peulataran geutanyoe, ta jak u Peru keu tajak kalon rungka-rungka kuno, atawa ta peugot lom rumoh waréh lingka geutanyoe.

source: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
reference: Beurkat link kawat optic imiyup laot u Eropa ngön sateulit broadband, Greenland ka meusambong ngön 93% populasi na geuakses internet.
hypothesis: Berkat koneksi kabel serat optik bawah laut keu Eropa ngen satelit broadband, Greenland na koneksi nyang get deungen 93% populasi nyang na akses internet.

source: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
reference: Hotel atawa ureueng rumoh gata (miseu tinggai bak wisma atawa rumoh droe) mungkén na wifi atawa PC meusambong bak internet, ngön mandum teumpat na warong internet atawa padum boh teumpat deungön wifi ureueng ramee.
hypothesis: Hotel atawa tuan rumah droeneuh ( meunyo droeneuh tinggai di rumoh tamu atawa rumoh pribadi) mungken na wifi atawa PC nyang terhubung internet, dan mandum pemukiman na internet cafe atawa na saboh lokasi nyang na wifi umum.

source: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.
reference: Lagee jiseubot di ateueh, bahpih kata "Eskimo" jiteurimong di Amerika Seurikat, kata nyan jianggap meupeureundah ureueng-ureueng nyang kon Amerika. Ureueng Arctic, teukeuphon that ureueng Kanada.
hypothesis: Lagee yang di peugah di ateuh, meskipun kata "Eskimo" tetap diterima di Amerika Serikat, nyan dianggap pejoratif le masyarakat Arktik yang hana di Amerika Serikat, terutama di Kanada.

source: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.
reference: Bahpih mungken gata meudeungo kata nyan jipakek le peundudok aseuli Greenland, nyang jipakek nyan wajeb jise le ureueng aseng.
hypothesis: Seudangkan awak droeneuh jeut tadeungo kata nyang dipakek le ureung asli Groenlandia, penggunaan jih harus dihindari le ureung asing.

source: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
reference: Peundudok aseuli Greenland jiseubot droejih seubagoe ureueng Inuit di Kanada ngon Kalaalleq (jamak Kalaallit), saboh peundudok Greenland, di Greenland.
hypothesis: Penduduk asli Greenland geukheun droe jih Inuit di Kanada ngen Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), sidroe Greenlander, di Greenland.

source: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."
reference: Buet broek, ngoen niet broek keu ureueng aseng bak umumjih, seubeutoijih karab hana geuturi bak Greenland. Adakpi i kuta, hideh hana "dairah gasa."
hypothesis: Kejahatan, dan keujeuhetan terhadap ureuëng aséng secara umum, hana jeumeulah jih di Greenland. Bahkan di banda-banda, hana "wilayah-wilayah kasar".

source: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
reference: Cuwaca leupie mungken saboh bahya nyang deuh geuneuk hadapi le ureueng nyang hana ase.
hypothesis: Cuaca dingin mungken merupakan bahaya nyata yang akan dihadapi ureung nyang hana siap.

source: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
reference: Meunyoe neujak saweu Greenland seulama masa leupie (beuteuingat maken jioh u baroh neujak, maken brat leupie), nyoe peureulee tame bajee nyang sep seuuem bacut.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak jak u Greenland bak musim dingin (meungingat bahwa leubeh utara awak jak, leubeh dingin akan), penting untuk geuba peukayan nyang leupie.

source: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.
reference: Uroe nyang panyang bak musem seuuem jeuet keu seubab peukara hana sep eh ngoen teusangkot peukara keusihatan.
hypothesis: Uroe-uroe nyang panyang that bak musim panas jeut keu masalah get get get dan masalah kesehatan nyang terkait.

source: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.
reference: Nibak musem seuuem, beuteugoh that sit keu jamok Nordik. Adakpih jamok nyan hana jipeuek dum penyaket, jamok nyan jeuet keu deuge teuh.
hypothesis: Seulama musim panas, jaga-jaga cit keu nyamuk Nordic. Bah pih awak nyan hana meupeularkan peunyakét, awak nyan jeut keu peuseunang.

source: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.
reference: Adakpih ekonomi San Fransisco meusangkot ngön nyan keu galak jamѐe glah-donya, ekonomi jih kaleuh jipareksa mandum.
hypothesis: Seudangkan ekonomi San Francisco terikat deungen jih jeut atraksi wisata kelas donya, ekonomi jih terdiversifikasi.

source: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.
reference: Sektor teunaga keureja paleng rayeuk nakeuh jasa profesional, pomeurintah, keuangan, meudagang, ngön pariwisata.
hypothesis: Sektor pekerjaan yeng paleng rayek adalah layanan profesional, pemerintah, keuangan, perdagangan, ngen pariwisata.

source: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.
reference: Nyan gamba nyang kayém lam lagu, pileuem, sastra ngön budaya meuceuhu ka geubantu peugot kuta ngön landmark diteupue bak sigom donya.
hypothesis: Penggambaran seureng jih lam musik, pilem, sastra ngen budaya populer ka membantu membuat kota dan landmark jih dikenal di seluruh dunia.

source: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.
reference: San Fransisco ka geukeumbangkan infrastruktur peungunjong nyang rayeuk deungön le hotel, teumpat seumajoh, ngön teumpat keuseupakatan glah-ateuh.
hypothesis: San Francisco ka geupeugöt infrastruktur wisata yang rayek deungen le hotel, restoran, ngen fasilitas konvensi teruna.

source: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
reference: San Fransisco nakeuh saboh teumpat paleng get bak nanggroe nyan keu seumajoh Asia laen: Korea, Thailand, India, ngön Jepang.
hypothesis: San Francisco juga salah saboh tempat terbaik di nanggroe untuk masakan Asia laen: Korea, Thailand, India, ngen Jepang.

source: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.
reference: Meusaweu u Walt Disney World nakeuh ziarah keuphôn keu jai keuluwarga Ameurika.
hypothesis: Meujak u Walt Disney World meuwakili peumbagian rayek keu le keluarga Amerika.

source: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.
reference: Saweu "khas" geupeutamoeng poe u Bandara Internasional Orlando, ek moto bes u saboh teumpat hotel Disney, peuhabeh sangkira saboh aleuhad han geutinggai properti Disney, ngön woe u rumoh.
hypothesis: Kunjungan "tipe" nyan melibatkan terbang u Bandara Internasional Orlando, bus keu hotel Disney di lokasi, menghabiskan kira-kira seminggu tanpa geutinggai properti Disney, dan geuwoe u rumoh.

source: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".
reference: Na meumacam nyang hana meubatah nyang mungkén, tapi nyoe teutap peurlee peue nyang ureueng maksud watѐe awaknyan peugah haba "jak u Disney World".
hypothesis: Na variasi hana putôh-putôh mungken, teuma nyoe mantong na meukeusut le ureung watee awak peugah "meujak u Disney World".

source: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.
reference: Dum tiket nyang jipeubloe online rhot situs lage eBay atawa Craigslist bacut dingui tiket park-hopper le-uroe.
hypothesis: Le tiket nyang ji peubloe bak internet melalui situs leuen lage eBay atawa Craigslist sebagian ji gunakan tiket park-hopper nyang jai uroe.

source: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.
reference: Adakpih nyoe na keuh saboh keugiatan nyang umum, tapih geuteugah le Disney: tiket hanjeuet pinah jaroe.
hypothesis: Seudangkan nyoë nakeuh saboh aktivitas nyang kayém that umum, nyan geutam lé Disney: tiket nyan hana jeut ditransfer.

source: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
reference: Tiep-tiep nyang eh di yup Grand Canyon wajeb na idin kunjong u duson.
hypothesis: Soe mantong nyang peudong khimah di miyueb pinggir Grand Canyon meukureueng izin bak darat.

source: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
reference: Idin nyan ijok padum boh sagai sabab neuk peulindong panton cot, ngon jipeulot ureueng peusan bak uroe phon awai buleuen, peuet buleuen sigohlom buleuen nyan puphon.
hypothesis: Peuneugöt nyan terbatas keu peulindong canyon, dan jeut keu tersedia bak uroe phon buleuen nyan, peuet buleun seugolom buleuen awai.

source: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
reference: Makajih, meunyoe neuk cok idin kunjong u duson bak buleun Mei na keuh nibak tanggai 1 Januari.
hypothesis: Jadi, izin backcountry untuk peue mantong tanggai awai bak buleuen Mei jeut tersedia bak 1 Januari.

source: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
reference: Lapak nibak teumpat nyang sep meuceuhu, lagee Bright Angel Campground nyang toe ngon Phatom Ranch, lazemjih jipeupenoh le peusan nyan jiteurimong bak tanggai phon ibuka reservasi.
hypothesis: Ruang untuk daerah nyang paleng populer, lage Bright Angel Campground nyang bersebelahan ngon Phantom Ranch, umum jih dipeupenuhi le permintaan nyang geuteurimong bak tanggal phon awak nyan dipeubuka untuk pemesanan.

source: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
reference: Na padum boh lumboi idin sagai ijok keu ureueng nyang jak langsong nyan pih keu ureueng nyang phon trok, nyang phon geulayani.
hypothesis: Na jumlah ijin nyang terbatas yang dipeugadeh untuk permintaan walk-in nyang tersedia bak phon datang, phon dilayani.

source: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
reference: Tamoeng u Afrika Tunoeng deungön moto nyankeuh cara nyang hayeu keu takaloen dumpue ceudah lagoina teumpat nyan ngön tajak bak teumpat-teumpat iluwa teumpat tamasya biyasa.
hypothesis: Meujak u Afrika Seulatan deungen mobil adalah cara yang luar biasa untuk melihat mandum keindahan wilayah nyan meunan cit untuk jak u teumpat-teumpat di lua rot wisata biasa.

source: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.
reference: Nyoejeuet jipubuet bak moto biyasa deungön peusiyap beugoet tapih 4x4 jiyue ngön jai teumpatjeuet jipeutubiet deungön bus ruda 4x4 panyang.
hypothesis: Nyo jeut di peubuet lam saboh mobil biasa deungen perencanaan teuliti tapi saboh 4x4 sangat disarankan dan le lokasi hanya dapat diakses deungen basis roda tinggi 4x4.

source: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.
reference: Beutingat teuh watѐe taneuk peugoet bahpih Afrika Tunoeng saban hana mandum nanggroe silingka.
hypothesis: Ingat watee awak nyan peuget rencana bahwa bah pih Afrika Selatan stabil hana mandum nanggroe tetangga nyan stabil.

source: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.
reference: Syarat ngön eungkoh yum visa meubagoe jinѐh nibak saboh nanggroe laen ngön jipeungaroh le nanggroe asai droeneuh.
hypothesis: Syarat visa ngen biaya meubeda dari nanggroe keu nanggroe dan dipengaruhi lé nanggroe awak nyan teuka.

source: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
reference: Tiep nanggroe sit na qanun ceudah lagoina peu dabeuh nyang meukarat nyang na lam moto.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb nanggroe na cit undang-undang yang unik yang merlukeun peue barang darurat harus di dalam mobil.

source: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.
reference: Ie Teureujun Victoria nyankeuh bak saboh Zimbawa blah barat, leupah ceu nibak Livingstone, Zambia, ngön toe Bostwana.
hypothesis: Victoria Falls nakeuh saboh banda di bagian barat Zimbabwe, di seulatan bataih dari Livingstone, Zambia, ngon rab ngon Botswana.

source: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
reference: Kuta nyoe nakeuh pah blah deh ie teureujun, ngön phôn that awak nyan galak, tapih niet jak meutamasya nyang meuceuhu nyoe jipeutaba keuduwa keu sibeurangkasoe jak lam uteun ngön ureueng jak tamasya jai watѐe keu tinggai trep hinan.
hypothesis: Banda nyan teuduek langsong deungen air terjun, dan awak nyan adalah daya tarik utama, teutapi tujuan wisata yang populer nyoe na meulimpah peluang bagi para pencari petualangan dan wisatawan untuk tinggai leubeh treb.

source: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
reference: Bak musem ujeuen (bak buleun November sampoe buleuen Maret), ie jiek sep manyang ngön rhoet nyang hana koen-koen.
hypothesis: Bak musém ujeuen (November sampoe Maret), volume ie akan leubeh rayek ngen Air Terjun akan leubeh dramatis.

source: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
reference: Ijamien bulut teuh meunyoe ta jeumeurang tutue atawa tajak ubena rauh nyang meuluwek-luwek bak ie teureujun.
hypothesis: Droeneuh dijamin jeut basah meunyoe droeneuh tajeumeurang jembatan atawa tajeumeurang langsong jalan raya nyang meugulung di seukeulileng Air Terjun Falls.

source: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
reference: Blah laen, nyankeuh musabab iejih sep manyang sampoe deuh takaloen ie teureujun nyang seubeutoijih jipadoek le mandum ie!
hypothesis: Di pihak laen, nyan keuh seubab volume ie nyan that tinggi sampoe pandangan droeneuh tentang Air Terjun nyata akan disembunyikan oleh mandum ie!

source: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
reference: Kubu Tutankhamum (KV62). KV62 mungkén nyang paleng meusyeuhu nibak kubu i Panton, teumpat geutumee Howard Carter thon 1922 bak bhom pang ulee meuligoe nyang karap punoh.
hypothesis: Kuburan Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 mungken nakeuh kuburan nyang paleng meusyeuhu di Lembah, teumpat Howard Carter geupeuleumah bak thon 1922 kubu raja muda nyan.

source: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
reference: Tabandeng ngön ladom jrat pang ulee nyang laen, adakpih, jrat Tutankhamun karap hana patot ta saweu, jeuet keu ubeut ngön hiyasan ube pah.
hypothesis: Namun, jika dibandingkan dengan sebagian besar kuburan raja laen, kuburan Tutankhamun hampir tidak layak dikunjungi, karena jauh lebih kecil dan berdekorasi terbatas.

source: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
reference: Sibeurangkasoe nyang meuheut kaloen bukti reulhoeh patong nyang jipeugoet nibak ta ilah daya keu jipeutubiet bak keureunda sabab teulah geuh sit ulee ngön baho sagai nyang deuh.
hypothesis: Soe mantong yang tertarik untuk kalon bukti kerusakan keu mumi nyang geupeuget seulama upaya untuk geucok jih dari peti akan kecewa karena hanya kepala dan bahu yang terlihat.

source: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
reference: Meugah jrat nyang hayeu nyan hana le hinan, tapih ka jipinah u misium Mesir i Kairo.
hypothesis: Keukayaan-keukayaan meugah nibak kuburan nyan hana le di dalam jih, teuma ka geuba u Museum Mesir di Kairo.

source: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
reference: Jamѐe troek siat leubѐh get geupeu abeh watѐe awaknyan i teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Pengunjung nyang na watee nyang teubatah akan leubeh get keu jipeujak watee awak nyan di teumpat laen.

source: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.
reference: Phnom Krom, 12 km blah tunoeng barat dari Siem Reap. Candi bak pucak buket nyoe dipeudong bak akhé abad keu-9, watѐe masa Raja Yasovarman.
hypothesis: Phnom Krom, 12 km barat daya Siem Reap. Kuil di ateueh bukét nyoe geupeudong bak akhe abad keu 9, bak masa keurajeuen Raja Yasovarman.

source: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.
reference: Keuadaan nyang reumang-reumang bak candi ngön pue nyang deuh i ateuh Dano Tonle Sap dipeugot buet ek u buket nyan na paidah.
hypothesis: Suasana nyang suram di kuil dan pandangan di ateueh danau Tonle Sap membuat pendakian u bukét nyan layak.

source: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.
reference: Neukunjong u teumpat nyan jeuet deungon teuseuheh digabong deungön saboh kunjongan deungon jalo u dano nyan.
hypothesis: Kunjungan bak situs nyan jeut digabungkan ngon perjalanan peurahô u danau nyan.

source: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
reference: Karcih Angkor nyan peureulee keu neutamong lam candi makajih bek tuwoe neumee paspor sajan droeneuh watѐe neujak u Tonle Sap.
hypothesis: Pass Angkor diperlukan untuk tamong u kuil jadi bék tuwoe geuba paspor droeneuh seudangkan geujak u Tonle Sap.

source: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
reference: Yerusalem nyankeuh ibukuta ngön kuta nyang paleng rayeuk bak Israel, bah pih dum nanggroe laen ngön Seurekat Nanggroe-Nanggroe han dipeunyata nyan seubagoe ibukuta Israel.
hypothesis: Yerusalem adalah ibu kota dan kota rayek di Israel, meskipun le nanggroe laen ngen PBB hana geu akui jih seubagai ibu kota Israel.

source: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
reference: Kuta jameun dilee bak Buket Judean nyan na saboh seujarah nyang lagak nyang trepjih meuribee thon.
hypothesis: Banda kuno di bukét-bukét Yudea na seujarah nyang meucahya nyang treb jih meuribée-ribée thon.

source: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
reference: Kuta nyan keuramat keu lhee agama nyang monoteis - Yahudi, Kristen ngön Islam, ngön jeuet sebagoe pusat rohaniah, agama, ngon budaya.
hypothesis: Banda nyan suci keu lhee agama monoteistik - agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, dan jeut keu pusat rohani, agama, dan budaya.

source: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
reference: Seubap meumakna agama nibak Kuta nyan, ngön khususjih jai teumpat nibak dairah Kuta Jameun, Yerusalem nyankeuh saboh nibak teumpat kunjong turis nyang phôn di Israel.
hypothesis: Kareuna peungaroh agama banda nyan, dan khususnya le situs-situs di wilayah Kota Tua, Yerusalem nakeuh salah saboh tujuan wisata utama di Israel.

source: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
reference: Yerusalem na jai teumpat meuseujarah, arkeologis ngön meubudaya, deungon teumpat meubloe nyang meugah ngön meusak-sak, keude-keude kupi, ngön teumpat-teumpat seumajoh.
hypothesis: Yerusalem na le situs bersejarah, arkeologi, ngen budaya, seulaen pusat perbelanjaan, kafe, ngen restoran nyang rame dan rame.

source: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
reference: Ekuador geulake ureueng Kuba teurimong saboh surat undangan sigohlom geutamong Ekuador rot bandara internasional atawa teumpat tamong nyang paleng luwa.
hypothesis: Ekuador meuheuet keu warga Kuba untuk geuteurimong surat undangan seugolom geutamong u Ekuador meulalu bandara internasional atawa titik masuk perbatasan.

source: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
reference: Surat nyoe suwah dipeusaheh le Meuntroe Luwa Nanggroe Ekuador, ngön pateh deungön syarat-syarat nyang ka meuteuntee.
hypothesis: Surat nyoe meuseuti ji-legalisasi lé Kementerian Luar Negeri Ekuador, dan na syarat-syarat nyang na.

source: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
reference: Syarat-syarat nyoe jipeugot keu diseudiya saboh buet pinah nyang meususon ile antara manduwa nanggroe nyan.
hypothesis: Syarat-syarat nyoe dirancang untuk meukembangkan aliran migrasi yang terorganisir antara dua nanggroe.

source: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
reference: Ureueng Kuba nyang meumat karcih ijo US suwah jak saweu saboh kanto Konsulat Ekuador keu geutumee saboh peungecualian keu syarat nyoe.
hypothesis: Warga Kuba nyang na kartu ijo AS harus jak u Konsulat Ekuador keu meuteumé pengecualian keu syarat nyoe.

source: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
reference: Paspor ata beu sah paleng kuereung 6 buleuen ‘oh lheueh tanggai neujak. Tiket jak ngoen woe/sigo jak nyan peureulee meujan padum trep neutinggai.
hypothesis: Paspor droeneuh harus sah sigra 6 buleun lheuh tanggai perjalanan droeneuh.

source: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
reference: Jak-jak leubeh murah keu keulompok nyang leubeh rayeuk, artijih meunyo gata sidroe atawa deungon sidroe ngôn sagai, neucuba meurumpok ureueng laen lheueh nyan neupeugot saboh keulompok nyang ureuengjih peuet sampoe nam droe keu tamah sidroe-sidroe ureueng nyang leubeh got.
hypothesis: Tur leubeh murah keu kelompok rayek, jadi meunyoe awak sidroe atawa deungon sidroe rakan, cuba meurumpok ngon ureung laen dan peugöt saboh kelompok dari peut hingga nam untuk tingkat yang leubeh get per orang.

source: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
reference: Bah pih meunan, nyo bek jeuet beutoi-beutoi han neuhiro, seubap kayemjih turis rame that dipeuwet-wet hinan keu dipasoe lam moto.
hypothesis: Namun, nyoe hana seubalek jih seubalek jih seubalek jih awak nyan seubalek jih awak wisatawan dipeupisah-pisah di sekitar untuk mengisi mobil-mobil.

source: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
reference: Nyan deuh seubeutoijih leubeh keu cara peungeut ureueng bah geupateh awaknyan peureulee bayeu leubeh le.
hypothesis: Nyang sibeuna jih deuh jih nyan leubeh saboh cara keu ji peungeut ureueng-ureueng mangat jipike awak nyan harôh jibayeue leubeh le.

source: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
reference: Manyang di ateueh blah baroh ujong dari Machu Picchu nyankeuh gunong meureuleueng, kayem jeuet keu layeu keu cok gamba dari jai gamba nyang tinggai dari teumpat nyan.
hypothesis: Meulaboh di ateuh ujong utara Machu Picchu adalah gunong curam nyoe, seureng latar bak padum-padum foto reruntuhan.

source: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
reference: Nyan deuh hangeub bacut dari yup, pih nyan meureuleueng ngoen payah bak ta ek, tapi ureueng nyang sep sihat biasajih jeuet geu grak lam watë 45 minet.
hypothesis: Meukalon bacut meukarat dari miyueb, dan nyan adalah pendakian curam dan payah, tapi ureung nyang paleng cocok harus jeut jih dalam kira-kira 45 menit.

source: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
reference: Reunyeun batee meuleueng dum bak rot, ngoen di teumpat nyang leubeh reuleueng na taloe beusoe diseudiya keu tumpang mat jaroe.
hypothesis: Langkah-langkah batu dipeuduek seulama sebagian rayek jalan, ngen di bagian-bagian nyang leubeh curam kabel baja meujok handrail pendukung.

source: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
reference: Nyan dipeugah, beuleuheun habeh naph’ah, ngôn beuleuheun lam teumpat nyang leubeh reuleueng, utamajih watë bulut, nyan bagah jeuet keu bahaya.
hypothesis: Nyang ka geupeugah, harap awak nyan hana le nafáh, dan jaga-jaga bak bagian nyang leubeh curam, terutama meunyoe basah, kareuna jeut keu bahaya sigra.

source: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
reference: Na guha ubit toe deungon pucak nyang peureulee neuliwat, nyan agak miyup ngoen agak arat meusak-sak.
hypothesis: Na saboh guha ubit di likot puncak nyan yang harus dilelui, nyan na bacut bacut dan agak teucet.

source: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
reference: Meukalon situs ngoen meunatang alam i Galapagos nyan paleng mangat deungon peuraho, lagee Charles Darwin peubuet bak thon 1835.
hypothesis: Meulaboh situs-situs dan satwa liar di Galapagos paleng get dilakukan ngen peurahô, lage Charles Darwin di 1835.

source: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
reference: Leubeh dari 60 kapai pesiar meulayeue bak ie Galapagos - nyang rayekjih lot dari 8 sampoe 100 droe peunumpang.
hypothesis: Lubeh dari 60 kapal pesiar meulayeue di laot Galapagos - ukuran jih mulai dari 8 sampoe 100 penumpang.

source: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
reference: Dum ureueng mangat geupeusan teumpatjih di awai (seubap peuraho biasajih peunoh watë musem rame).
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek ureung peugöt tempat droe leubeh awai (seucara lumrah jih para bot peunoh bak musém raya).

source: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
reference: Beu yakin agen nyang neupeusan tiket nyan ureueng nyang mah’e teuntang Galapagos deungon nyang got geutu’oh le macam kapai.
hypothesis: Peucaya kheueh bahwa agen nyang awak nyan peumeujanji nakeuh sidroe spesialis Galapagos nyang na peungeurtian nyang get keu meubagoe macam kapai.

source: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
reference: Nyo keu peuyakin peue nyang neuharok ngoen/atawa peue nyang han neuharok nyan pah deungon kapai nyang paleng pah keu awak nyan.
hypothesis: Nyan akan memastikan bahwa minat dan/atau batasan khusus awak nyan cocok dengan kapal yang paleng cocok untuk awak nyan.

source: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
reference: Sigohlom ureueng Spanyol troh bak abad keu-16, bahagian baroh Chili nyan di yup aturan Inca seumentara ureueng asai Araukanians (Mapuche) ditinggai bak tingoeh ngoen tunong Chili.
hypothesis: Sigohlom Spanyol teuka bak abad keu-16, utara Chili dimiyueb penguasaan Inca seudangkan penduduk asli Araucanians (Mapuche) tinggai di pusat dan selatan Chile.

source: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
reference: Mapuche pih salah saboh dari keulompok ureueng asai Amerika nyang dudoe nyang meudehka, nyang han punoh dicok keu aturan peugah haba basa Spanyol sampoe ‘oh lheueh Chili meurdehka.
hypothesis: Mapuche juga adalah salah saboh kelompok asli Amerika independen terakhir, yeng hana sepenuhnya terserap ke dalam penguasaan berbahasa Spanyol sampoe lheuh kemerdekaan Chili.

source: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
reference: Adakpih Chili dipeunyata meurdehka bak thon 1810 (di teungoh prang Napoleonik nyang peugot Spanyol hana saboh pusat pomeurintah nyang meufungsi lam padum thon), keumeunangan nyang peuteuntee deungon ureueng Spanyol nyan han diteumee sampe thon 1818.
hypothesis: Meskipun Chili geupeumaklum kemerdekaan bak thon 1810 (seungoh prang Napoleonic yeng geutinggai Spanyol tanpa pemerintah pusat yeng meuguna selama padum thon), keumeunangan nyang peunteng ateueh Spanyol hana geupeuleuh sampoe thon 1818.

source: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
reference: Republik Dominika (Spanyol: Replubica Dominicana) nakeuh saboh nanggroe Karibia nyang tinggai i pulo bagian timu Hispaniola, nyang i bagi ngon Haiti.
hypothesis: Republik Dominika (Spanish: República Dominicana) nakeuh saboh neugara Karibia nyang na di bagian timu pulo Hispaniola, nyang jibagi ngon Haiti

source: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.
reference: Seulaen pantee anoe puteh ngoen peumandangan gunong, nanggroe nyoe keuh kuta tuha Eropa nyang na i Amerika, jinoe nyan bagoe Santo Domingo.
hypothesis: Seulaen pantai pasir putih ngen lanskap gunong, nanggroë nyoe nakeuh nanggroë Eropa tertua di Amerika, jino jeut keu bagian dari Santo Domingo.

source: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
reference: Pulo nyan phon i tinggai le awak Tainos ngon Karibia. Karibia nyan keuh awak nyang meututo basa Arawakan nibak 10.000 SM.
hypothesis: Pulo nyoe phon-phon that jikeumiet lé Taínos ngon Karibe. Karibe nakeuh saboh bansa nyang meututoe Arawakan nyang ka trok bak sekitar 10.000 SM.

source: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
reference: Lam padum thon nyang singkat alheueh trok awak peunjeulajah Eropa , populasi awak Tainos ka le meukureueng kareuna peunaklok Spanyol.
hypothesis: Lam padum thon seucara singkat lheuh teuka para penjelajah Eropa, populasi Tainos ka dipeurangkat that le penakluk Spanyol

source: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
reference: Meunurot Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antara thon 1492 ngon thon 1498 peunaklok Spanyol ipoh 100.000 droe awak Tainos.
hypothesis: Berdasarkan Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antara 1492 ngen 1498 para penakluk Spanyol jipoh sekitar 100.000 Taínos.

source: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.
reference: Jardín de la Unión. Teumpat nyoe dipeudong seubagoe atrium keu saboh keuseupakatan abad keu-17, nyang Templo de San Diego nyankeuh sagai teumpat nyang seulamat.
hypothesis: Jardín de la Unión. Ruang nyo geupeudong seubagoe atrium untuk biara abad keu-17, di sinan Templo de San Diego nakeuh bangunan nyang mantong na.

source: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.
reference: Nyan jinoe dipeujeuet keu central plaza, ngoen sabe le macam piasan dipeugot hinan, uroe ngoen malam.
hypothesis: Jinoe berfungsi seubagai plaza pusat, dan sabe na padum boh peukara nyang teujadi, uroe ngon malam.

source: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.
reference: Na padum boh teumpat pajoh bak taman, bak suepot ngon malam hinan na konser pre kayem ibri le gazebo pusat.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum restoran di sekitar taman, ngen bak malem dan malam na konser gratis seureng dari gazebo pusat.

source: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.
reference: Callejon del Beso (juroeng meucom-com). Duwa boh trah manyang jipeucre le trah manyang 69 sintimete sagai nyankeuh rumoh lagenda cinta jameun.
hypothesis: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Dua balkon nyang dipisah hanya 69 sentimeter adalah rumoh legenda cinta tuha.

source: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.
reference: Keu padum-padum sen na meu padum droe aneuk miet neuk ceurita bak droeneuh.
hypothesis: Untuk padum boh sen na aneuk miet akan jicalitra kisah nyan keu gata.

source: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.
