reference: Pulo Bowen nyan keuh saboh peurjalanan nyang meuceuhu si uroe-uroe atawa abeh peukan geupeutaba ek jaloe, ek gunoeng, keude-keude, teumpat pajoh bu ngoen jai lom.
hypothesis: Pulo Bowen nakeuh saboh uroe nyang rayek atawa uengkot akhir minggu nyang meupeuget kayaking, hiking, toko-toko, restoran, ngen leubèh le.

source: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.
reference: Keulompok aseuli nyoe na i Howe Sound hana jioh bak Vancouver, ngoen mangat jiakses rot teksi ie nyang dijak bak pulo Granville i pusat kuta Vancouver.
hypothesis: Komunitas otentik nyoe teuduek di Howe Sound hana padub kureung Vancouver, dan mudah di akses melalui taksi air yang dijadwal dari Pulo Granville di pusat kota Vancouver.

source: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.
reference: Keu awaknyan nyang peurasat buet uroe-uroe iluwa rumoh, peurjalanan u jurong laot u langet sep brat peunteng.
hypothesis: Keu droeneuh nyang galak keu kegiatan lueng lua, peugisa u laot Laôt u Langét nyan peunteng.

source: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.
reference: Whistler (1,5 jeum ek moto bak Vancouver) nyan meuhai tapih meuceuhu kareuna bak 2010 Olimpiade Musem leupie.
hypothesis: Whistler (1.5 jam berkendara dari Vancouver) meuhanyang tapi terkenal kareuna Olimpiade Musim Dingin 2010.

source: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
reference: Bak musem leupie, neupeurasat padum boh ski nyang get i Ameurika Utara, ngon musem seuuem aci cuba padum aseuli dairah gunong nyang get jak ngon geuritan angen gunong.
hypothesis: Bak musim dingin, nikmati beberapa ski terbaik di Amerika Utara, dan bak musim panas coba beberapa mountain biking asli.

source: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
reference: Idin suwah tapeusan leubeh awai. Droeneuh suwah meurumpok idin keu neu dom i Sirena.
hypothesis: Izin harus dipeusiapkan seugolom jih. awak harus na izin untuk tinggai malam di Sirena.

source: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.
reference: Sirena nyan keuh saboh-saboh nyang keumiet tasiyon nyang jipeutaba bilek ngoen peunajoh seuuem seulaen meudom. La Leona, San Pedrillo, ngoen Los Patos jipeutaba meukemah sagai hana jiseudiya peunajoh.
hypothesis: Sirena nakeuh saboh-saboh stasiun ranger nyang na peuneugöt akomodasi asrama dan makanan panas seulaen camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, dan Los Patos na peuneugöt camping seulaen hana peuneugöt makanan.

source: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
reference: Nyoe geupeueumungken keu aman idin langsong bak taman bak Ureueng Keumiet Tasiyon i Puerto Jiménez, tapi awaknyan hana jitueng kartu keuridit
hypothesis: Jeuët keu meuteumé izin parkir langsong nibak Stasiun Ranger di Puerto Jiménez, teuma awak nyan hana geuteurimong kartu kredit

source: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
reference: Peulayanan taman (MINAE) hana jipeutubiet idin leubeh i sibuleun troek nyang jihindar.
hypothesis: Peurintah Taman (MINAE) hana meujok izin taman leubeh dari sibuleuen seugolom teuka.

source: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.
reference: CafeNet El Sol jipeutaba jipeulaku reservasi ngoen yum US$30, Atawa $10 keu tiket si uroe; meuutit bak trah Corcovado.
hypothesis: CafeNet El Sol na jasa pemesanan untuk biaya US $ 30, atawa $10 untuk tiket saboh uroe; rincian bak laman Corcovado jih.

source: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
reference: Pulo Cook nyankeuh pulo nyang meusapat bebah ngoen Selandia Baro, na i Polysinia, bak teungoh-teungoh blah Tunong Samudra Pasifik.
hypothesis: Kepulauan Cook nakeuh saboh neugara pulo nyang na hubungan bebas ngon Selandia Baru, nyang na di Polinesia, di teungoh La'ôt Pasifik Seulatan.

source: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
reference: Nyoekeuh nanggroe keupulowan deungoeun 15 pulo nyang paleng rayek nyang meusipreuk i laot luwahjih 2,2 juta km2.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah sebuah kepulauan yeng na 15 pulo yeng meutabu di 2,2 juta km2 laot laot.

source: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
reference: Deungoen zona watë nyang saban lage Hawai, meujan-jan pulo –pulonyan jikira seubagoe "Hawaii jimiyup".
hypothesis: Dengan zona waktu yang sama dengan Hawaii, pulau-pulau nyan kadang-kadang dianggap seubagai "Hawaii di bawah".

source: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.
reference: Bahpih leubeh ubeut, nyoe teuingat padumdroe jamee tuha Hawaii seugolom jeuet keu keuneugaraan hana mandum teumpat dom ureung luwa nyang luwah ngoen geudong selaenjih.
hypothesis: Meskipun leubeh ubit, nyan geupeutingat padum-padum-padum ureung tuha dari Hawaii sigohlom jeut keu negara tanpa mandum hotel wisata rayeuk dan pembangunan laen.

source: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
reference: Pulo Cook hana kuta tapih na meu 15 pulo nyang meubeda. Nyang phôn that nyankeuh Rarotonga ngoen Aitatuki.
hypothesis: Pulo-pulo Cook hana na banda-banda, teuma terdiri dari 15 pulo-pulo nyang meubeda, nyang paleng rayek nakeuh Rarotonga ngon Aitutaki.

source: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
reference: Bak nanggroe maju uroe nyoe, geupeusedia teumpat eh ngon bu beungoh ka geuangkat jeuet keu bentuk seni.
hypothesis: Di nanggroë-nanggroë nyang ka maju bak uroë nyoe, peuseumahan teumpat éh dan sarapan mewah ka teupeujeuet keu saboh bentuk seni.

source: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.
reference: Dibak ujong ateuh, B&B jeulah meusaeng keu phôn that bak dua hai: teumpat eh ngoen bu beungoh.
hypothesis: Di ujung atas, B&B jelas bersaing terutama bak dua hal utama: bed linen dan sarapan.

source: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.
reference: Biasajih, bak teumpat nyang paleng get lagee nyan ureueng biasajih meurumpok teumpat eh paling get, mungken ija limbot dipeugot ngon jaroe atawa teumpat eh antik.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, di rumoh-rumoh nyang paleng lagak nyan, mungken na teumpat éh nyang paleng mewah, miseu jih teumpat éh nyang teupeuget ngon jaroe atawa teumpat éh nyang ka tuha-tuha.

source: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.
reference: Bu beungoh jeuet roeh keumangat musem dairah atawa geuhidang khas poe rumoh.
hypothesis: Sarapan jeut mencakup nikmat musiman daerah atawa hidangan khas tuan rumah.

source: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.
reference: Teumeuatoe mungken saboh geudong tuha meuseujarah deungon peurabot antik, halaman meurawat ngoen saboh kulam meulangue.
hypothesis: Pengaturan mungken adalah bangunan kuno bersejarah dengan furnitur kuno, lapangan yang dipeuruskan dan kolam renang.

source: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
reference: Tamong lam moto gata ngoen pubuet peurjalanan jioh na daya tarek intrinsik lam keusederhana.
hypothesis: Meu tamong lam mobil droeneuh dan meujak u jalan raya nyang treb na daya tarik nyang luwah lam kesederhanaan jih.

source: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.
reference: Hana lage moto nyang leubeh rayeuk, gata mungken kayem deungoen ba moto gata ngoen geuteupeu batahjih.
hypothesis: Seulaén nibak kendaraan nyang leubeh rayek, awak nyan mungken ka teutaupoh ngon cara awak awak awak awak awak awak awak awak nyan peumeungendong dan ka teutaupoh ngon syarat-syarat jih.

source: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.
reference: Peudong saboh tenda bak properti ata droe atawa bak saboh kuta deungoen ukuran padumpih jeuet deungoen mudah geutarek peurhatian.
hypothesis: Meupeudong khimah bak tanoh pribadi atawa di saboh banda deungen ukuran peue mantong jeut dengan mudah menarik perhatian nyang hana diinginkan.

source: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".
reference: Paneukjih, neupakek moto gata nakeuh cara paleng get keu peurjalanan tapi jareung jeuet keudroe cara keu "kemah".
hypothesis: Singkat jih, peuguna mobil droeneuh adalah cara yang rayek keu geujak u jalan tapi jarang keudroe jih saboh cara keu "kamping".

source: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.
reference: Meukemah moto jeuet mungken miseu gata na minivan rayeuk, SUV, Sedan atawa Station Wagon deungoen kurusi nyang jeuet dipeueh.
hypothesis: Car camping mungken meunyo droeneuh na minivan rayek, SUV, Sedan atawa Station Wagon nyang na teumpat duek.

source: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
reference: Padum boh hotel geupeuwareh nibak jameun meuh geurita apui uap ngoen kapai laot; seugohlom Prang Dônya keudua, bak abad keu-19 atawa toe keu-20.
hypothesis: Padum-padum hotel na warisan dari masa keemasan rel uap ngen kapal-kapal laot; sigohlom Perang Dunia II, bak abad keu-19 atau awai abad keu-20.

source: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
reference: Hotel-hotel nyoe teumpat ureueng kaya ngoen ureueng meuceuhu oh uroe geupiyoh, ngoen kayem geupeurasat pajoh bu malam ngoen suasana malam sep meuseunang.
hypothesis: Hotel-hotel nyoe adalah teumpat ureung kaya dan terkenal nibak uroe nyan tinggai, dan seureng na restoran dan kehidupan malam yang indah.

source: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
reference: Peukakah jameun dum, hana fasilitah nyang baro, ngoen umue nyang get nyan kajeuet keu siphuet awak nyan.
hypothesis: Fitting yang lama, kekurangan fasilitas terbaru, dan seumangat tua yang meugah juga merupakan bagian dari karakter mereka.

source: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
reference: Seumentarajih awak nyan kayem ime atra droe ih, meujan-jan awak nyan geu idang keu Presiden atawa Peujabat laen nyang troeh.
hypothesis: Meskipun biasa jih dimiliki pribadi, kadang-kadang jih jeut keu akomodasi para pemimpin negara dan tokoh-tokoh yang laen yang dikunjungi.

source: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
reference: Sidroe ureueng tamasya nyang jai peng mungken ipike sit ineuk pho ban sigom dônya, han item piyoh bak hotel nyang lage nyan.
hypothesis: Sidroe ureuëng uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot uengkot ueng.

source: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
reference: Hospitality exchange network nyan keuh saboh organisasi nyang sinambong antara ureueng dengoen ureueng gampong bak teumpat nyan u kuta nyang galak awak nyan saweu.
hypothesis: Jaringan pertukaran perhotelan adalah organisasi yang menghubungkan wisatawan ngen penduduk setempat di kota yang akan dikunjungi.

source: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
reference: Meugabong bak jaringan nyan kayem jih sep ngon pasoe formulir online sagai, adakpih padum boh jaringan nyan na jipeutaba atawa jilake tamah syarat.
hypothesis: Meusaboh jaringan lage nyan biasa jih merlôh meupeutamong lam formulir online; meskipun padum-padum-padum jeuretan na meubri atawa merlôh verifikasi tambahan.

source: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
reference: Dafta teumpat kunjong nyan keuh jeuet keu bukti jiprint atawa online, meujan-jan ngoen referensi dengoen review le awak ureueng jak tamasya nyang laen.
hypothesis: Daftar tuan rumah nyang na tersedia lheuh nyan dipeujok dalam bentuk cetak dan/atau online, kadang-kadang deungon referensi dan ulasan le ureueng-ureueng la'én.

source: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
reference: Couchsurfing jiteume bak buleuen Januari 2004 lheueh peupogram komputer Casey Fenton iteume peuneupho murah u Iceland tapi hana tempat piyoh.
hypothesis: Couchsurfing geupeudong bak Januari 2004 lheuh programmer komputer Casey Fenton meurumpok saboh penerbangan murah keu Islandia teutapi hana na teumpat tinggai.

source: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
reference: Jih jikirem email u mahasiswa bak kampus dairah nyan ngoen jiteurimoeng jai peutaba layanan pree.
hypothesis: Jih geukirém surat-surat keu mahasiswa di universitas lokal dan geuteurimong na jeumeulah rayek tawaran keu akomodasi gratis.

source: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
reference: Hotel jai ilayani awak muda – tipe umu awak duwa ploh thon – tapih droeneuh kayem that meutume awak ureueng jak tamasya nyang leubeh tuha hinan.
hypothesis: Hostel terutama untuk ureung muda  sidroe tamu biasa na lam umu dua ploh thon  tapi seureng jeut meurumpok wisatawan tuha di sinan cit.

source: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
reference: Keuluwarga dengoen anuek miet jareung na, tapi padum boh bilek na nyang ibri ijin awak nyan bak kama pribadi.
hypothesis: Keluarga nyang na aneuk nyan jarang deuh, teuma na hostel nyang jipeu idhin awak nyan bak kamar pribadi.

source: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
reference: Kuta Beijing i Cina neuk jeuet keu kuta poe rumoh Olympic Winter Games bak 2022, nyan neuk juet keu kuta keu phôn poe rumoh nyang na dua boh musem olimpiade seuuem dengoen lupie.
hypothesis: Banda Beijing di China akan jeut keu banda tuan rumah Olimpiade Musim Panas bak thon 2022, yang akan jeut keu banda phon nyang ka tuan rumah Olimpiade musim panas dan musim dingin.

source: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
reference: Beijing neuk jeuet keu poe rumoh keu acara phôn ngon seuneulheuh ngon acara eh lam kama.
hypothesis: Beijing akan tuan rumah upacara pembukaan dan penutupan dan acara es dalam ruangan.

source: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
reference: Acara ski laen na bak teumpat ski Taizicheng i Zhangjiakou, na seukitar 220 km (140 mil) nibak Beijing.
hypothesis: Acara ski laen akan di daerah ski Taizicheng di Zhangjiakou, kira-kira 220 km (140 mil) dari Beijing.

source: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
reference: Jai geureja nyang na peurayaan thon nyang geumulai nibak akhee November sampoe seuteungoh Mei, nyan meumacam bagoe meunurot keulender thon tiep-tiep geureja.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek kuil na festival tahunan mulai dari akhe November hingga pertengahan Mei, yeng meubeda meunurot kalender tahunan masing-masing kuil.

source: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
reference: Jai festival geureja nyang geurayakan seubagoe bahgian dari thon lahe jih atawa thon lahe peutuha atawa na keujadiyan rayeuk pue laen nyang na meusangkot pawot dengoen geureja nyan.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek festival kuil jih dirayakan seubagai bagian dari ulang tahun kuil atau ulang tahun dewi nyang memimpin atau acara utama laen nyang na hubongan ngon kuil.

source: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
reference: Festival Geureja Kerala nyang keuh sep galak ta kalon, deungon na prosesi jipungui gajah, orkestra geureja atawa khanduri laen.
hypothesis: Peurayaan kuil di Kerala sangat menarik untuk ditonton, deungen prosesi biasa gajah yang dihias, orkestra kuil ngen peurayaan laen.

source: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
reference: World’s Fair (umumjih jikheun Pameran Dônya, atawa Expo) nyang keuh festival rayeuk internasional bahgian seni deungoen sains.
hypothesis: A World's Fair (biasa jih geukheun World Exposition, atawa hanya Expo) adalah festival internasional rayek seni ngon ilme.

source: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
reference: Nanggroe-nanggroe nyang ikot geu peulemah seuni deungoen pendidikan nyang geupamer bak pavilion nasional keu neuk peudeuh haba-haba dônya atawa budaya ngoen seujarah nanggroe awak nyan.
hypothesis: Nanggroë-nanggroë nyang na partisipasi geupeugöt pameran seni ngen pendidikan di paviliun nasional untuk geupeuleumah masalah donya atawa budaya ngon seujarah nanggroë awaknyan.

source: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
reference: Expo Hortikultura Internasional nyan keuh khusus acara nyang jipeudeuh meukuntom bungoeng, keubon botani ngoen pue-pue laen nyang na sangkot pawot deungoen seulaman.
hypothesis: Pameran Hortikultur Internasional adalah acara khusus yeng meupeudeh pameran bunga, taman botani dan peue mantong nyang la'én nyang na hubongan ngen tumbuhan.

source: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
reference: Bahpih meunurot tiori acara lage nyan jipeugot tiep-tiep thon (watë awak nyan na bak nanggroe-nanggroe), lam jipubuet tan.
hypothesis: Meskipun secara teoritis awak nyan jeut terjadi seulanjut jih (selama awak nyan na di nanggroe-nanggroe yang berbeda), lam praktek jih awak nyan hana.

source: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
reference: Acara nyoe biasajih sabe na nibak lhee ngoen nam buleuen, ngoen jipeugot bak lapak nyang hana ubiet nibak 50 hektar.
hypothesis: Acara-acara nyoe biasa jih berlangsung antara lhee dan enam buleun, dan di peuget bak situs-situs nyang hana kureueng dari 50 hektar.

source: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
reference: Nyan jai format filem nyang meubeda-beda nyang jipakek ka meuthon-thon. Pileuem standar 35 mm (36 x 24 mm negatif) nyan keuh nibak umumjih.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum macam format pilem nyang ka dipakek seulama thon. pilem 35 mm standar (36 x 24 mm negatif) adalah yang paleng umum.

source: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
reference: Jih nyan jeuet neupasoe dengoen mudah habeh, ngoen meutume resolusi nyang kira-kira jeuet ta peubanding deungoen DSLR.
hypothesis: Biasa jih jeut ji meupeutamong lom deungon mudah meunyoe awak nyan ka seuleusoe, dan na resolusi nyang kira-kira saban deungen DSLR saat nyoe.

source: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
reference: Padum boh kamera deungoen format teungoh jipakek format 6 x 6 cm, leubeh teupat jih 56 x 56 mm negatif.
hypothesis: Padum-padum-padum-format kamera pilem meupakek format 6 x 6 cm, leubeh tepat jih 56 x 56 mm negatif.

source: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
reference: Nyoe jeuet jibri resolusi karap peuet kali lipat nyang 35 mm negatif (3136 mm2 versus 864).
hypothesis: Nyo geubri resolusi hampir peuet kali lipat dari 35 mm negatif (3136 mm2 versus 864).

source: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
reference: Alam luwa nyan salah saboh hai nyang jeuet keu seubap nyang meupakat keu sidroe ahli foto, ngoen peureulee keu tuwah, saba, peungalaman dan dabeuh nyang get.
hypothesis: Kehidupan liar adalah salah saboh motif nyang paleng sulet keu fotografer, dan membutuhkan kombinasi keberuntungan, kesabaran, pengalaman ngen peralatan yang get.

source: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
reference: Sidroe ahli foto alam luwa nyan seureng that han di boh yum le ureueng, tapi lagee ban bidang cok foto lagee lazem jih, saboh foto nyang beutoi jih saban na yum lagee seuribee kata.
hypothesis: Fotografi satwa liar seureng dianggap seucara seutawa, teutapi lagee fotografi secara umum, saboh gamba bernilai siribée kata.

source: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
reference: Bidang cok foto alam luwa nyan kayem peureulee keu lensa telefoto nyang panyang, adakpi hai lagee saboh kawan cicem atawa makhluk nyang haloh nyang peureulee keu lensa nyang laen.
hypothesis: Fotografi satwa liar seureng merlukeun lensa tele panjang, meskipun hal-hal lage kawan burung atau makhluk ubit merlukeun lensa laen.

source: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
reference: Le meunatang nyang lagak nyan payah bak tateumee, ngoen lam taman kadang na keuh aturan nyang geularang keu tacok foto keu arah tujuan komersial.
hypothesis: Le binatang eksotik that payah meurumpok, dan taman kadang-kadang na aturan tentang meucok foto untuk tujuan komersial.

source: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
reference: Meunatang juwah kadang jeuet keu malee atawa jeuet keu juwah. Cuawaca kadang jeuet keu leupie, seuuem, atawa seubalekjih meubahaya.
hypothesis: Beulatang-beulatang uteuen jeuet keu malée atawa agresif.

source: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
reference: Dônya nyoe na leubeh dari 5.000 basa nyang meubeda-beda, na roeh cit leubeh dari duwa ploh ngôn 50 juta atawa leubeh ureueng nyang geungui basa-basa nyan.
hypothesis: Donya na leubèh dari 5.000 bahsa nyang la'én, termasuk leubèh dari dua ploh ngon 50 juta atawa leubeh penutur.

source: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
reference: Kata-kata nyang meutuleh nyan kayem leubeh mudah bak ta muphom dibandeng kata nyang di kheun ngôn babah, cit. Nyoe leubeh beutoi lom meunyo keu mita alamat, nyang biasajih hek bak ta kheun deungoen jeulah.
hypothesis: Tutoe haba nyang teucetet kayém that leubeh mudah muphom nibak tutoe haba nyang jipeugah.

source: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
reference: Le dum ban saboh nanggroe nyan beutoi-beutoi jeuet basa Inggreh, ngoen leubeh lom bak nyan gata jeuet neuteumee eleumee nyang jareung na - utamajih bak ureueng nyang leubeh muda.
hypothesis: Le bansa-bansa mandum ji peugah bahsa Inggreh ngon lancar, dan leubeh nibak nyan, awak nyan na jeumeulah bacut - terutama di kalangan ureung muda.

source: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
reference: Neupike, meunyo gata jeuet, sidroe Mancunia, Bostonia, Jamaica ngoen Sidneysider geuduek bak saboh meja geupajoh bu malam bak saboh teumpat seumajoh di Toronto.
hypothesis: Bayangkan, meunyoe jeut, sidroe ureuëng Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican dan Sydneysider jiduek bak meuja teungoh pajoh bu bak saboh restoran di Toronto.

source: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
reference: Ureueng nyan geukhem-khem sabee keudroe-droe geuh ngoen calitra dari tiep-tiep dairah asai ureueng nyan, nyang dipeutroh deungon aksen nyang meubeda-beda ngoen dialek dari teumpat asai maseng-maseng.
hypothesis: Awaknyan saling meujok kisah-kisah dari gampông droe jih, diceritakan lam aksen dan argot lokal.

source: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
reference: Meubloe peunajoh bak supermarket biasajih jeuet keu cara nyang paleng murah keu peutumbon badan. Hana watë keu maguen, pilehan biasajih teubatah keu peunajoh nyang jeuet dipajoh sigra.
hypothesis: Meulaboh makanan di supermarket biasa jih nakeuh cara nyang paleng murah untuk dipakek.

source: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
reference: Meutamah le supermarket nyang na macam bagoe nyang peuseudiya peunajoh nyang jeuet dipajoh sigra. Ladom na nyang peuseudiya microwave oven atawa alat laen keu peuseuuem peunajoh.
hypothesis: Laen-laen bak supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket-supermarket

source: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
reference: Lam ladom nanggroe atawa macam keude na keuh paleng kureueng saboh teumpat seumajoh di dalam, kayem nyang hana that resmi ngoen yum nyang murah.
hypothesis: Di padum-padum nanggroe atawa jenis toko na setidaknya saboh restoran di lokasi, seureng saboh yang agak informal deungen harga yang terjangkau.

source: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
reference: Neupeugot ngoen neumee meupadum on policy droeneuh nyang ka meucitak ngoen numboi asuransi droeneuh nyang leungkap sajan droeneuh.
hypothesis: Peuget dan ba salinan polis awak dan rincian kontak perusahaan asuransi awak.

source: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
reference: Awak nyan suah geupeukaloen alamat e-mail asuransi ngoen lumboi talipun internasional keu nasihat/otorisasi ngoen peugot tuntutan.
hypothesis: Awak nyan perlu menunjukkan alamat e-mail perusahaan asuransi ngen nomor telepon internasional untuk saran/izin dan meulah klaim.

source: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
reference: Beuna laen saboh nyang ka meucitak lam tah droeneuh ngoen online (neu e-mail u droeneuh keudroe deungon lampiran, atawa neukeubah lam "cloud").
hypothesis: Na salinan laen lam bagasi droeneuh dan bak internet (e-mail keu droeneuh keudroe deungon lampiran, atawa disimpan lam "awan").

source: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
reference: Meunyo neujak-jak ngoen laptop atawa tablet, peuduek saboh citak lam memori atawa disc (nyang jeuet diakses adakpi hana internet).
hypothesis: Meunyo awak jak ngon laptop atawa tablet, simpan saboh salinan lam memori atawa disk jih (na akses tanpa internet).

source: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
reference: Pih neubri numboi asuransi nyang ka meucitak keu ureueng nyang peungon watë jak-jak ngoen syedara atawa ngôn-ngôn nyang na di rumoh nyang jeuet bantu gata.
hypothesis: Meunan cit peujok salinan kebijakan/kontak keu rakan-rakan nyang jak meulayeue dan waréh kawöm atawa rakan-rakan di rumoh nyang rila jitulông.

source: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
reference: Rusa rayeuk (pih dituri deungon nan elk) nyan hakjih han meubahaya, tapi keuneuk dipeulindong droe ih meunyoe awak nyan jiancam.
hypothesis: Moose (dikenal cit seubagoe elk) hana agresif secara inheren, teutapi akan meuprang droe jih jika awak nyan persepsi ancaman.

source: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
reference: Yoh ureueng han geukalon rusa rayeuk nyan deueh meubahya, awak nyan meujan geujak rap-rap ngoen geupeugot droegeuh lam bahya.
hypothesis: Watee ureueng-ureueng hana ji kalon rusa seubab bahaya, awak nyan jeut ji pendekatan that dan ji peugadoh droe jih keudroe.

source: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
reference: Peucandu jep alkohol ie jep ube sep. Alkohol jipeungaroh ureueng meumacam bagoe, ngoen neutupeue gareh gata nyan sep peunteng.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng nyang jieb ié kreueh hana saban-saban keunong lé ié kreueh, dan peungeurtian keu jeumeulah jih keubiet that-that peunteng.

source: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
reference: Hai keusihatan jangka panyang nyang mungken neurasa jai that jep ie nyan nyankeuh reuloh ate ngoen buta ngoen mate. Bahya nyang mungken nyan meutamah jai meunyoe neujep ie alkohol nyang dipeugot hana idin.
hypothesis: Keujadian-keujadian panyang-panyang akibat jijieb ié kreueh nyang lumpah that brat hase jipeuteuka luka hati, buta, dan maté.

source: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
reference: Jiwa hana jeulah meuasoe meubagoe macam hai kuto nyang meubahya lagee metanol, nyang jeuet keu seubap buta atawa mate adakpih lam dosis ubeut.
hypothesis: Spiritual nyang hana sah jeut na macam-macam impuritas berbahaya termasuk methanol, yang jeut menyebabkan buta atawa mate bahkan dalam dosis ubit.

source: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
reference: Gaca mata jeuet leubeh murah bak nanggroe aseng, utamajih bak nanggroe ubeut-wase nyang oengkoh ureueng keureujajih leubeh ubeuet eungkoh.
hypothesis: Kacamata jeut leubeh murah di nanggroe lua, terutama di nanggroe-nanggroe berpenghasilan rendah dimana biaya tenaga kerja leubeh murah.

source: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
reference: Neupikee keu neuikot ujoe mata i rumoh, phôn that jih meunyoe dibayeu le asuransi, ngoen neumee resepjih keu neujok bak teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Pertimbangkan untuk tes mata di rumoh, terutama jika asuransi mencakup jih, dan membawa resep untuk difailkan di tempat laen.

source: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
reference: Bingkai nan merek nyang meuceuhu teuseudiya bak teumpat nyan biasajih na duwa peukara; ladom dabeuh nyan hana aseuli, ngoen dabeuh nyang jitamoeng nyang aseuli biasajih leubeh meuh’ai dibandeng bak teumpat asai.
hypothesis: Kerangka merek mewah yang tersedia di daerah lage nyan mungken na dua masalah; padum-padum jeut keu knock-off, dan yang asli diimpor mungken leubeh mahal daripada di rumoh.

source: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
reference: Kupi nyang keuh salah saboh nyang paleng jai i publoe lam dônya nyoe, ngoen gata mungken keuneuk jai neu teumee meubagoe macam atra nyan i nanggroe droeneuh.
hypothesis: Kopi adalah salah saboh komoditas nyang paleng meudagang di donya, dan awak nyan mungken jeut meurumpok le macam-macam di wilayah awak nyan.

source: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
reference: Adakpih meunan, jai that meubagoe cara keu ta jep ie kupi nibak dônya nyoe nyang mungken peureulee tacirasa.
hypothesis: Namun, na padum-padum cara khas untuk jijieb kopi di seulama donya yang layak untuk ji peurati.

source: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
reference: Jak lam reuleueng (atawa: canyoneering) na keuh jak di meuyup saboh reuleueng, nyang mungken kadang thoe atawa punoh ngoen ie.
hypothesis: Canyoning (atau: canyoneering) adalah tentang jak bak ujong canyon, yeng gareh atawa leubèh ie.

source: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
reference: Jak lam reuleueng peureulee keu tapeusapat padum boh hai dari meulangue, ek cot ngoen grop--tapi meujan peuereulee keu bacut meurunoe atawa ta peugoet badan nyang get nak jeuet ta mubuet (tabandeng ngôn ek bate, nom ngoen scuba atawa ski troen cot, keu tamsee).
hypothesis: Canyoning meujampu elemen dari renang, pendakian ngen lompat -- tapi kureueng latihan atau bentuk fisik untuk dimulai (seubanding ngen pendakian gunong, menyelam atau ski alpine, umpam jih).

source: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
reference: Jak jioh nyan nakeuh buet nyang na roh jak ngoen tapak lam alam luwa, biasajih tajak ateuh rauh nyang ka na.
hypothesis: Perjalan kaki adalah aktifitas lubeh lubeh yang terdiri dari meujalan di lingkungan alam, seureng di jalur pejalan kaki.

source: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
reference: Jak ngoen aki cot uroe na roeh jarak kureueng nibak saboh mil sampoe jarak leubeh jioh nyang jeuet dijak lam siuroe.
hypothesis: Day hiking melibatkan jarak yeng kureueng dari satu mil hingga jarak yeng lubeh rayek yeng jeut dipeujak lam saboh uroe.

source: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
reference: Bak siuroe ek gunong sajan jak beumudah peurle bacut persiapan, ngoen tip ureueng nyang sihat jeuet geunikmati nyan.
hypothesis: Keu saboh uroe geujak bak rot nyang mudah bacut persiapan nyang geukeuheut, dan soe mantong ureung yang get get get get jeut meugeumbira.

source: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
reference: Keuluarga deungoen aneuk miet peurle leubeh le persiapan, tapi siuroe diluwa rumoh mungken leubeh mangat deungoen aneuk miet ngoen aneuk gohlom sikula.
hypothesis: Keluarga nyang na aneuk ubit mungken peureulée persiapan leubeh le, teuma saboh uroe diluwa mudah mungken bahkan deungen bayi dan aneuk-aneuk pra-sekolah.

source: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
reference: Secara internasional, na karap 200 organisasi wisata jijak. Le nibak awak nyan dipeudong keudroe.
hypothesis: Di luwa nanggroe, na kira-kira 200 organisasi wisata nyang beroperasi.

source: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
reference: Peuwareh Global Running Tour, Go running Tour peuhubong lusinan peuna peumandanagan bak peut benua.
hypothesis: Penggantungan Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours meulah jaringan meurapek panyedhiya wisata di peut benua.

source: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
reference: Meudasar bak Barcelona Running Tour ngoen Copenhagen Running Copenhagen, nyan bagah that meugabong deungoen Running Tour Prague nyang asaijih di Prague ngoen laenjih.
hypothesis: Deungen akar di Running Tours Barcelona di Barcelona ngen Running Copenhagen di Kopenhagen, nyan langsong dipeugabong le Running Tours Prague nyang berbasis di Prague ngen la'én-la'én.

source: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
reference: Na lee hai nyang peurle peutimang sigohlom ngoen watë gata jak bak saboh teumpat.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum peukara yang harus awak pertimbangkan seugolom dan watee awak jak u teumpat laen.

source: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
reference: Watë gata neuk jak, neuharap seumike hana lage awak nyan "woe u rumoh". Adab, undang-undang, peunajoh, lalu lintah, seumedom, standar, basa ngoen laenjih neuk sampoe batas meuteunte nibak dipat gata tinggai.
hypothesis: Meunyoe gata jak u nanggroe laén, gata hana teuma meu-ubah-ubah lagée nyang gata rasa bak watée gata jak u nanggroe laén.

source: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh saboh nyang peurlee sabe gata ingat, keu kheun keugob nibak meuseuroi atawa mungken hana galak cara lokal keu pubuet.
hypothesis: Nyan na kheueh saboh hai nyang awaknyoe meuseuti ingat, mangat awaknyoe hana teukeujot atawa hana galak keu cara-cara nyang jipeubuet lé ureuëng-ureuëng di daerah nyan.

source: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
reference: Agen peurjalanan kana watë abad keu-19. Saboh agen peurjalanan biasajih saboh pilehan nyang get keu peurjalanan nyang leubeh nibak wisata alam sigohlom jih, budaya, basa atawa nanggroe penghasilan dimiyup.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan ka na di sekitar sejak abad keu-19. Agen perjalanan seureng jeut keu pilihan yang get untuk saboh perjalanan yang lubeh luwah dari pengalaman peujak awai tentang alam, budaya, bahasa atau negara-negara berpenghasilan rendah.

source: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
reference: Adakpih le agensi akan geucok leubeh sereng peusanan teurato, le agen khusus bak peurjalanan, kisaran peng atawa tujuan.
hypothesis: Meskipun leubèh-leubèh agensi rila geupeugot pemesanan biasa, leubèh agen khusus bak jenis perjalanan tertentu, kisaran anggaran atawa tujuan.

source: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
reference: Nyan jeuet leubeh get ta ngui agen nyang kayem peusan peurjalanan saban ngoen gata.
hypothesis: Leubeh gét neutem peuguna agen nyang kayém-kayém geubuka perjalanan nyang saban ngon awak nyan.

source: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
reference: Kalon bak peu nyang geupeutaba le agen, peu nyang na bak website atawa bak tingkap toko.
hypothesis: Neupandang wisata nyang geu promosi lé agen nyan, peu kheueh di situs web atawa di tingkap toko.

source: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
reference: Miseu gata keuneuk kalon dônya deungoen murah, keu peurlee, gaya udep atawa tantangan, padum boh cara keu pubuet nyan.
hypothesis: Meunyo awaknyoe keuneuk kalon donya deungon murah, keu keperluan, gaya udeb atawa tantangan, na padum-padum cara untuk neupeubuet nyan.

source: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
reference: Bak dasarjih, awak nyan rhot lam dua keulompok: keureuja sira meujak-jak atawa geucoba ngoen peutheun peng teubit gata. Artikel nyoe nakeuh fokus bak nyang akhe.
hypothesis: Teunuléh nyoe teutuleh keu hai-hai nyang keudua: Meukeureuja seudangkan awak nyan teungoh jak-jak, atawa meu-useuha mangat awak nyan hana jipeuleueh biaya awak nyan.

source: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
reference: Keu awak nyan jiseudiya geukorbankan keunyamanan, watë ngoen prediktabilitas keu peutheuen peng teubit sampoe karap nol, kaloen paleng bacut peng keu jak-jak.
hypothesis: Keu droeneuh yang rela mengorbankan kenyamanan, masa dan keunajuan untuk mendorong biaya sampoe hampir nol, kalon perjalanan anggaran minimum.

source: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
reference: Saran nyan asumsijih ureueng meujak-jak hana geuceumeucu, peulanggaran, na partisipasi lam peukan illegal, ureueng lake-lake, atawa eksploitasi ureueng laen keu untong droe.
hypothesis: Nasehat nyan jipike bahwa wisatawan hana jiceumeucue, jiceumeucue, jibagi-bagi dalam pasar ilegal, ji meulakée, atawa ji-eksploitasi ureung laen keu keuntungan droe jih keudroe.

source: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.
reference: Saboh poh peupareksa biasajih piyoh keu phôn wate i tron nibak kapai, kapai ie, atawa kendaraan laen.
hypothesis: Pinto kontrol imigrasi biasa jih adalah stop awai watee geutron dari pesawat, kapai, atawa kendaraan laen.

source: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.
reference: Nibak keureta apui lewat-batah inspeksi ka jipuebuet wate keureta apui I jak ngoen gata haroh na kartu identitas deungon gata wate neu ek salah saboh keureta apui nyan.
hypothesis: Lam padum-padum-padum tren lintas batas peuninspeksi geupeuget di treun nyang teungoh dan awak nyan harus na ID nyang sah deungen awak nyan bak saat naik salah saboh treun nyan.

source: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
reference: Bak keureta eh malam, paspor jeuet jipeusapat le konduktor seuhingga eh gata hana jipeukaru.
hypothesis: Bak tren malam, paspor jeut dikumpol le sopir mangat awak nyan hana terganggu ulee awak nyan.

source: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
reference: Pendaftaran nakeuh saboh syarat tamah keu proses visa, bak padum boh nanggroe, gata haroh meudaftar dipat ngoen alamat gata tinggai keu pihak berwenang disideh.
hypothesis: Pendaftaran nakeuh syarat tambahan untuk proses visa. Lam padum-padum nanggroe, droeneuh meuseuti neumeungandong kehadiran ngon alamat droeneuh di teumpat droeneuh tinggai bak pihak berwenang lokal.

source: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
reference: Nyoe mungken peurlee geupasoe saboh formulir deungon pulisi di sinan atawa meukunjong u kanto imigrasi.
hypothesis: Nyo jeut meukukheun meupeutamong lam saboh formulir bak polisi lokal atawa jak u kantor imigrasi.

source: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
reference: Bak le nanggroe deungoen hukom lagee nyan, hotel lokal neuk geupubuet pendaftaran (pastikan keu meutanyong).
hypothesis: Di padum-padum nanggroe nyang na undang-undang lage nyan, hotel-hotel lokal akan geupeurusak pendaftaran (pastikan ta tanyong).

source: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
reference: Lam masalah laen, hanya awak nyan tinggai diluwa akomodasi wisata peurlee mendaftar. Adakpih, nyoe dipeugot hukom jioh leubeh kabo, jadi geumita sigohlom nyan.
hypothesis: Lam peukara-peukara la'én, awak nyang tinggai di luwa akomodasi wisatawan mantong nyang peureulèë meuandam.

source: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.
reference: Arsitektur na hubongan deungon desain ngon kontruksi geudong. Arsitektur nibak saboh teumpat kayem jeuet daya tarek sidroe turis.
hypothesis: Arsitektur na hubongan deungen desain ngen konstruksi bangunan. Arsitektur saboh teumpat seureng jeut keu daya tarik wisata deungen hak jih keudroe.

source: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.
reference: Le geudong nyang cukop ceudah keu jikalon ngoen jipandang nibak bangunan manyang atawa nibak jendela posisi-pah jeuet ceudah keu dikaloen.
hypothesis: Le bangunan sangat indah untuk di kalon dan pandangan dari bangunan tinggi atau dari tingkap yang diposisikan seucara bijak jeut menjadi indah untuk di kalon.

source: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.
reference: Arsitektur meutumpok jioh ngoen bideung laen geutamong lam rencana kuta, teknik sipil, seuni dekoratif, desain bak lam ngoen desain landscape.
hypothesis: Arsitektur meubeda that deungen bidang laen termasuk perencanaan perkotaan, teknik sipil, seni dekoratif, desain interior ngen desain lanskap.

source: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.
reference: Geujok kiban ato le pueblo nyan, gata keuneuk mita jumlah beujelas dônya malam koen jak-jak bak Albuquerque atawa Santa Fe.
hypothesis: Meukalon padubna jiôh le pueblo nyan, awak nyan hana jeut meurumpok le kehidupan malam yang signifikan tanpa geujak u Albuquerque atawa Santa Fe.

source: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
reference: Tapi, karap mandum kasino nyang tercantum bak ateueh geujok ie, ngon padum nibak nyan geuba hiburan nyang meumerek (khusohjih nyang rayeuek lam lingka Albuquerque ngoen Santa Fe).
hypothesis: Namun, hampir mandum kasino yang tercantum di atas layani minuman, dan padum-padum dari awak nyan jiba hiburan merek nama (penting jih yang rayek di sekitar Albuquerque dan Santa Fe).

source: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.
reference: Peuleuheun: bar kuta-ubeut disino hana sabe teumpat get keu peungunjong luwa nanggroe keu duek sajan.
hypothesis: Waspada: bar-bar kota ubit di sini hana sabe teumpat nyang jroh keu pengunjung di luwa negara untuk meugumpôi.

source: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.
reference: Keu saboh hai, Meksiko Utara Baro kana masaalah khusus deungon ba moto teungoh mabok, ngoen konsentrasi ureueng ba moto mabok manyang toe keu bar kuta-ubeut.
hypothesis: Saboh hal, utara New Mexico na masalah rayek deungen nyetir mabok, ngen konsentrasi supir mabok that rayek deungen bar kota ubit.

source: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
reference: Meugamba atawa ceu –ceu nyang hana meuheut nakeuh jituri seubagoe graffiti.
hypothesis: Lukisan mural atau karet nyang hana dilee jih teungui seubagoe graffiti.

source: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
reference: Adakpih nyan jioh nibak hai nyang deuh moderen, jai ureueng mungken peuhubong nyan dengoen aneuk muda nyang peureulhoh areuta umum ngoen pribadie geupakek cet geudong.
hypothesis: Sementara nyan jauh dari fenomena modern, seubagian rayek ureung meugantoe jih deungen muda nyang merusak properti publik ngen pribadi deungen cat semprotan.

source: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
reference: Tapi, jinoe ka na seuniman buet jaroe nyang caroeng, acara buet jaroe ngon binteh nyang "jeuet le hukom". Gamba buet jaroe lam bagoe nyoe kayem hi karya seuni nibak seuni hana teubaca.
hypothesis: Namun, jinoe na seniman graffiti yang mapan, acara graffiti dan tembok "hukum". Lukisan graffiti dalam konteks nyoe seureng lagee karya seni daripada tag yang hana jeut dibaca.

source: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.
reference: Rhom Bumerang nyan keuh saboh keuahlian nyang meuceuhu nyang galak le ureueng jamee.
hypothesis: Timbak boomerang adalah keterampilan populer nyang le wisatawan keuneuk meurunoe.

source: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh neuk meurunoe rhom bumerang jiwoe lom bak jaroe droeneuh, neupeuteunte droeneuh meurumpok bumerang nyang pah keu neupuwoe.
hypothesis: Meunyo awak keuneuk peurunoe meucaruek boomerang nyang teuka lom bak jaroe awak, pastikan awak na boomerang yang cocok untuk meucaruek lom.

source: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy
reference: Jai bumerang jiseudiya i Australia seubeutoijih hana diwoe. Nyoe that get keu ureueng phôn keu bek geuujoe rhom lam watë meuangen
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek bumerang nyang na di Australia seucara nyata hana geuwoe.

source: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
reference: Peunajoh Hangi nyan nyang jitaguen lam ruhueng tanoh seuuem.
hypothesis: Makanan Hangi dipeuhasoe lam lueng seu-uem lam tanoh.

source: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
reference: Ruhueng jipeuseuuem deungoen batee seuuem ngoen apui, atawa bak padum boh teumpat bumoe nyang seuuem geupeugot keu teumpat tanoh jeuet seuuem keudroe.
hypothesis: Lubang nyo dipanaskan deungen aneuk batée panas dari apui, atau di padum-padum teumpat panas geotermik jeut daerah tanoh seuhat secara alami.

source: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
reference: Hangi kayem geuboh keu geutaguen lam tradisi panggang keu peunajoh malam.
hypothesis: hangi seureng dipakek untuk memasak makan malam gaya panggang tradisional.

source: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
reference: Na padum – padum boh teumpat jipeutaba seuuem bumoe hangi, adak hangi laenjih jeuet tarasa i Christchurch, Wellington, ngoen bak teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Padum boh teumpat di Rotorua na hangi geothermal, seudangkan hangi laen jeut disampel di Christchurch, Wellington ngen laen teumpat.

source: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).
reference: MetroRail na duwa boh tingkat i komuter geureutan apui i dalamjih ngoen seukeulileng Cape Town: MetroPlus (geuseubot sit Tingkat Phôn) ngoen Metro (geuseubot Tingkat lhee).
hypothesis: MetroRail na dua kelas bak kereta peutahanan di dan sekitar Cape Town: MetroPlus (ju lom jiboh nan First Class) dan Metro (ju geuboh nan Third Class).

source: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.
reference: MetroPlus nyankeuh nyang leubeh mangat ngoen hana that meusak-sak tapih leubeh meuhai bacut, bahpih mantoeng na yang brat murah nibak tiket metro biyasa u Eropa.
hypothesis: MetroPlus leubeh nyaman ngen kureung rame tapi bacut leubeh mahal, meskipun mantong leubeh murah daripada tiket metro biasa di Eropa.

source: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.
reference: Tip geureutan apui na peulatih MetroPlus ngoen Metro; peulatih MetroPlus sabe geuduek bak ujong geureutan apui toe ngoen Cape Town.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb treun na bus MetroPlus ngen Metro; bus MetroPlus sabe na di ujong treun nyang paleng rab Cape Town.

source: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
reference: Meume keu ureueng laen, meubek tapeulheuh tah nibak deuh bak droe teuh, nyang keu phôn that munyoe droeneuh neuk lingkeu u ceu internasional.
hypothesis: Peubeuôt keu ureuëng laén - Hántom neupeubiyeu tasikeue gata teubiet nibak mata gata, terutama meunyoe gata teungoh tajeumeurang bataih-bataih internasional.

source: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
reference: Droeneuh jeuet neuthei droeneuh jiboh seubagoe ureueng nyang mee narkoba hana meuneutupue le droeneuh, nyang neuk peugoet droeneuh meupeukara.
hypothesis: Awak jeut meurumpok awak nyan dipakek seubagai pengangkut narkoba tanpa awak nyan meuteupeue, nyang jeut awak nyan lam masalah nyang raya.

source: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
reference: Nyoe teumasok bak preh meubanja, lage asee peulacak narkoba jeuet jiapakek dumjan hana jipeugah-peugah.
hypothesis: Nyoe teumasok waiting in line, karena anjing-anjing narkoba jeut dipakek kapan mantong tanpa pemberitahuan.

source: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
reference: Padum boh nanggroe ka ulak hukoman nyang keujam bahpih keu nyang keu phôn meulanggeh; nyoe ka banmandum hukoman keurengkeng leubeh nibak 10 thon atawa matee.
hypothesis: Padum-padum nanggroe na huköman yang sangat brat bahkan untuk pelanggaran phon; nyoe jeut mencakup hukuman penjara leubeh dari 10 thon atawa pati.

source: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
reference: Tah nyang hana soe kalon nyan nakeuh target pancuri ngon keu galak jipeurati le sibeurangkasoe nyang na keurajeun keu jiancam bhom.
hypothesis: Kantong nyang hana jijaga jeut keu sasaran untuk pencurian dan jeut cit menarik perhatian dari pihak berwenang yang waspada terhadap ancaman bom.

source: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.
reference: I rumoh, kareuna keunongsabee kumeun bak teumpat droe, hayeujih sep brat manyang gata ka keubai keu kumeun nyan.
hypothesis: Di rumoh, kareuna keunong bak bakteri lokal nyan, kemungkinan that awak nyan hana keunong bak bakteri nyan.

source: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
reference: Tapih nibak blah dônya nyang laen, dipat euleumee keu fauna bakteri nyang hai baro keudroeneuh, gata mungken leubeh jih neuplueng bak peukara.
hypothesis: Teuma di nanggroe-nanggroe la'én di donya, bak teumpat fauna bakteriologi baro keu awak nyan, awak nyan leubeh mungken meurumpok ngon masalah.

source: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
reference: Meunan sit, bak cuwaca seuuem bacut, kumeun jitimoh sep bagah ngoen udepjih that trep iluwa tuboh.
hypothesis: Seulaen nyan, bak iklim nyang leubeh suboh bakteria berkembang lubeh get dan udep leubeh treb di lua awak.

source: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
reference: Nyangkeuh hantu Pruet Delhi, Kutok Fira’un, Balah deundam Montezuma, ngoen le ngoen awaknyan.
hypothesis: Meunan kheueh peundeuritaan Delhi Belly, Fir'aun's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, dan rakan-rakan awaknyan nyang le.

source: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.
reference: Lage hai jih peukara peulheueh naph’ah bak cuwaca nyang that leupie, peukara lam pruet bak cuwaca seuuem sep umum ngoen jai keujadian jioh that dari karu keu gata tapi hana that meubahaya.
hypothesis: Lagee masalah pernapasan di iklim nyang leubeh dingin, masalah usus di iklim nyang seu-uem nyan agak umum dan lam seubagian rayek kasus nyan sangat menjengkelkan tapi hana that bahaya.

source: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
reference: Meunyoe taneuk jak u nanggroe nyang maju keuphon that atawa i bahagian dônya nyang baro-beu bek ta peu eleh akan na mungken teukeujot tanyoe ngôn budaya lua.
hypothesis: Meunyo geujak u nanggroe berkembang keu seulanjut jih  atawa u bagian baroe donya  bék neutimang potensi keukeujaman budaya.

source: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
reference: Jai jamee nyang timang, ngön caröng ka taloe ngön peurjalanan dônya nyang teungoeh maju, dipat jai peusaban sare budaya ubeut jeuet meutamah bagah.
hypothesis: Le ureueng nyang stabil, mampu nyang jak u pasai ka geupeutaloe oleh keugisahan baroe di donya berkembang, di sinan le perubahan budaya ubit jeut geu ek laju.

source: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
reference: Nyang phôn bak siuroe-uroe phôn gata, neupike-pike keu neusewa hotel, peunajoh, jiseudiya meugaya lage awak barat ngoen-nyang get keu meutulong peusaban droe.
hypothesis: Khusus jih bak uroe-uroe awai awak nyan, pertimbangkan untuk meutanggong biaya di hotel, makanan, dan jasa-jasa gaya Barat dan berkualitas untuk membantu awak nyan meuasai.

source: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.
reference: Bek teungeut bak kasoe atawa diateuh tanoh bak teumpat nyang hana neutupue na meunatang bak daerah gata.
hypothesis: Bék gata éh di ateueh piasan atawa pad di ateueh tanoh di teumpat-teumpat nyang hana gata turi keu fauna lokal.

source: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
reference: Meunyoe gata nau jak meukemah, neume teumpat eh nyang jeuet taba-ba atawa ayon dodi keu tahindar droe teuh nibak uleue, kala ngoen seujeunehjih.
hypothesis: Meunyoe droeneuh keuneuk peudong khimah di luwa, ba kheueh saboh teumpat éh atawa sarong keu teupeusie droeneuh nibak uleue, kala-kala dan nyang laén.

source: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
reference: Pasoe rumoh gata ngoen kupi nyang meuhai ngoen te chamomile nyang peuteunang droe oh watë malam.
hypothesis: Peupeunoh rumoh gata deungon kopi nyang le bak beungoh dan bacut teh chamomile nyang santai bak malam.

source: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
reference: Watë gata teungoeh jak liburan bak hotel, gata na watë keu peumangat droe teuh ngoen peuruweung beubrat meu padum minet keu tapeugot saboh nyang istimewa.
hypothesis: Watee awak nyan bak liburan, awak nyan na watee keu awak nyan keudroe dan awak nyan na watee keu awak nyan. Dan awak nyan na watee keu awak nyan keudroe.

source: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
reference: Meunyoe gata leubeh galak neujak-jak lam uteun, neucok watë keu neupeugot jus atawa neupeugot meupadit boh smoothie:
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh meurasa leubèh petualang, tacok kesempatan keu jus atawa tacok bacut smoothies:

source: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
reference: Mungken gata tatumee jep ie nyang biasa nyang jeuet keu bu beungoh watë neuwoe bak keureuja siuroe-uroe.
hypothesis: mungken awak akan meurumpok ngon saboh minuman sederhana yang jeut awak peuget untuk sarapan wate awak puléh bak rutinitas harian awak.

source: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.
reference: Meunyoe neutinggai i kuta ngoen meumacam bagoe ie jep bek kayem that neujak bak bar ngoen pub bak nanggroe jiran.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh tinggai di banda nyang na budaya minum yang bervariasi, jak u bar atawa pub di lingkungan droeneuh hana seureng.

source: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
reference: Keu ureueng nyang hana meuphom ngoen jargon medis, kata-kata infeksi atawa meujangket na arti nyang meubeda.
hypothesis: Keu ureueng nyang hana biasa ngon jargon kedokteran, kata-kata peularan ngon peularan na makna nyang berbeda.

source: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
reference: Peunyaket nyang jiek nyankeuh peunyaket nyang musabab le patogen, lage virus, kumeun, kulat atawa glang.
hypothesis: Peunyakét peunyakét nakeuh peunyakét nyang geupeusabab lé patogen, lage virus, bakteri, jamur atawa parasit la'én.

source: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
reference: Peunyaket nyang jiek nyankeuh peunyaket nyang mudah jiek deungoen na teuh toe ngoen ureueng nyang teungoeh saket.
hypothesis: Peunyakét peularan nakeuh peunyakét nyang mudah peularan deungen na di silingka ureueng nyang keunong peunyakét nyan.

source: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.
reference: Dum pomeurentah geuyue tamoeng ureueng jak tamasya, jeuet keu ureueng teumpat tinggai, nanggroe awak nyan jivaksin meubagoe peunyaket.
hypothesis: Le peumeurintah meukheun pengunjung nyang geutamong, atau penduduk nyang geutinggai, nanggroe awak nyan dipaksa untuk dipaksa untuk seudang peunyakét.

source: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
reference: Peusyaratan nyoe mungken meunurot pue nyang kayem jisaweu atawa le ureueng jak tamasya.
hypothesis: Syarat-syarat nyoe seureng meugantueng bak nanggroe-nanggroe yang dipeujak awak nyan ka jak u atawa jikeuneuk jak u.

source: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
reference: Salah saboh hai nyang teuleubéh di Charlotte, Carolina Utara, nyankeuh jai teumpat got nyang jeut tapileh keu keuluarga.
hypothesis: Salah saboh titik kuat di Charlotte, North Carolina, adalah bahwa nyan na le lee pilihan-pilihan berkualitas tinggi untuk keluarga.

source: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
reference: Ureueng bak wilayah laén kayem geukheun piasan meusyédara jeut keu sabab phôn taminah keunan, ‘oh lheueh nyan jamèe kayeum geurasa kuta nyan mangat keu meu’en ngön aneuk miet.
hypothesis: Warga nibak daerah-daerah la'én seureng geu peugah bahwa seubagoe alasan utama keu geuminah u banda nyan na kheueh keu ramah keluarga, dan para pengunjung seureng meurasa mudah keu ji nikmati banda nyan deungon na aneuk-aneuk di seukeulileng nyan.

source: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
reference: Lam 20 thôn nyang ka leupah, dum teumpat nyang aneuk miet galak bak kuta Charlotte ka meutamah bagah lagoina.
hypothesis: Lam 20 thon nyang ka lheueh, jumlah pilihan yang ramah keu aneuk miet di Uptown Charlotte ka meutamah le.

source: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
reference: Taksi hana kayeum geuék lé ureueng di Charlotte, adakpi meunan na cit geuék lam meujan watèe.
hypothesis: Taksi hana umum jih dipakek le keluarga di Charlotte, meskipun awak nyan jeut dipakek dalam keadaan tertentu.

source: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
reference: Na ongkoh tamah meunyoe leubéh dari 2 droe peunumpang, nyoe keuh nyang peugot yum taksi leubéh meuh’ai nibak nyang jipeureulèe.
hypothesis: Na biaya tambahan untuk na leubeh dari 2 penumpang, jadi pilihan nyoe mungken leubeh mahal daripada yang diperlukan.

source: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
reference: Antartika nakeuh teumpat teuleupie di Bumoe, ngon meukeulileng Kutop Seulatan.
hypothesis: Antartika nakeuh teumpat nyang paleng leupie di bumoe, dan jikeulileng Kutub Seulatan.

source: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
reference: Keumunjong turis meuhai, geutuntot beusehat badan, hanya jeut watee musem seuuem Nov-Feb, ngon seubagian rayek hanya jeuet di Semenanjung, Kepulauan, ngon Laot Ross.
hypothesis: Kunjungan wisata nyan mahal, merlukeun fitness fisik, hanya jeut terjadi bak musim panas Nov-Feb, dan sebagian besar dibatasi bak Semenanjung, Kepulauan dan Laut Ross.

source: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
reference: Napadum ribee staf tinggai di sinoe di musem seuuem di seukitar peuet lusen teumpat piyoh nyang biasajih le di daerah nyan; seujumlah ubit laen tinggai seulama musem leupie.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum reutoh staf tinggai di sinan bak musim panas di kira-kira peuet dozen pangkalan sebagian besar di daerah-daerah nyan; bacut tinggai bak musim dingin.

source: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
reference: Antartika Peudalaman nakeuh dataran lambong terpencil nyang ditop le 2-3 km eh.
hypothesis: Antartika dalam adalah dataran dataran seungue nyang teutôb le 2-3 km ais.

source: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
reference: Tur spesialis udara sigo-go jak keu pedalaman, keu meuek gunong atawa keu capoe Kutub nyang na uram rayek.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang wisata udara khusus pergi ke pedalaman, untuk pendakian gunong atau untuk mencapai Pole, yang na pangkalan rayek.

source: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
reference: South Pole Traverse (atawa Jalan Raya) panyangjih 1600 km dari Stasion McMurdo di ateuh Laôt Ross u Kutob.
hypothesis: South Pole Traverse (atawa Highway) nakeuh saboh jalur 1600 km dari Stasiun McMurdo bak Laôt Ross u Pole.

source: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
reference: Jalan raya nyan nakeuh salju nyang dipeupadat ngön jeureulong yang dipasoe salju, ‘aleuh nyan disinan diboh bandira keu tanda. Jalan nyan cuma jeut dijak lé moto meu’ue khusus, moto angkot geuritan salju deungön minyeuk bensen ngön dabeuh.
hypothesis: Nyan nakeuh salju nyang padat deungon celah-celah nyang peunoh ngon tanda-tanda bendera. Nyan cuma jeut dijak-jak le traktor khusus, ji angkot treuk ngon bahan bakar dan bekalan.

source: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
reference: Moto angkotan nyan hana that bagah, nyan keuh payah jak dikilek liwat Gunong Transantartika mangat trok u tanoh nyang manyang.
hypothesis: Nyo hana that leumoh leumbot jadi trek nyan harus meutabu bak gunong-gunong Transantartika untuk trok u dataran tinggi.

source: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
reference: Sabab nyang paléng kayem jeut keu ceulaka bak musem salju nyankeuh licen jalan, jalan geunireng (bineh jalan keu ureueng jak ngön tapak) ngön nyang paléng peunteng nyankeuh langkah gaki.
hypothesis: Penyebab nyang paleng umum keu kecelakaan di musém seumeuneng adalah jalan-jalan nyang lipeh, trotoar (palinggang) dan terutama langkah-langkah.

source: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
reference: Paléng kureung, gata peureulèe sipatu nyang pah deungön tapak gaki. Sipatu musem seuuem biasajih licen that bak eh ngön salju, ladom sipatu musem leupie pih kureueng got.
hypothesis: Seureuta jih, awak nyan peureulée sapat nyang na bak gaki nyang paih. Seureuta-seureuta sepatu musim panas kayém that gli bak gle ngon salju, bahkan padum-padum boh sepatu musim dingin hana le.

source: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
reference: Bungong tapak sipatu jih beusep lhok, 5 mm (1/5 inch) atawa leubéh, ngön bahan nyang beusep lembut lam cuwaca leupie.
hypothesis: Pola harus cukup dalam, 5 mm (1/5 inci) atau leubeh, ngen bahan leumoh cukup dalam suhu dingin.

source: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
reference: Ladom sipatu na pancang ngön na dipeuduek alat tamah bah bèk meusireuk, pah keu dum seulop ngön sipatu, keu geunue atawa tumet ngön tapak gaki.
hypothesis: Padum-padum boh bot na stud dan na alat tambahan yang terpasang untuk kondisi geslip, cocok untuk sebagian besar sepatu dan bot, untuk tumit atau tumit dan bulu.

source: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
reference: Tumet beumiyup ngön luwah. Anoe, aneuk batèe atawa sira (kalsium klorida) kayem ditabu bak jalan atawa rot bah mangat watèe geujak.
hypothesis: Heels harus rendah dan lebar. Pasir, gravel atau garam (kalsium klorida) seureng meutabu di jalan atawa jalur untuk meningkatkan traction.

source: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
reference: Salju luroh kon saboh hai nyang hana normal; bineh gle nyang lhok cuma jeut jitheun meulek bacut, ngön teuleubéh geuhon asoe nyan jeut keuh keu rheut salju.
hypothesis: Avalanches hana abnormalitas; pinggiran curam jeut tahan seubab lambat, ngen volume lebeh akan turun seubagai avalanches.

source: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
reference: Masalahjih nyankeuh salju nyan leukiet, peureulèe na nyang peuphôn bah ditren, ngön ladom salju pih ditren jeut keu nyang peuphôn musibah nyan selanjutjih.
hypothesis: Masalah jih adalah salju nyan lengket, jadi jih peureulée bacut pemicu untuk jitreun, dan bacut salju nyang jitreun jeut keu peristiwa pemicu untuk yang laen.

source: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
reference: Meujan-jan nyang peuphôn musibah nyan nyankeuh mata uroe nyang peuseuuem salju nyan, meujan-jan seubap salju nyang ditren leubéh le, meujan-jan seubap alam, nyang kayem nyankeuh seubap ureung.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang peristiwa pemicu asli adalah matahari yang memanaskan salju, kadang-kadang leubeh le salju, kadang-kadang kejadian alam laen, seureng manusia.

source: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
reference: Tornado nakeuh saboh tameh meupuseng asoejih udara teukanan rendah, nyang hu’ep angén bak seulingkajih u dalam ngön u ateuh.
hypothesis: Tornado adalah kolom berputar udara tekanan yang sangat rendah, yang menyedot udara sekitar ke dalam dan ke atas.

source: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
reference: Tornado nyan peujeut angén teuga (kayem 100-200 mil/jeum) ngön jeut dibet dabeueh nyang geuhon u ateuh langet, dimè dabeuh-dabeuh nyan mandum watèe tornado meugrak.
hypothesis: Awak nyan ji peuget angén rayek (sering 100-200 mil / jam) dan jeut ji angkat objek berat u udara, ji angkot awak nyan seiring tornado bergerak.

source: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
reference: Tornado meupunca sebagoe corong itroen dari awan badé, ngön jeut keu "tornado" watèe trok u tanoh.
hypothesis: Awak nyan dimulai seubagai corong nyang jitreun dari awan ribut, dan jeut keu "tornado" wate awak nyan menyentuh bumoe.

source: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
reference: Penyedia VPN pribadi (virtual private network) nakeuh cara leubéh get geuhindar mandua sensor politek ngön geusareng IP komersial.
hypothesis: Penyedia VPN pribadi (jaringan pribadi virtual) nakeuh cara nyang rayek untuk meutanggong sensur politik ngen geofilter IP komersial.

source: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
reference: Awak nyan leubéh maju keu proxy web sebab padum boh alasan: Awak nyan geu-set mandum lalu lintas internet, kon http sagai.
hypothesis: Awaknyan leubeh unggul daripada proxy web karena padum boh alasan: Awaknyan ji ulang rute mandum lalu lintas internet, kon mantong http.

source: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
reference: Awak nyan biasajih peutaba bandwidth leubéh manyang ngön kualitah peulayanan leubéh get. Awak nyan dienkripsi makajih leubéh payah diseulidek.
hypothesis: Awaknyan biasa jih na bandwidth nyang luwah dan kualitas layanan nyang luwah.

source: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
reference: Kanto berita sabèe sulet bah meukusud nyoe, dipeugah nyan keuh keu "meunceugah peumbajakan".
hypothesis: Peurusahaan media biasa meusulet tentang tujuan nyoe, geu klaim bahwa nyan adalah untuk "menghindari pembajakan".

source: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
reference: Faktajih, kode wilayah hana meupeungaroh keu Salinan illegal; bacut-bacut jisalen dari disk nyang jineuk puta deungön get bak peurangkat dumpat na aslijih diputa.
hypothesis: Kenyataannya, kode wilayah hana sekali-kali efek bak penyalinan ilegal; saboh salinan bit-by-bit saboh disk akan dipeutrang seucara lancar di perangkat manapun yang asli akan.

source: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
reference: Meukusud seubeutoijih nakeuh di jok keu kanto-kanto keundali leubéh rayek keu peukan awak nyan; nyan mandum teuntang puta peng.
hypothesis: Tujuan jih na kheueh keu geubri keu perusahaan-perusahaan nyan leubeh le kontrol ateueh pasai jih; nyan mandum na hubongan ngon meuwet péng.

source: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
reference: Sebab di hoi rute rot Internet, gata hana peurlèe ngui saboh kanto télépon teumpat dipat gata tinggai atawa dipat tajak.
hypothesis: Seubab peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian peundirian.

source: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
reference: Pih hana syarat keu gata meurumpok numboi lokal dari teumpat gata tinggai; gata jeut meurumpok sinambong internet sateulit bak manok kleut, Alaska ngön pileh numboi nyang pat jeut gata na i matauroe tarek Arizona.
hypothesis: Meunan cit hana syarat bahwa awak jeut neucok nomor lokal dari komunitas awak tinggai; awak jeut neucok koneksi internet satelit di alam liar Chicken, Alaska dan neutem pilih nomor yang mengklaim awak na di Arizona nyang cerah.

source: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
reference: Gata suah tabloe numboi global meupisah nyang télépon PSTN jeut tahubông keu gata. Dipat asai numboi nyan nakeuh saboh peurbedaan keu ureung nyang hubông gata.
