hypothesis: seureng, awak nyan harus meuli nomor global secara terpisah yang memungkinkan hp PSTN untuk menelepon awak nyan. Dari mana nomor nyan membuat perbedaan bagi ureung nyang menelepon awak nyan.

source: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
reference: Aplikasi peuneurjeumah kata watèe nyoe – aplikasi nyang jeut otomatis meuboh makna mandum segmen kata dari saboh basa keu basa laén.
hypothesis: Aplikasi penerjemah teks seucara nyata  aplikasi nyang jeut ji translate secara otomatis keseluruhan segmen teks dari saboh bahsa u bahsa laen.

source: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
reference: Padum aplikasi lam keunira nyoe jeut meuboh makna kata lam basa aséng atawa padum boh objek lam dônya nyata watèe soe nyang paké geupeuarah télépon carong keu arah objek.
hypothesis: Padum-padum-padum-padum aplikasi lam kategori nyoe bahkan jeut diterjemahkan teks dalam bahasa asing bak tanda atawa objek laen di donya nyata wate pengguna menunjuk smartphone u objek nyan.

source: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
reference: Mesen peuneurjemah ka jiék deungön dramatis, ngön jino kayem dijok leubéh kureung teurjemahan beutoi (ngön leubéh jareung haba soeh), tapi peurhatian peurlèe, sabab mesin-mesin nyan mungkén manteng salah.
hypothesis: Mesin terjemahan telah meningkat secara dramatis, dan jinoe seureng geubri terjemahan yang leubeh atau kurang akurat (dan leubeh jarang gibberish), teutapi na bacut perhatian, kareuna awak nyan mantong mungken ka meuphom salah mandum nyan.

source: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
reference: Salah saboh aplikasi paléng deuh dalam keunira nyoe nakeuh Google Translate, nyang mungkén peuneurjemahan online leuh unduh data basa nyang peurlèe.
hypothesis: Salah saboh aplikasi nyang paleng meusyeuhu lam kategori nyoe nakeuh Google Translate, nyang peugot translations offline lheuh geu download data bahasa nyang geukeuheundak.

source: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
reference: Paké aplikasi petunyok arah GPS bak telpon carong gata jeut keu mudah ngön cara paléng nyaman keu peutunyok arah watèe gata di luwa nanggroe.
hypothesis: Menggunakan aplikasi navigasi GPS di smartphone droeneuh jeut keu cara yeng paleng mudah ngen paleng nyaman untuk menavigasi wate di lua nanggroe droeneuh.

source: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
reference: Nyoe jeut keubah peng dari bloe peuta barô keu saboh GPS, atawa peurangkat GPS ata droe atawa siwa saboh dari salah saboh kanto rental moto.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ta peuseulamat duit daripada meuli peta baru untuk GPS, atawa perangkat GPS mandiri atau menyewa saboh dari perusahaan penyewaan mobil.

source: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
reference: Miseu gata hana meurumpok koneksi keu télépon gata, atawa watèe diluwa jangkauan, keurija jih jeut teurbatas atawa hana teusedia.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak hana koneksi data untuk telepon awak, atawa watee nyan di lua jangkauan, kinerja awak nyan jeut terbatas atawa hana tersedia.

source: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
reference: Tiep sagoe keude meupasoe deungön meubareh-bareh kartu télépon sigohlom-bayeue nyang jeut dipaké dari télépon umum atawa pih télépon biasa.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb toko sagoe peunoh deungon macam-macam kartu telepon pra-bayar nyang jeut dipakek dari telepon umum atau telepon biasa.

source: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
reference: Seumeuntara seubagoe lë kartu get keu télépon dumho, padum boh spesialis dalam dijok yum panggelan keu keulompok nanggroe meuteuntèe.
hypothesis: Seudangkan sebagian rayek kartu meuguna untuk geumunggil di pat mantong, padum-padum spesialisasi dalam meujok tarif geumunggil keu kelompok-kelompok bansa tertentu.

source: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
reference: Akses keu layanan nyoe kayem dijok rot numboi télépon bebah pulsa nyan jeut jihubông dari télépon hana bayeue.
hypothesis: Akses keu layanan nyo seureng melalui nomor telepon gratis yeng jeut ditelepon dari seubagian rayek telepon tanpa biaya.

source: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
reference: Atoran bhah fotografi biasa pih jeut keu reukam video, mungkén jeut leubéh.
hypothesis: Aturan tentang fotografi biasa juga berlaku untuk rekaman video, mungken leubeh le.

source: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
reference: Miseu cok saboh poto hana dibie idin, makajih hana suah tapiké reukam video nyan.
hypothesis: Meunyo cuma tacok foto sapeue-sapeue hana jeuet, maka awak pih hana jeuet tapeuget video nyan.

source: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
reference: Miseu neupaké drone, neupareksa dilèe peu nyang jeut tarekam atawa idin tatamah nyang dipeurlèe.
hypothesis: Meunyo meupakek drone, periksa seugolom-seugolom bahwa awak nyan di idhin untuk meupeuget pilem dan izin atawa lisensi tambahan nyang geukeuheundak.

source: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
reference: Dipo saboh drone toe bandara atawa diateuh ureueng ramé nakeuh saboh ide hana get, bahkan miseu nyan hana illegal lam dairah gata.
hypothesis: Pembuangan drone di deungen bandara atawa di ateuh seuramoe ureung nyan hampir selalu saboh ide nyang salah, bahkan jika nyan hana ilegal di daerah droeneuh.

source: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
reference: Saat nyoe tiket peurjalanan udara jareung dipeusan langsong rot maskapai kon phôn geuseutot ngön geubandengkan yum.
hypothesis: Jinoe perjalanan udara hanya jarang dipeutabu langsong melalui maskapai udara tanpa phon mita dan membandingkan harga.

source: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
reference: Kadang peuneurbangan nyang sama geujok yum meubeda nibak mandum agregator ngön nyan dibayeue keu mita peurbandéngan ngön geukalon bak website peuneurbangan nyan sigohlom dipeusan.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang penerbangan yang sama jeut na harga yang sangat berbeda di macam-macam agregator dan meuguna untuk membandingkan hasil pencarian dan juga untuk melihat situs web maskapai itu sendiri sebelum pemesanan.

source: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
reference: Adak pih gata hana peurlèe saboh visa keu saweu siat keu nanggroe meuteute sebagoe turis atawa bisnis, jak keudeh sebagoe peulajar internasional umumjih peurlèe watèe tinggai leubéh trep daripada jak keudeh sebagoe turis sagai.
hypothesis: Seudangkan awak nyan hana peureulèë visa untuk jak u nanggroe-nanggroe seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara

source: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
reference: Umumjih, tinggai i nanggroe laén lam watèe nyang trep suah tameurumpok visa phôn-phôn that.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, keu tinggai di nanggroe aséng keu masa nyang panyang akan awak nyan peureulée keu mendapatkan visa seugolom jih.

source: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
reference: Visa peulajar umumjih dijok syarat meubeda ngön prosedur aplikasi dari visa ureung aséng normal atawa visa ureung keureuja.
hypothesis: Visa mahasiswa umum jih na persyaratan ngen prosedur aplikasi yang berbeda dari visa wisata atau bisnis biasa.

source: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
reference: Keu sibahgian lë nanggroe, gata tapeurlèe surat dari institusi teumpat gata meurunoe, ngön bukti peng keu dukôngan droe teuh sekureueng-kureuengjih sithôn gata meurunoe.
hypothesis: Keu leubèh-leubèh bansa, awak nyan peureulée surat tawaran nibak institusi nyang awak nyan keuneuk beuet, dan cit bukti dana keu neutulông droe awak nyan sigra thon phon kursus awak nyan.

source: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
reference: Tateumanyong bak institusi, seureuta departemen imigrasi keu nanggroe teumpat gata keuneuk meurunoe keu syarat leungkap.
hypothesis: Meutanyong bak institusi, meunan cit bak departemen imigrasi keu nanggroe yang awak keuneuk meu-studi keu syarat-syarat nyang teukeujot.

source: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
reference: Keucuali gata sidroe diplomat, keuruja di luwa nanggroe pada umumjih meumakna gata suah bayeue pajak wasé di nanggroe teumpat gata tinggai.
hypothesis: Seulaén awak nyan sidroe diplomat, bekerja di lua nanggroe umum jih ateuh awak nyan akan meutanggong pajak penghasilan di nanggroe awak nyan berbasis.

source: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
reference: Pajak wasé di suson meubeda tiep tiep nanggroe, ngön hareuga pajak seureuta tanda kureung meumacam bagoe dari saboh nanggroe keu nyang laén.
hypothesis: Pajak penghasilan na struktur yeng meubeda di nanggroe-nanggroe yeng meubeda, ngen tingkat pajak ngen bracket meubeda rayek dari saboh nanggroe keu nanggroe yeng laen.

source: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
reference: Di padum boh nanggroe federal, lage Amèrika Serikat ngön Kanada, pajak wasé dilakèe mandua bak level federal ngön level lokal, sampoe hareuga ngön tanda kureung jeut meumacam bagoe dari saboh wilayah keu wilayah laén.
hypothesis: Di padum-padum nanggroe federal, lage Amerika Serikat ngen Kanada, pajak penghasilan ditumpok bak tingkat federal ngen tingkat lokal, jadi tarif ngen bracket jeut meubeda dari wilayah keu wilayah.

source: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
reference: Seumentara peumareksaan imigrasi biasajih hana atawa keu syarat watèe gata troh u tanoh-ie gata, kontrol bea cukai jeut keu karu.
hypothesis: Seudangkan pemeriksaan imigrasi seureng hana na atau formalitas watee awak trok u nanggroe awak nyan, kontrol kastam jeut keu masalah.

source: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
reference: Tapeuteuntèe lé droeteuh puetra nyang jeuet ngön nyang hanjeuet taba ngön pu nyang ta peunyata diluwa batah nyang jeuet.
hypothesis: Peucaya kheueh bahwa gata tateupeue peue nyang jeuet dan hana jeuet gata ba dan tapeugah peue mantong nyang leubeh nibak batas-batas hukum.

source: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
reference: Cara nyang paléng mudah untuk ta mulai usaha bak bidang teumuleh tentang travel nakeuh deungön neu peumah‘e droeneuh bak bidang teumuleh di website blog travel.
hypothesis: Cara yeng paleng mudah untuk mulai dalam bisnis menulis perjalanan adalah untuk mengasah keterampilan awak bak situs web blog perjalanan yang mapan.

source: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
reference: Alheueh droeneuh mah‘e cara neuatô ngön neu-edit bak web, alheueh nyan, mungkén droeneuh jeut neumulai peuget website droe.
hypothesis: Lheuh awak jeut nyaman deungen pemformatan ngen pengeditan di web, lheuh nyan, awak jeut neupeugöt situs web awak droeneuh.

source: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
reference: Peutaba droe watèe tajak lam traveling nakeuh saboh cara nyang get untuk tapeugot saboh hai nyang meubeda tapi nyan keun cuma tentang buet jok.
hypothesis: Sukarelawan seudangkan awak nyan teungoh uengkot uengkot nakeuh saboh cara nyang rayek keu neupeuget perbedaan tapi nyan hana cuma tentang meubri.

source: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
reference: Meu udép ngön peutaba droe untuk udép di lua nanggroe nakeuh saboh cara nyang get untuk ta meureuno tentang budaya nyang meubeda, meuturi deungön urueng barô, meuruno hai tentang droe teuh, ta teumèe saboh pandangan barô akan hai ngön bahkan jeut ta teumèe saboh skill nyang barô.
hypothesis: Ureueng tinggai dan sukarelawan di nanggroe luwa nakeuh cara yang rayek keu ta teupeu saboh budaya yang berbeda, ta tem ureung baro, ta teumeuri tentang droe teuh keudroe, ta tem peurasaan perspektif dan bahkan ta peuget keterampilan baro.

source: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
reference: Nyoe pih jeuet keu saboh cara nyang get untuk ta peurayek asoe dompet untuk jeuet ta tinggai leubéh trep bak saboh tempat karna lë buet-buet nyang dipeutaba nyang jeut di bri teumpat untuk ta duek ngön ladom na nyang di bri bacut keu gaji.
hypothesis: Nyo jeut keu cara yang jroh untuk meujampu anggaran untuk meujampu tinggai leubeh treb bak saboh teumpat kareuna le pekerjaan sukarela menyediakan kamar dan makanan dan padum-padum droe meutanggong upah bacut.

source: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
reference: Ureueng Viking dipaké jalan ie ureueng Russia untuk jak u Laôt Black ngön Laôt Caspian. Bagian-bagian dari jalan nyoe manteng jeuet ta paké jino. Neu cek hai nyang peureulèe untuk izin-izin nyang khusus, nyang mungkén payah bak neu teumèe.
hypothesis: Viking-viking ji peuguna rot-rot krueng Rusia keu ji jak u Laôt Hitam ngon Laôt Kaspi. Bagian-bagian rot-rot nyoe mantong jeuet ji peuguna.

source: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
reference: White Sea-Baltic Canal peusambông laôt Artik deungön laôt Baltic, dari danau Onega, danau Ladoga ngön Saint Petersburg, leubéh lë dari krueng-krueng ngön danau-danau.
hypothesis: Laôt Laôt Putih Baltik meuhubong Laôt Arktik ngon Laôt Baltik, meulalu Laôt Onega, Laôt Ladoga ngon Saint Petersburg, le jih deungen krueng ngon danau.

source: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
reference: Danau Onega pih meusambông deungön Volga, jadi tajak dari laôt Caspian rhet Russia manteng mungkén.
hypothesis: Danau Onega cit meuhubong ngon Volga, jadi teuka dari Laôt Kaspi meulalu Rusia mantong mungken.

source: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
reference: Beu neupeuyakin droeneuh bahwa sigoe droeneuh teuka u tempat meulaboh kapai mandum hai ka deuh trang. Droeneuh akan neu mereumpok penumpang-penumpang kapai nyang laén ngön ureueng-ureueng nyan akan geu bri informasi keu droeneuh.
hypothesis: Gata jeuet yakin bahwa meunyoe gata trok bak pelabuhan-pelabuhan nyan, bandum nyan teuma deuh teukalon. Gata teuma meurumpok ngon peugawée-peugawée peurahô nyang laén dan awaknyan teuma jibagi-bagi informasi jih ngon gata.

source: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
reference: Pada dasarjih droeneuh akan diumumkan tanda keu bantuan droeneuh, neuputa-puta dermaga, neupeutoe ureueng nyang teungoh geurah kapai, neuusaha untuk neupeugah haba dengan awak kapai dalam bar, ngön laén-laén.
hypothesis: Padahai awak nyan akan peuduek catatan nyang meujanji bantuan awak nyan, meulayeue di dok, mendekati ureung yang peugleh peurahô awak nyan, meucuba meuhubongan ngon peulangkah di bar, dll.

source: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
reference: Neuusaha untuk neupeugah haba deungön ureueng beu le. Alheueh nyan mandum ureueng akan geuturi droeneuh ngön akan geujok peutunyok keu droneuh nyang töh kapai nyang peureulèe ureueng.
hypothesis: Cuba peugah haba deungon le that ureuëng. Hana treb le mandum ureuëng teuma jituri gata dan teuma jibri naseuhat keu gata keu peurahô nyang teungoh jimita ureuëng.

source: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
reference: Droeneuh wajeb neu pileh maskapai penerbangan lam saboh syarikat deungön beuleuheun.
hypothesis: Neutem piléh maskapai Frequent Flyer awak nyan deungon teuliti.

source: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
reference: Adak pih mungkén droeneuh neu piké bahwa nyoe hai nyang wajar untuk ta pileh masakapai penerbangan nyang kayem neu jak ék, droeneuh wajeb neu teupu bahwa na keuleubéhan-keuleubéhan nyang di peutaba meubeda ngön kayeum poin peulanggan maskapai nyang di peutaba leubéh got nibak saboh maskapai lam saboh syarikat.
hypothesis: Meskipun awak mungken meurasa intuitif untuk bergabung dengan maskapai penerbangan yang awak terbang paleng, awak harus sadar bahwa hak istimewa yang ditawarkan seureng beda dan poin-poin yang sering terbang mungken leubeh murah hati di bawah maskapai penerbangan yang berbeda dalam aliansi yang sama.

source: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.
reference: Maskapai-maskapai lagèe Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines ka di peuluwah wilayah phe kapai troh u Afrika, ngön di peutaba tujuan u kuta-kuta nyang na di Afrika deungön yum nyang leubéh murah dari Maskapai-maskapai Eropa.
hypothesis: Airlines lage Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines ka ji ekstensifkan jasa jih keu Afrika, dan ji tawarkan koneksi keu le kota-kota utama Afrika deungen tarif yang kompetitif daripada maskapai hawa Eropa la'én.

source: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.
reference: Maskapai Turki di phe u 39 boh wilayah tujuan di 30 boh nanggroe nyang na di Afrika watèe thôn 2014.
hypothesis: Turkish Airlines meulayeue u 39 tujuan di 30 nanggroë Afrika bak thon 2014.

source: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh na leubéh watèe pre, jeut neu-eu jumlah mandum dari yum u Afrika di bandeng deungön biaya jak keulileng dônya.
hypothesis: Meunyoe droeneuh na watee perjalanan tambahan, periksa untuk kalon pakriban tarif total droeneuh keu Afrika ji bandingkan deungen tarif di seukeulileng donya.

source: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
reference: Bèk tuwo neu tamah biaya keu tambahan visa, pajak watèe ta phe, biaya jak di darat, ngön sabagoejih keu mandum teumpat-teumpat nyan nyang diluwa Africa.
hypothesis: Bék tuwoe neutamah biaya tambahan visa tambahan, pajak keberangkatan, transportasi darat, dll untuk mandum teumpat di luwa Afrika.

source: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh na hawa neu phe u keulileng dônya ban mandum bak wilayah tunong bumoe, pilihan untuk jak rhet nan ngön untuk tujuan keunan nyan sangat terbatah kareuna dit that kapai phe ateuh laôt arah wilayah keunan.
hypothesis: Meunyo awaknyoe keuneuk meulayeue bansigom donya seucara sampoereuna di Hemisfer Seulatan, pilihan penerbangan dan tujuan terbatas kareuna hana rute transoceanic.

source: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
reference: Hana meusaboh pih syarikat maskapai nyang meucakop ban lhèe boh laôt raya nyang na di wilayah tunong bumoe (SkyTeam hana di cakop ban saboh pih wilayah nyan).
hypothesis: Hana aliansi pawai nyang meuprang mandum lhee peunteng laot di Hemisfer Selatan (dan SkyTeam hana meuprang na peunteng).

source: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.
reference: Tapi, Star Alliance mencakop mandum wilayah kecuali wilayah timu South Pacific dari Santiago de Chile u Tahiti, nyan keuh nyan penerbangan LATAM Oneworld.
hypothesis: Namun, Star Alliance mencakup mandum hal kecuali Pasifik Selatan timu dari Santiago de Chile keu Tahiti, yeng merupakan penerbangan LATAM Oneworld.

source: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)
reference: Penerbangan nyoe kon saboh-saboh jih cara meunyo droeneuh meuheut neupeuliwat arah phe South Pacific ngön wilyah panté barat dari Amèrika Selatan. (neu kalen di yup)
hypothesis: Penerbangan nyoe hanjeut saboh pilihan meunyoe awak keuneuk skip Pasifik Selatan ngen pantai barat Amerika Selatan. (lihat di bawah)

source: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
reference: Nibak thôn 1994, wilayah etnis Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh i Azerbaijan geupeubeureutoh prang geulawan Azeri.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1994, wilayah Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh di Azerbaijan dipeujeut prang lawan Azeris.

source: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
reference: Deungön dukôngan Armenia, peumeurintahan barô ka jipeugot. Tapi, hana nanggroe - bahkan meu ureueng Armenia - geuakui seucara reusmi.
hypothesis: Deungon dukungan Armenia, saboh republik barô geupeudong.

source: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
reference: Argumen diplomatik bak wilayah nyan sabèe jipeubroek hubungan antara Armenia ngön Azerbaijan.
hypothesis: Argumen diplomatik di wilayah nyan mantong jipeususah hubungan antara Armenia ngon Azerbaijan.

source: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
reference: Saluran Wilayah Kanal (Beulanda: Grachtengordel) nyan keuh wilayah bak abad keu-17 nyang meusyeuhu seulingka Binnenstad Amsterdam.
hypothesis: Kawasan kanal (bahsa Belanda: Grachtengordel) nakeuh kawasan abad keu-17 nyang meusyeuhu nyang jikeulileng Binnenstad di Amsterdam.

source: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.
reference: Ban mandum wilayah jiteutapkan seubagoe saboh situs Peuwareh Dônya UNESCO sabab nilai budaya ngön seujarah nyang unik.
hypothesis: Seureuta kabupaten nyoe dipeutunyok seubagoe Situs Warisan Dunia UNESCO seubab nilai budaya ngon seujarah jih yang unik, dan nilai properti jih na antara yang paleng manyang di nanggroe nyan.

source: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
reference: Cinque Terre, nyang meumakna limoeng boh nanggroe, na limoeng boh gampong bineh pasi ubeut Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ngön Monterosso nyang na di wilayah Italia Liguria.
hypothesis: Cinque Terre, nyang makna Limong Tanoh, terdiri dari limong gampong pesisir ubit Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ngen Monterosso nyang na di wilayah Liguria Italia.

source: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
reference: Wilayah nyan ka teudaftar bak dafta peuwareh dônya UNESCO.
hypothesis: Awak nyan na di Daftar Warisan Donya UNESCO.

source: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
reference: Sampoe meu abad-abad, ureueng sep brat leuheun geu peugot trah bak teumpat nyang gasa, peumandangan nyang lhok sampoe u bineh nyang meuhadap keu u laôt.
hypothesis: Seulama meu-abad-abad, ureuëng-ureuëng ka jipeudong teras deungon teuliti bak lanskap nyang meutabu dan curam trok u bukét-bukét nyang meutabu u laot.

source: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
reference: Saboh bahgi nyang meunawan hate nyan keuh peungeumbangan peurusahaan nyang deuh ta kalon. Jalan sitapak gaki, geureutan apui, ngön jaloe peu sinambong gampong gampong, ngön moto nyang hana ék ta jangkau awak nyang dari luwa.
hypothesis: Bagian dayah jih adalah hana pembangunan perusahaan yang deuh. Jalan, kereta dan peurahô meuhubong gampông-gampông nyan, dan mobil hana jeut jak keunan dari luwa.

source: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.
reference: Jeuneh basa Prancis nyang jipaké di Belgia ngön Swiss meubeda bacut deungön basa Prancis nyang na di Prancis, bahpih banduajih karab sama bak dipeuphom.
hypothesis: Varietas bahasa Prancis yeng dipeugah di Belgia ngen Swiss bacut meubeda dari bahasa Prancis yeng dipeugah di Prancis, meskipun awak nyan saban that untuk jeut meuphom sabe keudroe-droe.

source: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.
reference: Leubéh khususjih, nibak cara peulimboi basa Prancis nyang jipeugah di Belgia ngön Swiss na bacut khas meubeda deungön basa Prancis nyang jipaké di Prancis, ngön cara peulafai na padum boh kata bacut meubeda.
hypothesis: Khusus jih, sistem penomoran di Belgia dan Swiss nyang meututoe bahasa Prancis na padim boh peukara yeng meubeda dari bahasa Prancis yeng dipeututoe di Perancis, ngen pengucapan padim boh kata nyan bacut meubeda.

source: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.
reference: Bahpih meunan, mandum ureueng Belgia ngön ureung Swiss nyang meubasa Prancis ka jimeurunoe basa Prancis nyang ka teutap bak Sikula, sampoe awak nyan meuphom bahpih droe neuh neupaké cara peulimboi lage sistem Prancis.
hypothesis: Namun, mandum Belgia dan Swiss nyang meututoe bahasa Prancis akan belajar bahasa Prancis standar di sikula, jadi awak nyan akan jeut muphom awak nyan bahkan jika awak nyan meupakek sistem numerasi Prancis standar.

source: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."
reference: Rab mandum bahgian dônya, geu beuot jaroe nyan sipheut rumeh, nyan isyarat "halo."
hypothesis: Di padum-padum boh nanggroe di donya, meukabông na kheueh tanda seujahteura, sibagoe tanda "salam".

source: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.
reference: Adak pih, di Malaysia, na padum droe ureung Meulayu gampong, nyan meumakna "jak keunoe" lage jaroe punyok tunyok u tuboh, grak nyan jipaké lé padum-padum teumpat di nanggroe Barat, ngön wajeb jipaké keu nyan sagai.
hypothesis: Namun, di Malaysia, setidaknya di kalangan Melayu di daerah pedesaan, nyan berarti "keukeuh," saban lagee jari telunjuk nyang ditekuk ke arah awak, sebuah gerakan yang dipakek di negara-negara Barat tertentu, dan harus dipakek untuk tujuan nyan mantong.

source: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
reference: Meunan sit, Sidroe-droe jamèe inggreh mungkén na salah meunyoe jikhen seulamat tinggai deungön cara beuot jaroe meuhadap keu ureueng nyan meumakna sebagoe grak neuk wo.
hypothesis: Meunan cit, sidroe ureuëng Britanik nyang jak u Spanyol mungken meurasa seudeh ngon jaroe nyang meubahya bak jaroe nyang meubahya bak jaroe nyang meubahya bak jaroe nyang meubahya (teutapi ureuëng nyang jibahya bak jaroe nyang meubahya) sibagoe tanda bahwa awak nyan ka geuwoe lom teuma.

source: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.
reference: Basa Auxiliary nyan keuh basa-basa jipeugot atawa jipeujeut deungön meukusud keu peuhubông tameututoe deungön ureueng-ureueng nyang pueh meututoe.
hypothesis: Bahsa-bahsa tambahan adalah bahsa-bahsa buatan atau dibangun yeng dipeuget deungen tujuan untuk meumengkin komunikasi antara ureung-ureung yang laen jih akan na kesulitan untuk meumengkin.

source: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.
reference: Mandum nyan muepisah nibak lingua franca, nyan keuh basa alami atawa aseulie nyang jai dipaké sabab na saboh atawa laén hai sebagoe teumpat meututoe deungön awak laén.
hypothesis: Awak nyan terpisah dari lingua francas, yeng adalah bahasa alami atau organik yeng jeut dominan karena alasan saboh atau laen seubagai sarana komunikasi antara penutur bahasa laen.

source: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).
reference: Bak cot uroe nyang suum, peujeulajah meutume rasa fatamorgana nyang ibi bayangan ie (atawa hai nyang laén).
hypothesis: Bak uroe nyang seu-uem, para peujak jeut meugeumbara nyang meujok ilusi air (atau hal laen).

source: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.
reference: Nyoe jeut keu saboh bahaya meunyoe awak penjeulajah yak seutot fatamorgana, abeh watèe, abeh teunaga ngön ie jep nyang teusisa.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut keu bahaya meunyoe ureuëng nyang jak nyan jitiyeub mita-mita nyan, deungon nyan awak nyan jipeubloe energi nyang meuhareuga dan ié nyang na tinggai.

source: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.
reference: Bah guron nyang sep suum pih jeut sep that lupie oh watèe malam uroe. Hipotermia nyan peunyaket nyata meuseu hana baje tubai.
hypothesis: Bahkan padang pasi nyang paleng seu-uem pih jeuet keu leupie that bak malam. Hipotermia adalah resiko nyata meunyoe hana peukayan nyang seu-uem.

source: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.
reference: Bak musem suum, khususjih, droe neuh wajeb beu leuheun-leuheun keu nyamok meuseu neuk ék gunong rhot uteun.
hypothesis: Khusus jih bak musim panas, awak harus waspada keu nyamuk jika awak memutuskan untuk hiking melalui hutan hujan.

source: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.
reference: Bahpih meunyoe droeneuh neumè moto rhot uteun ujeuen subtropis, padum at manteng pintoe teuhah watèe neuk tamong lam moto nyan watèe nyang sep keu nyamok itamong lam moto droeneuh.
hypothesis: Bahkan meunyo awak awak awak pejalan melalui hutan hujan subtropis, padum-padum detik deungon pintoe-pintoe terbuka seugolom awak geutamong u dalam kendaraan nyan cukup watee untuk nyamuk-n nyamuk geutamong u dalam kendaraan droeneuh.

source: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
reference: Flu Burung, atawa jikheun leubéh reusmi avian influenza, nyang jeut keunong cicem atawa mamalia.
hypothesis: Gripe manuk, atau yang leubeh formal jih influenza manuk, jeut ji peunyakét manuk ngen mamalia.

source: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
reference: Kureung nibak siribe kasus na diadue nyang keunong manusiya, tapi padum-padum droe nibak awak nyan na nyang meuninggai.
hypothesis: Kurang dari seribu kasus ka ji lapor bak manusia, teutapi padum-padum nibak awak nyan ka fatal.

source: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
reference: Jai nibak awak nyan urueung nyang peulhara bak bangsa manok, na sit nibak awak nyan galak kalon cicem.
hypothesis: La'én-la'én jih na melibatkan ureung nyang bekerja deungen unggas, tapi na cit na padum boh bahaya keu peunonton cicém.

source: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.
reference: Khususjih keu norwegia nyan keuh fjord ngön leumbah nyang lhok lam sigra meuubah jeut keu buket manyang nyang leubéh kureung santeut.
hypothesis: khas untuk Norwégia adalah fjord dan lembah teuntang yang tiba-tiba meulah tempat ke dataran tinggi, lebih atau kurang rata.

source: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.
reference: Miyup-miyup manyang nyoe kayem geupeugah "vidde" nyang meumakna kama, tehah luah hana bak kayèe, teu leung hana ceu.
hypothesis: Plateau-plateau nyoë seureng dituri seubagoe "vidde" yang meuarti saboh ruang luah, terbuka hana kayee, saboh luwah nyang hana bataih.

source: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.
reference: Di Rogaland ngön Agder awak nyan kayem geupeugah "hei" nyang meumakna lampoh hana bak kayèe kayem meutop.
hypothesis: Di Rogaland ngen Agder awak nyan biasa jih geukheun "hei" yang meukeusut padang rumput hana kayee seureng teutôb deungen heather.

source: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.
reference: Gletser hana stabil, tapi dile tron dari gunong. Nyoe keuh sababjih crah, ceulah, nyang mungkén meutop ngön tutue salju.
hypothesis: gletser hana stabil, teutapi mengalir di ateueh gunong. nyo akan menyebabkan ret, celah-celah, yang mungken disembunyikan oleh jembatan salju.

source: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.
reference: Binteh ngön bubong guha eh jeut runtoh ngön crah jeut meutop.
hypothesis: Beuton dan bumbung gua es jeut runtuh dan retak jeut ditutup.

source: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.
reference: Di bineh gletser, balok-balok rayek tepeleuh, rhot ngön mungkén jigrop atawa meugule leubéh jioh u bineh.
hypothesis: Di ujong gletser blok rayek meucre, rhot dan mungken loncat atau meugulung leubeh jiôh dari ujong.

source: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.
reference: Watèe awak luwa u stasion buket umumjih trok u puncak watèe musem suum India.
hypothesis: Musim wisata untuk stasiun bukit umum jih puncak seulama musim panas India.

source: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.
reference: Adak pih, awak nyan na jeuneh nyang lagak ngön meunawan até nyang meubeda watèe musem leupie, deungön jai stasion buket geuterimong jumlah salju nyang leu ngön geupeutaba keugiatan lage ski ngön snowboarding.
hypothesis: Namun, awak nyan na bentuk yang berbeda dari keindahan dan pesona bak masa musim dingin, deungen padum boh stasiun bukit yang geuteurimong jumlah yang sehat salju dan na menawarkan kegiatan lage ski dan snowboarding.

source: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.
reference: Na padum boh sagai maskapai nyang manteng geupeutaba yum beurkabung, jeut bacut kureung biaya peurjalanan peumakaman bak keu seuneulheuh.
hypothesis: Padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum-padum

source: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
reference: Maskapai nyang geupetaba nyoe teumasok Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa keupenerbangan asai dari Amèrika Serikat atawa Kanada, ngön WestJet.
hypothesis: Bandara-bandara nyang peubloe nyoe termasuk Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa untuk penerbangan nyang meuasai dari AS atawa Kanada, ngen WestJet.

source: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
reference: Lam mandum peukara, gata payah tapesan rot teulepon langsong u maskapai.
hypothesis: Lam mandum peukara, awak nyan harus dipeubuka langsong lewat telepon bak maskapai penerbangan.
